AI.summary: 论文提出了 ReSight，一个用于具身智能体的任务驱动自提升记忆系统。它通过保留关键帧及时空关联，结合执行智能体与编码智能体，并利用 EDM（探索-蒸馏-挂载）机制自动识别能力差距，将探索解决方案转化为可复用的工具和技能，从而有效扩展了记忆处理和访问能力。
AI.keywords: 具身智能, 自我提升记忆, 任务驱动, 探索-蒸馏-挂载, 时空查询
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种任务驱动的具身智能体自我提升记忆系统 ReSight，通过“探索-蒸馏-挂载”（EDM）机制实现了记忆表示与访问能力的扩展，创新性地结合了执行智能体与编码智能体，兼顾了在线运行的效率与离线能力扩展的需求。

title: Incremental Predictive Value of LLM Tutoring Interactions for Student Performance
summary: We evaluate whether semester-level interaction features from a large language model tutor improve assignment-score prediction beyond constant baselines. StudyChat provides 16,851 student-assistant exchanges from two offerings of an undergraduate artificial intelligence course, with outcomes matched to 175 of 203 student-semester records. Six fitted estimators and training-fold mean and median baselines share repeated nested cross-validation. After averaging each student's held-out predictions across ten repeats, Gradient Boosting achieves mean absolute error of 3.023 grade points, versus 3.138 for the median baseline. The paired difference is -0.114, with a conditional 95% bootstrap interval of [-0.245,0.013]. Representation changes and a semester-specific median yield similarly small gains. In the lowest observed-score quartile, however, boosting's error is 7.30 points, versus 8.07 for the median and 6.67 for the mean; Ridge has the lowest fitted-model error at 6.37 despite its worse overall error of 3.331. Scores concentrate near the ceiling: 160 students (91.4%) score above 90, and the lowest quartile contributes 62.1% of boosting's total absolute error. This retrospective comparison shows how baseline choice and error distribution affect predictive value, informing evaluation of student-support tools without establishing a learning effect.

AI.title_translation: 大语言模型家教交互对学生表现的增量预测价值
AI.tldr: 大语言模型家教的交互特征能小幅提升学生作业成绩的预测准确性，在低分段学生群体中预测价值更明显。
AI.motivation: 评估大语言模型（LLM）家教的学期级交互特征是否能够超越恒定基线，从而提升对学生作业成绩的预测能力。
AI.method: 利用来自本科人工智能课程的16,851次学生-助手交互数据，结合学生-学期记录，采用六种拟合估计器与训练折的均值、中位数基线，通过重复嵌套交叉验证评估预测性能。
AI.result: Gradient Boosting取得了3.023的平均绝对误差（MAE），优于中位数基线（3.138）。在最低观测成绩四分位数中，Boosting的误差为7.30，而中位数为8.07、均值为6.67；Ridge模型在拟合模型中取得了最低的误差（6.37）。由于成绩接近天花板效应（91.4%的学生得分在90以上），低分四分位数贡献了Boosting总绝对误差的62.1%。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，LLM家教交互特征能够带来微小的整体预测增量，但在低分段学生群体中表现出更显著的预测价值。基线选择和误差分布对评估学生支持工具的预测效果具有重要影响。
AI.translation: 我们评估了大语言模型（LLM）家教的学期级交互特征是否能超越恒定基线，从而改进对作业成绩的预测。StudyChat提供了来自两学期本科人工智能课程的16,851次学生-助手交互数据，其结果与203个学生-学期记录中的175个相匹配。六个拟合估计器以及训练折的均值和中位数基线共享重复的嵌套交叉验证。在将每个学生在十次重复中的保留预测取平均后，梯度提升（Gradient Boosting）实现了3.023个成绩点的平均绝对误差，而中位数基线为3.138。成对差值为-0.114，条件95%自助法区间为[-0.245, 0.013]。表征变化和学期特定的中位数也产生了类似的小幅增益。然而，在最低观测成绩四分位数中，Boosting的误差为7.30点，而中位数为8.07，均值为6.67；尽管Ridge的整体误差较差（3.331），但其拟合模型误差最低（6.37）。分数集中在上限附近：160名学生（91.4%）得分超过90分，最低四分位数贡献了Boosting总绝对误差的62.1%。这项回顾性比较展示了基线选择和误差分布如何影响预测价值，为评估学生支持工具提供了参考，但并未确立学习效果。
AI.summary: 本文研究了利用大语言模型家教的交互特征来预测学生作业成绩的可行性与增量价值。通过对一门本科人工智能课程的大量学生交互数据进行嵌套交叉验证和回归分析，结果表明尽管整体成绩提升有限且存在天花板效应，但交互特征在识别和预测低分段学生的表现方面具有一定的价值，突显了基线选择和误差分布在评估教育支持工具时的重要性。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型家教, 成绩预测, 交互特征, 嵌套交叉验证, 误差分布
AI.comments: 该论文探讨了利用大语言模型（LLM）家教的学期级交互特征来预测学生作业成绩的增量预测价值。研究表明，虽然整体提升幅度较小，但在成绩较低的四分位数学生群体中，模型展现出了一定的预测差异和潜力。这为评估学生支持工具提供了重要的方法论参考，强调了基线选择和误差分布对预测评估的影响。

title: From Instructions to Exploits: Applying Program Analysis to Malicious Agent Skills Across Natural Language and Code
summary: LLM-powered agents increasingly rely on third-party skills that combine natural-language instructions with executable code, creating supply-chain risks that may span both artifacts. Existing skill scanners often rely on rule matching or direct LLM judgments and provide limited support for tracing such cross-domain behavior. We present the Supply-Chain Scanner for Agent Skills (SCS), a static analysis framework that unifies instructions and code for security analysis. SCS compiles natural-language instructions into a constrained Python-style intermediate representation using a limited set of security-oriented APIs. It then constructs program dependence graphs for instructions and bundled code and connects them into a cross-domain graph (xPDG). A Trust-Sensitivity-Capability (TSC) model propagates security properties over the graph to support structured, largely deterministic risk detection. On a manually verified benchmark of 117 malicious and 117 benign skills, SCS achieves the highest average accuracy (85.6%), recall (95.2%), and F1-score (86.9%) among evaluated methods across five LLMs, with 80.2% precision and average token consumption of 13.7 million. Its NL-to-IR compiler achieves 92.5%-94.5% step-level correctness on 400 human-annotated instruction steps. Finally, analyzing 66,157 real-world ClawHub skills yields 2,473 candidates, of which 627 are confirmed malicious through auxiliary dynamic validation and manual review.

AI.title_translation: 从指令到漏洞：将程序分析应用于跨自然语言和代码的恶意智能体技能
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为SCS的静态分析框架，通过将大模型智能体的自然语言指令与可执行代码统一转化为跨域程序依赖图，实现了对跨模态供应链风险的高效、精准检测。
AI.motivation: 大模型智能体日益依赖结合了自然语言指令与可执行代码的第三方技能，这带来了跨越两种模态的供应链安全风险。然而，现有的技能扫描器主要依赖规则匹配或大模型直接判断，缺乏对跨域行为进行追踪的有效支持。
AI.method: 提出了SCS（Supply-Chain Scanner for Agent Skills）静态分析框架：首先利用自然语言到中间表示（NL-to-IR）编译器将自然语言指令转化为受限的Python式中间表示，接着构建指令与代码的程序依赖图并将其连接为跨域图（xPDG），最后通过信任-敏感度-能力（TSC）模型在图上进行安全属性传播以实现风险检测。
AI.result: 在包含117个恶意和117个良性技能的基准测试中，SCS取得了最高的平均准确率（85.6%）、召回率（95.2%）和F1分数（86.9%）；NL-to-IR编译器在400个步骤上达到了92.5%-94.5%的正确率；在对66,157个真实ClawHub技能的分析中筛选出2,473个候选，并经动态验证和人工审核确认了627个恶意技能。
AI.conclusion: SCS框架通过将自然语言指令与可执行代码统一为跨域程序依赖图，并基于TSC模型进行确定性风险检测，显著提升了智能体第三方技能的恶意检测准确率与召回率，在实际数据集上发现了大量真实存在的恶意技能。
AI.translation: 基于大语言模型的智能体越来越依赖于结合了自然语言指令与可执行代码的第三方技能，这产生了可能跨越这两种模态的供应链安全风险。现有的技能扫描器通常依赖于规则匹配或直接的大模型判断，对追踪此类跨域行为的支持有限。我们提出了用于智能体技能的供应链扫描器（SCS），这是一个统一指令和代码进行安全分析的静态分析框架。SCS使用一组有限的安全导向API，将自然语言指令编译为受限的Python风格中间表示。然后，它为指令和打包的代码构建程序依赖图，并将它们连接成一个跨域图（xPDG）。信任-敏感度-能力（TSC）模型在图上单向传播安全属性，以支持结构化、大体上确定性的风险检测。在一个包含117个恶意和117个良性技能的手工验证基准上，SCS在五个大模型评估方法中取得了最高的平均准确率（85.6%）、召回率（95.2%）和F1分数（86.9%），精确率为80.2%，平均代币消耗为1370万。其NL-to-IR编译器在400个人工标注的指令步骤上达到了92.5%-94.5%的步骤级正确率。最后，通过分析66,157个真实世界的ClawHub技能，产生了2,473个候选技能，其中627个通过辅助动态验证和人工审核被确认为恶意技能。
AI.summary: 论文提出了SCS静态分析框架，通过将大模型智能体的自然语言指令编译为中间表示，并与可执行代码构建跨域程序依赖图（xPDG），结合TSC模型实现了对智能体技能供应链风险的高效、确定性检测。
AI.keywords: LLM agents, supply-chain security, program analysis, security scanner, cross-domain program dependence graph
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将程序分析方法应用于大模型智能体（LLM Agent）的供应链安全领域，通过将自然语言指令编译为中间表示并构建跨域程序依赖图（xPDG），有效解决了传统扫描器无法跨自然语言和代码进行精准追踪的痛点，展示了在真实世界大规模技能扫描中的强大威力。

title: Explicit Frictional Contact Modeling in Neural Garment Simulation
summary: Graph neural networks (GNNs) simulate garments efficiently through physics-based self-supervision, but leave body-garment friction implicit or inside training energies, with no friction coefficient $μ$ to set at inference; retraining the tested GNNs with a coefficient-specific friction term barely responds to $μ$. Optimization-based solvers decide each contact's stick-slip state from the reaction that governs it, but only by re-optimizing the garment state at every step; a friction term in a one-pass training objective acts as a fixed-weight penalty on sliding, and the trained weights apply no per-contact Coulomb condition at inference. We therefore resolve friction explicitly after prediction: a Modular Contact Operator, attached to a frozen predictor without retraining or an iterative solve, estimates the normal load, applies a closed-form Coulomb correction along a path across body triangles, and propagates the induced motion through the cloth as a linearized membrane wave. On HOOD and ContourCraft, it raises sticking and lowers slip monotonically in $μ$, tracking a reference solver's response while coefficient-specific retraining stays flat, with low penetration and reference-consistent stretching at an eighth of the solver's runtime.

AI.title_translation: 神经网络服装模拟中的显式摩擦接触建模
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种新的模块化接触算子，用于在神经网络服装模拟中显式处理摩擦。该算子可以在不进行再训练或迭代求解的情况下，在预测后估计法向载荷，应用库仑摩擦修正，并传播运动。实验结果表明，该方法能单调提高粘着性并降低滑动性，同时保持较低的穿透和拉伸，并且运行速度比参考求解器快八倍。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于图神经网络（GNN）的服装模拟方法将身体-服装摩擦隐式化或包含在训练能量中，导致在推理时无法设置摩擦系数μ。而基于优化的求解器虽然可以决定每个接触的粘滑状态，但需要每一步都重新优化服装状态，并且在训练目标中加入的摩擦项仅作为滑动时的固定权重惩罚，无法在推理时实现每接触的库仑条件。因此，需要一种新的方法来显式地处理摩擦。
AI.method: 提出了一种模块化接触算子（Modular Contact Operator），该算子可以附加到一个固定的预测器上，无需再训练或迭代求解。该算子首先估计法向载荷，然后沿着跨越身体三角形的路径应用闭式库仑修正，最后将诱导的运动作为线性化膜波传播到衣物上。
AI.result: 在HOOD和ContourCraft数据集上，该方法能够随着摩擦系数μ的增加单调地提高粘着性并降低滑动性，跟踪了参考求解器的响应，而仅通过特定系数再训练的方法则效果不佳。此外，该方法实现了较低的穿透和与参考求解器一致的拉伸，运行时间仅为参考求解器的八分之一。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的模块化接触算子能够显式地解决神经网络服装模拟中的摩擦问题，显著提高了模拟的准确性和效率，并且能够根据摩擦系数进行有效调整，优于现有方法。
AI.translation: 图神经网络（GNN）通过基于物理的自监督学习有效地模拟服装，但将身体-服装摩擦隐式化或置于训练能量内部，在推理时没有摩擦系数μ可供设置；对所测试的GNN进行特定系数的摩擦项再训练，几乎无法响应μ。基于优化的求解器通过控制其反应来决定每个接触的粘滑状态，但只能通过在每一步重新优化服装状态来实现；训练目标中的摩擦项仅作为滑动时的固定权重惩罚，并且训练好的权重在推理时不对每个接触应用库仑条件。因此，我们在预测后显式地解决摩擦：一个模块化接触算子（Modular Contact Operator），附加到一个固定的预测器上，无需再训练或迭代求解，即可估计法向载荷，沿着跨越身体三角形的路径应用闭式库仑修正，并将诱导的运动作为线性化膜波传播到衣物上。在HOOD和ContourCraft数据集上，它能随着μ单调地提高粘着性并降低滑动性，跟踪参考求解器的响应，而特定系数的再训练则保持不变，穿透度低，拉伸度与参考求解器一致，运行时间仅为参考求解器的八分之一。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种模块化接触算子，用于在神经网络服装模拟中显式处理摩擦。该算子在预测后进行操作，无需重新训练或迭代求解，能够估计法向载荷并应用库仑摩擦修正，从而有效控制衣物的粘滑状态。实验证明，该方法在提高模拟准确性、降低穿透和拉伸的同时，显著提高了计算效率。
AI.keywords: 神经网络服装模拟, 摩擦建模, 接触算子, 库仑摩擦, 物理仿真
AI.comments: 这项工作解决了神经网络服装模拟中的一个关键挑战——显式地建模摩擦。通过引入一个模块化算子，该方法在不牺牲效率的情况下提高了模拟的真实感。其优势在于无需复杂的迭代或再训练过程即可实现精确的摩擦控制，这对于实时应用尤其重要。未来的工作可以探索更复杂的摩擦模型或将其集成到更广泛的物理模拟场景中。

title: Small Edits, Shifting Decisions: Benchmarking LLM Accuracy and Reliability on French Input Variants
summary: French users may omit apostrophes and diacritics or make keyboard typos in everyday input. The effects of these common variations on language model performance and prediction reliability remain insufficiently understood. To address this gap, we construct a controlled French surface-variant benchmark covering seven task types, with 4,200 original-low-high triplets (12,600 input instances). Each high-intensity variant retains all low-intensity edits and adds further changes. We evaluate six models from two LLM families. The results show that accuracy decreases and Brier score and negative log-likelihood (NLL) increase with perturbation intensity. Larger models show smaller accuracy losses under high intensity, but increases in Brier score and NLL do not consistently decrease with scale. Keyboard typos cause the largest losses in accuracy and the quality of predicted probabilities at the predefined high-intensity settings. Finally, calibration temperatures fitted on original inputs transfer effectively to surface variants. Combining calibration with input restoration further improves Brier score and NLL over either method alone while preserving restored accuracy. Our benchmark provides a unified framework for jointly evaluating task accuracy and prediction reliability under common French surface variations.

AI.title_translation: 小型编辑，决策转移：在法语输入变体上对大型语言模型准确性和可靠性进行基准测试
AI.tldr: 该研究构建了一个法语输入变体基准，以评估大型语言模型在处理省略撇号、变音符号和键盘拼写错误等常见用户输入变化时的准确性和可靠性。结果表明，输入变化越剧烈，模型准确性越低，Brier分数和负对数似然（NLL）越高。虽然更大的模型在剧烈变化下准确性损失较小，但其Brier分数和NLL的增加并不总是随着模型规模的增大而减小。键盘拼写错误对准确性和概率预测质量的影响最大。研究还发现，使用原始输入校准的温度可以有效地应用于变体输入，并且结合输入恢复和校准可以进一步提高Brier分数和NLL。
AI.motivation: 法语用户在日常输入中可能会省略撇号和变音符号，或出现键盘拼写错误，但这些常见变化对语言模型性能和预测可靠性的影响尚不清楚。
AI.method: 构建了一个包含七种任务类型的、受控的法语表面变体基准，包含4,200个原始-低-高三元组（12,600个输入实例）。评估了来自两个大型语言模型系列的六个模型。
AI.result: 准确性随扰动强度增加而降低，Brier分数和负对数似然（NLL）随之增加。更大的模型在强扰动下准确性损失较小，但Brier分数和NLL的增加并不总是随着模型规模的增大而减小。键盘拼写错误在预设的强扰动设置下导致准确性和预测概率质量的最大损失。校准温度在原始输入上拟合后能有效地转移到表面变体上。结合校准和输入恢复比单独使用任一方法更能改善Brier分数和NLL，同时保持恢复后的准确性。
AI.conclusion: 该基准提供了一个统一的框架，用于联合评估在常见的法语表面变体下任务准确性和预测可靠性。结合输入恢复和校准是提高模型在处理法语输入变体时性能的有效策略。
AI.translation: 法语用户在日常输入中可能会省略撇号和变音符号，或出现键盘拼写错误。这些常见变化对语言模型性能和预测可靠性的影响尚不清楚。为了解决这一差距，我们构建了一个受控的法语表面变体基准，涵盖七种任务类型，包含4,200个原始-低-高三元组（12,600个输入实例）。每个高强度变体保留了所有低强度编辑并增加了进一步的更改。我们评估了来自两个大型语言模型系列的六个模型。结果表明，准确性随扰动强度增加而降低，Brier分数和负对数似然（NLL）随之增加。较大的模型在强扰动下准确性损失较小，但Brier分数和NLL的增加并不总是随着规模的增大而减少。键盘拼写错误在预设的强扰动设置下导致准确性和预测概率质量的最大损失。最后，在原始输入上拟合的校准温度能有效地转移到表面变体上。结合校准和输入恢复比单独使用任一方法更能改善Brier分数和NLL，同时保持恢复后的准确性。我们的基准提供了一个统一的框架，用于联合评估在常见的法语表面变体下任务准确性和预测可靠性。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一个针对法语输入的表面变体基准，用于评估大型语言模型（LLM）在处理常见用户输入错误（如省略撇号、变音符号和键盘拼写错误）时的准确性和可靠性。研究结果表明，输入扰动强度越大，模型准确性越低，Brier分数和负对数似然（NLL）越高。虽然更大规模的模型在面对高强度扰动时准确性下降幅度较小，但其Brier分数和NLL的增加并不总是随着模型规模的增大而减小。键盘拼写错误对准确性和概率质量的影响最为显著。此外，研究发现，在原始输入上训练的校准温度可以有效应用于变体输入，并且结合输入恢复和校准策略能够进一步提升模型性能，同时保持准确性。该基准为评估模型在处理法语输入变体时的表现提供了一个统一的框架。
AI.keywords: 法语输入变体,大型语言模型,准确性,可靠性,基准测试
AI.comments: 该研究构建了一个非常有用的法语输入变体基准，填补了现有研究的空白。研究方法严谨，评估了不同扰动强度和模型规模的影响，并提出了结合输入恢复和校准的有效策略。然而，该基准仅限于法语输入，未来可以扩展到其他语言。此外，对于键盘拼写错误的具体分析可以更深入。

title: RBGA: Residual-Budget Guide Arbitration for Offline-to-Online Safe Reinforcement Learning in Dexterous Manipulation
summary: Dexterous manipulation requires robots to leverage existing datasets for rapid skill acquisition while maintaining safety during real-world deployment to prevent damage to the robot or its surroundings. Offline-to-online safe reinforcement learning (O2O safe RL) provides a promising solution for this problem by leveraging prior experience for online improvement under safety constraints, thereby mitigating the sample inefficiency and exploration risk of learning safe policies from scratch. However, existing O2O safe RL approaches do not explicitly account for the safety budget already consumed when making decisions within an episode. Excessive cost incurred early can therefore leave little room for subsequent exploration and policy improvement. To address this limitation, we propose \textbf{R}esidual-\textbf{B}udget \textbf{G}uide \textbf{A}rbitration (RBGA), an algorithm that explicitly tracks the remaining episode safety budget and uses it to adaptively select between offline guidance and the evolving online policy. At each step, RBGA compares the cost-to-go estimates of the guide and online actions against the remaining budget, enabling step-wise action arbitration throughout the episode. We provide theoretical analysis characterizing the safety implications of residual-budget-based selection and its effect on guide-assisted exploration. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RBGA enables effective online policy improvement while maintaining strong safety performance. Our code is available at this \href{https://github.com/sii-pilab}{link}.

AI.title_translation: 残余预算指导仲裁：用于灵巧操作的离线到在线安全强化学习
AI.tldr: 现有的离线到在线安全强化学习方法在决策时没有考虑到每个回合已经消耗的安全预算，可能导致后续探索和策略改进的空间不足。本研究提出的RBGA算法通过跟踪剩余的安全预算，并根据剩余预算自适应地在离线指导和在线策略之间进行选择，从而解决了这个问题。RBGA在每一步都会将指导动作和在线动作的预估剩余成本与剩余预算进行比较，从而在整个回合中实现分步式的动作仲裁。理论分析和实验表明，RBGA在保证安全性能的同时，能够有效地进行在线策略改进。
AI.motivation: 现有的离线到在线安全强化学习方法在决策时没有考虑到每个回合已经消耗的安全预算，可能导致后续探索和策略改进的空间不足。
AI.method: RBGA算法通过跟踪剩余的安全预算，并根据剩余预算自适应地在离线指导和在线策略之间进行选择。在每一步，RBGA将指导动作和在线动作的预估剩余成本与剩余预算进行比较，从而在整个回合中实现分步式的动作仲裁。
AI.result: RBGA能够实现有效的在线策略改进，同时保持强大的安全性能。
AI.conclusion: RBGA算法通过显式跟踪剩余的回合安全预算，并利用该预算自适应地在离线指导和在线策略之间进行选择，从而解决了现有O2O安全RL方法中安全预算消耗不均的问题，有效提升了在线策略改进和安全性能。
AI.translation: 灵巧操作要求机器人利用现有数据集快速获取技能，同时在实际部署中保持安全性，以防止对机器人或其周围环境造成损害。离线到在线安全强化学习（O2O安全RL）通过利用先验经验在安全约束下进行在线改进，为解决这个问题提供了一个有前途的解决方案，从而减轻了从头开始学习安全策略的样本效率低下和探索风险。然而，现有的O2O安全RL方法在每回合的决策中没有明确考虑到已经消耗的安全预算。因此，早期产生的过高成本可能会为后续的探索和策略改进留下很小的空间。为了解决这个限制，我们提出了残余预算指导仲裁（RBGA）算法，该算法显式跟踪剩余的回合安全预算，并利用它来适应性地在离线指导和不断发展的在线策略之间进行选择。在每一步，RBGA将指导动作和在线动作的剩余成本估算与剩余预算进行比较，从而在整个回合中实现分步式的动作仲裁。我们提供了理论分析，描述了基于残余预算的选择对安全性的影响及其对指导辅助探索的影响。大量的实验表明，RBGA在保持强大的安全性能的同时，能够实现有效的在线策略改进。我们的代码可在以下链接获取：https://github.com/sii-pilab。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种名为RBGA（Residual-Budget Guide Arbitration）的新算法，用于解决离线到在线安全强化学习（O2O safe RL）在灵巧操作任务中的一个关键挑战：现有方法未能充分考虑每个回合中已消耗的安全预算，可能导致后续探索空间受限。RBGA通过显式跟踪剩余的安全预算，并在每一步自适应地在离线指导和在线策略之间进行仲裁，从而确保在保证安全性的前提下，最大化在线策略的改进效果。理论分析和实验结果均证实了RBGA在提升策略性能和维持安全保障方面的有效性。
AI.keywords: 离线到在线安全强化学习, 灵巧操作, 安全预算, RBGA, 策略改进
AI.comments: 该研究提出的RBGA算法通过引入残余安全预算的概念，有效解决了现有O2O安全RL方法在实际应用中的一个关键限制。通过在每一步进行自适应的动作选择，RBGA在保证安全性的前提下，显著提高了样本效率和策略改进能力，对于需要安全保障的灵巧操作任务具有重要的理论和实践意义。未来的工作可以进一步探索RBGA在更复杂的环境和更广泛的任务中的适用性。

title: Five Architectures, One Shared Space Cross-Model Representational Alignment Without Weight Merging
summary: Combining language models is usually done by averaging weights, which works only when the models share a common starting point. We ask whether five frozen, independently trained models with different internal designs (four transformers from four organizations and one state-space model) can be related through their activations alone, with no weight merging. Using permutation tests, an independent replication probe set, depth sweeps, pooling ablations and confound checks, we find statistically robust correspondence between how the five models organize the same text. It is strongest at each model's final layer and weaker for the state-space model, whose weakest pairing is still 35-43 times chance. We use this to build a shared space with Generalized Procrustes Analysis, in which no model is a fixed reference. At the final layer, mean held-out retrieval accuracy over the twenty ordered model pairs is 0.91 to 0.93 on two probe sets (chance 0.03), beating pairwise linear maps (0.82 to 0.85), but the space is worse than those maps in the middle layers. It transfers to ordinary English of unfamiliar grammatical form and fails on mathematical and logical notation. We then test whether the space supports a router that picks among the five models on gradeable tasks. Across four task types we find no case where routing beats always using the strongest model, and we report this as a negative result. A correctness signal that looked strong turned out to be category membership in disguise. All experiments ran on one laptop without a GPU.

AI.title_translation: 五种架构，一个共享空间：无权重合并的跨模型表征对齐
AI.tldr: 本文证明了五种架构完全不同的独立语言模型仅通过激活值就能实现跨模型表征对齐，并构建了一个高效的共享空间，但基于此空间的模型路由未能超越最强单模型。
AI.motivation: 传统的语言模型结合方法（如权重平均）仅适用于共享共同起点的模型，作者旨在探讨五种完全独立训练且内部设计不同的冻结模型（包括四种不同的Transformer和一种状态空间模型）是否能仅通过激活值实现跨模型表征对齐，而无需进行权重合并。
AI.method: 使用置换检验、独立复制探针集、深度扫描、池化消融和混淆检查来分析激活对应性；并利用广义普罗克鲁斯特分析（GPA）构建共享空间，无需固定参考模型。
AI.result: 五个模型之间存在显著的表征对应关系（最强在最后一层，状态空间模型较弱但远超随机）；使用GPA构建的共享空间在最后一层的平均保留检索准确率达到0.91-0.93（随机为0.03），优于两两线性映射；该空间可泛化至语法结构不熟悉的普通英语，但在数学和逻辑符号上失败；基于该空间的模型路由未能超越始终使用最强模型的性能。
AI.conclusion: 独立训练的不同架构模型之间存在统计学上稳健的激活对应关系，通过广义普罗克鲁斯特分析可以构建一个有效的跨模型共享空间，但该空间在中间层表现较弱且在逻辑/数学任务上失效，基于此空间的模型路由未能超越最强单模型。
AI.translation: 组合语言模型通常通过平均权重来实现，但这仅在模型共享共同起点时才有效。我们探讨了五个冻结的、独立训练且内部设计不同的模型（来自四个组织的四个Transformer和一个状态空间模型）是否仅通过激活值就能相互关联，而无需合并权重。通过使用置换检验、独立复制探针集、深度扫描、池化消融和混淆检查，我们发现这五个模型在组织相同文本的方式上存在统计学上稳健的对应关系。这种对应关系在每个模型的最后一层最强，对于状态空间模型较弱，但其最弱的配对依然是随机情况的35-43倍。我们利用广义普罗克鲁斯特分析（GPA）构建了一个共享空间，其中没有哪个模型是固定参考点。在最后一层，二十个有序模型对在两个探针集上的平均保留检索准确率达到了0.91到0.93（随机概率为0.03），超过了两两线性映射（0.82到0.85），但该空间在中间层的表现不如这些线性映射。它能够迁移到语法形式不熟悉的普通英语，但在数学和逻辑符号上失败了。然后，我们测试了该空间是否支持在可分级任务中从这五种模型中进行选择的路由器。在四种任务类型中，我们发现没有任何一种情况下的路由效果能超过始终使用最强的模型，并将此报告为一个消极结果。一个看起来很强的正确性信号最终被证明是伪装成类别的成员身份。所有实验都在一台没有GPU的笔记本电脑上运行。
AI.summary: 本文研究了五种独立训练的不同架构语言模型（含Transformer和状态空间模型）在无权重合并的情况下，仅通过内部激活值实现跨模型表征对齐的可行性。研究发现模型间存在显著的对应关系，并利用广义普罗克鲁斯特分析构建了高效的共享空间，但在中间层表现较弱、数学逻辑符号上失效，且模型路由尝试得出消极结果。
AI.keywords: 表征对齐, 语言模型, 广义普罗克鲁斯特分析, 模型架构, 激活值分析
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地展示了五种不同架构的独立预训练模型（包括Transformer和状态空间模型）在没有权重合并的情况下，仅通过激活值能够实现跨模型的表征对齐。这对于理解不同语言模型内部表征的共性具有重要意义，且实验仅在无GPU的笔记本上完成，非常轻量。局限性在于该共享空间在中间层的效果不如两两线性映射，且在数学和逻辑符号上失效，路由实验也得到了消极结果。

title: FedSEAM: Federated Continual Learning of LLMs via Subspace Expert Agreement Merging
summary: Federated continual learning trains a model on a sequence of tasks across several clients without sharing their data while retaining knowledge of earlier tasks. Sparse mixture-of-experts models support this setting by adapting selected parameters on a frozen backbone. However, clients learn different expert content as tasks evolve, making it difficult to share knowledge across clients without disrupting task-specific and client-specific specialization. Matching tile coordinates alone does not establish whether their learned content is compatible. We present FedSEAM, a federated continual learning framework that organizes task knowledge into sparse experts and selectively shares their content across tasks and clients. On each client, task-aware tile selection allocates capacity to a new task, while a subspace-based compatibility test determines which existing expert tiles to reuse and where to introduce fresh capacity. On the server, Subspace Expert Agreement Merging (SEAM) compares client updates as subspaces and moves each client towards consensus only along agreed-upon directions, leaving the rest of its update unchanged. We identify two remaining sources of forgetting, routing drift and merge erasure, and address them with three protections, one of which exactly preserves tile components in a selected prior-overlap subspace at every merge. We evaluate FedSEAM on TRACE using Qwen3-4B and Llama-3.2-3B, with component-wise ablations and studies of data size to assess its balance between learning new tasks and retaining prior knowledge.

AI.title_translation: 联邦学习中的大型语言模型持续学习：通过子空间专家一致性合并
AI.tldr: FedSEAM是一种联邦持续学习框架，通过子空间专家一致性合并来解决大型语言模型（LLMs）在分布式数据上进行持续学习时遇到的知识遗忘和客户端间知识共享难题。它通过任务感知型平铺选择来适应新任务，并利用子空间兼容性测试来重用现有专家或引入新容量。服务器端的SEAM机制通过比较客户端更新的子空间并仅在一致的方向上进行合并，以促进共识。框架还引入了三种保护机制来解决遗忘问题。
AI.motivation: 在联邦持续学习的场景下，客户端学习到的专家内容可能不同，这使得在不破坏任务特定和客户端特定专业化的前提下，跨客户端共享知识变得困难。仅仅匹配平铺坐标不足以判断其学习到的内容是否兼容。
AI.method: FedSEAM框架首先在每个客户端，利用任务感知型平铺选择来为新任务分配容量。然后，通过基于子空间的兼容性测试来确定重用哪些现有专家平铺以及在哪里引入新的容量。在服务器端，子空间专家一致性合并（SEAM）机制将客户端更新视为子空间进行比较，并仅在达成一致的方向上推动客户端达成共识，而保留其余更新不变。此外，还提出了三种保护机制来解决路由漂移和合并擦除导致的遗忘问题。
AI.result: FedSEAM在TRACE数据集上使用Qwen3-4B和Llama-3.2-3B模型进行了评估，并通过组件消融和数据规模研究，证明了其在学习新任务和保留先验知识之间的平衡能力。
AI.conclusion: FedSEAM通过其创新的子空间专家一致性合并机制，有效地解决了联邦持续学习中LLMs的知识共享和遗忘问题，并在实验中展示了其在学习新任务和保留旧知识方面的优越性能。
AI.translation: 联邦持续学习在不共享数据的情况下，在多个客户端上对一系列任务进行模型训练，同时保留早期任务的知识。稀疏的专家混合模型通过在固定的骨干模型上调整选定的参数来支持这种设置。然而，随着任务的演变，客户端会学习到不同的专家内容，这使得在不破坏任务特定和客户端特定专业化的前提下，跨客户端共享知识变得困难。仅仅匹配平铺坐标并不能确定它们学习到的内容是否兼容。我们提出了FedSEAM，一个联邦持续学习框架，将任务知识组织成稀疏的专家，并有选择地跨任务和客户端共享其内容。在每个客户端，任务感知型平铺选择为新任务分配容量，而基于子空间的兼容性测试确定重用哪些现有专家平铺以及在哪里引入新的容量。在服务器端，子空间专家一致性合并（SEAM）将客户端更新视为子空间进行比较，并仅在达成一致的方向上推动客户端达成共识，而保留其余更新不变。我们识别了遗忘的两个残留来源——路由漂移和合并擦除——并通过三种保护措施来解决它们，其中一种在每次合并时在选定的先验重叠子空间中精确地保留平铺组件。我们在TRACE上使用Qwen3-4B和Llama-3.2-3B评估了FedSEAM，并通过组件消融和数据规模研究来评估其在学习新任务和保留先验知识之间的平衡。
AI.summary: FedSEAM是一个新颖的联邦持续学习框架，专门用于大型语言模型（LLMs）。它通过将知识组织成稀疏专家并利用子空间兼容性测试来有效管理跨客户端和跨任务的知识共享。该框架通过服务器端的子空间专家一致性合并（SEAM）机制，促进客户端之间的共识，同时保留其专业化知识。此外，FedSEAM还引入了专门的保护机制来应对遗忘问题，从而在学习新知识和保持旧知识方面取得了良好的平衡。
AI.keywords: 联邦持续学习, 大型语言模型, 专家混合, 子空间合并, 知识共享
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种名为FedSEAM的联邦持续学习框架，用于解决大型语言模型（LLMs）在分布式设置下的知识共享和遗忘问题。FedSEAM的核心创新在于其子空间专家一致性合并（SEAM）机制，该机制能够智能地比较和合并来自不同客户端的更新，只在达成共识的方向上进行调整，从而有效地促进了知识的共享，同时保留了客户端的专业化知识。此外，框架还通过任务感知型平铺选择和基于子空间的兼容性测试来优化新任务的学习和旧知识的重用。研究中提出的针对遗忘问题的三种保护措施，特别是精确保留特定子空间组件的方法，显示了其解决持续学习挑战的细致考量。然而，该框架的计算复杂性以及在大规模、异构联邦学习场景下的实际部署和性能仍有待进一步研究和验证。

title: Proof of the Langberg-Médard Multiple Unicast Conjecture
summary: Let $\mathcal{N}=(V,A,S, R)$ be a directed network, where $D=(V,A)$ is a digraph, $S=\{s_1,s_2,\ldots,s_k\}\subseteq V$ is a set of senders, and $R=\{r_1,r_2,\ldots,r_k\}\subseteq V$ is a set of receivers. We prove that if, for each $1\le j \le k$, there exist $k$ pairwise arc-disjoint directed paths in $D$, one from each $s_i$ to $r_j$, then the underlying undirected network of ${\cal N}$, with unit capacities, admits a feasible $(s_1,s_2,\ldots,s_k)$-$(r_1,r_2,\ldots,r_k)$ multiflow of value $1$ for each pair $(s_i,r_i)$, $i=1,2,\ldots,k$. This establishes the multiple unicast conjecture proposed by Langberg and Médard in 2009.

AI.title_translation: Langberg-Médard 多重单播猜想的证明
AI.tldr: 该论文成功证明了著名的Langberg-Médard多重单播猜想。
AI.motivation: 验证并解决由Langberg和Médard于2009年提出的关于多重单播（multiple unicast）网络容量的著名猜想。
AI.method: 通过图论与网络流理论，证明在满足每个接收器对所有发送器存在$k$条两两弧不相交有向路径的条件下，底层单位容量无向网络允许每个$(s_i, r_i)$对具有值为1的可行多流。
AI.result: 证明了Langberg-Médard多重单播猜想，展示了有向路径条件与底层无向网络可行多流之间的理论联系。
AI.conclusion: 论文成功证明了如果每个接收器都存在来自各个发送器的弧不相交路径，则底层无向网络允许容量为1的可行多商品流，从而证实了Langberg-Médard多重单播猜想。
AI.translation: 设 $\mathcal{N}=(V,A,S, R)$ 是一个有向网络，其中 $D=(V,A)$ 是一个有向图，$S=\{s_1,s_2,\ldots,s_k\}\subseteq V$ 是一组发送器，$R=\{r_1,r_2,\ldots,r_k\}\subseteq V$ 是一组接收器。我们证明了：如果对于每个 $1\le j \le k$，在 $D$ 中存在 $k$ 条两两弧不相交的有向路径（每个 $s_i$ 到 $r_j$ 各一条），那么该底层无向网络（具有单位容量）对于每个对 $(s_i,r_i)$（$i=1,2,\ldots,k$）都允许一个流量为 1 的可行 $(s_1,s_2,\ldots,s_k)$-$(r_1,r_2,\ldots,r_k)$ 多流。这确立了 Langberg 和 Médard 于 2009 年提出的多重单播猜想。
AI.summary: 该论文证明了2009年提出的Langberg-Médard多重单播猜想：当网络中每个接收器对所有发送器都存在$k$条两两弧不相交的有向路径时，底层单位容量无向网络将允许每个源-宿对存在值为1的可行多重流。
AI.keywords: 网络多单播猜想, Langberg-Médard猜想, 弧不相交路径, 多商品流, 有向网络
AI.comments: 该论文证明了Langberg和Médard在2009年提出的多播/多单播猜想，解决了网络编码和多商品流领域中一个长期悬而未决的公开问题，具有重要的理论意义。

title: Optimal Connectivity of Random Boolean Networks for Reservoir Computing
summary: Reservoir computing shifts the focus from training a system's internal dynamics to designing dynamics that expose useful computational capabilities via linear projection. We study random Boolean networks as reservoirs: cellular automata with random recurrent wiring and a random rule at each node. Their main parameter is the connectivity, the mean number of edges into a node. Without input, these networks pass from ordered to chaotic dynamics at a connectivity of 2, where their dynamics are expected to facilitate computation. How the input is connected is itself a design factor: if the input shares the network's edges, the connectivity sets both the dynamics and how many nodes receive the input, the input fan-out. We set the input fan-out separately and compare 7,560 reservoir designs, all combinations of six design factors, each built as many random reservoirs, on recalling the majority or the parity of a few input bits seen several steps earlier. The optimal connectivity falls from 2.5 to 1.75-2 as more nodes receive the input, but hardly depends on the task or on the other design factors, except self-loops, which connect a node to itself and raise the optimal connectivity. A measure computed from the reservoir states without a trained readout peaks at a connectivity that also falls with the fan-out and rises with self-loops, but does not replace training a readout. Reservoirs of one design vary widely, so a design should be judged by its typical reservoir.

AI.title_translation: 随机布尔网络的最佳连通性用于水库计算
AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了随机布尔网络（RBN）作为水库计算的潜力，重点关注其连通性参数。研究发现，网络动力学从有序到混沌的转变点（连通性为2）对于计算至关重要。通过调整输入扇出和自环等因素，可以优化RBN的性能，但网络本身的变异性意味着设计应基于典型表现。
AI.motivation: 水库计算将训练重点从系统内部动力学转移到设计能够通过线性投影暴露有用计算能力的动力学。本研究旨在探索随机布尔网络（RBN）作为水库计算的可能性，并优化其设计参数。
AI.method: 研究了随机布尔网络（RBN）作为水库计算的适用性。通过改变输入扇出（即输入连接到的节点数量）和自环（节点连接到自身）等设计因素，并评估了7560种不同的水库设计。评估标准是水库在回忆几步之前输入的多数或奇偶校验任务上的表现。
AI.result: 在回忆任务中，最佳连通性随着输入扇出的增加而从2.5降低到1.75-2。最佳连通性几乎不依赖于任务或除自环以外的其他设计因素。自环会提高最佳连通性。一个不依赖于训练读出的度量在连通性不是2时达到峰值，该度量随输入扇出的增加而降低，随自环的增加而增加，但不能替代训练读出。
AI.conclusion: 随机布尔网络的连通性是优化其在水库计算中性能的关键因素，但最佳连通性会受到输入扇出和自环等因素的影响。虽然可以设计出表现良好的RBN，但其内在的变异性意味着需要考虑典型表现而非单个实例。
AI.translation: 水库计算将训练重点从系统内部动力学转移到设计能够通过线性投影暴露有用计算能力的动力学。我们研究随机布尔网络作为水库：具有随机递归连接和每个节点随机规则的元胞自动机。它们的主要参数是连通性，即每个节点接收到的平均边数。在没有输入的情况下，这些网络在连通性为2时从有序动力学转变为混沌动力学，此时它们的动力学有望促进计算。输入的连接方式本身就是一个设计因素：如果输入共享网络的边，连通性就决定了动力学以及多少节点接收输入（输入扇出）。我们单独设置输入扇出，并比较了7,560种水库设计（所有六个设计因素的组合），每种设计都由多个随机水库构成，评估它们回忆几步之前输入的多数或奇偶校验任务的能力。最佳连通性随着输入接收的节点增多而从2.5降低到1.75-2，但几乎不依赖于任务或除自环外的其他设计因素，自环连接节点自身并提高最佳连通性。一个不依赖于训练读出的、从水库状态计算出的度量在连通性为2时达到峰值，该连通性随输入扇出的增加而降低，随自环的增加而升高，但不能替代训练读出。一种设计的储层变化很大，因此一种设计应以其典型的储层来判断。
AI.summary: 本研究探讨了随机布尔网络（RBN）在水库计算中的应用，重点关注连通性参数对网络计算能力的影响。研究发现，RBN的动力学在连通性为2时从有序转变为混沌，这对于计算至关重要。通过调整输入扇出和自环等设计因素，可以优化RBN在特定任务（如回忆多数或奇偶校验）上的表现。结果表明，最佳连通性会随着输入扇出的增加而降低，并且受到自环的显著影响。虽然存在一些不依赖于训练读出的度量可以反映网络性能，但它们不能完全替代训练过程。
AI.keywords: 随机布尔网络,水库计算,连通性,输入扇出,自环
AI.comments: 这项研究对理解和优化随机布尔网络在水库计算中的应用具有重要意义。通过量化连通性、输入扇出和自环等参数对网络性能的影响，为设计更高效的计算系统提供了指导。然而，研究中也提到RBN的内在变异性可能是一个挑战，未来的研究可以进一步探索如何减轻这种变异性或利用其特性。

title: Translating RDF 1.2 Graphs to Property Graphs
comments: 13 pages, 5 figures. Accepted for the 2nd International Workshop on Data Management for Knowledge Graphs (DMKG 2026), Bari, Italy
summary: RDF 1.2 introduces statement-level constructs, such as triple terms, reifiers, and descriptions, that pose new challenges for transforming RDF data into labeled property graphs (LPGs). This work presents and compares three algorithms for translating RDF 1.2 data into LPGs, each interpreting a different amount of the RDF 1.2 reification vocabulary. Algorithm Structural interprets no vocabulary and losslessly supports arbitrary RDF 1.2 graphs by representing triple terms explicitly as nodes; Direct interprets rdf:reifies to recover annotated edges while preserving reifiers as graph objects; and Fold additionally folds reifier descriptions into edge properties, resulting in a more concise, albeit lossy, LPG representation. We define the three translations, analyze which class of RDF 1.2 graphs each preserves, and experimentally evaluate their implementations. The experiments confirm the predicted trade-offs: all variants scale linearly on the tested workloads, the generality of Structural has no runtime penalty, and folding descriptions into edge records can significantly reduce the number of edges on description-heavy data.
comment: 13 pages, 5 figures. Accepted for the 2nd International Workshop on Data Management for Knowledge Graphs (DMKG 2026), Bari, Italy

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了三种将RDF 1.2数据转换为标签属性图（LPG）的算法，并进行了比较，每种算法对RDF 1.2反向词汇的解释程度不同。
AI.motivation: RDF 1.2引入的报表级构造（如三元组项、反向器和描述）给将RDF数据转换为标签属性图（LPG）带来了新的挑战。
AI.method: 提出了三种算法（Structural、Direct、Fold）来翻译RDF 1.2数据到LPG，并对它们的实现进行了实验评估。
AI.result: Structural算法无损地支持任意RDF 1.2图；Direct算法恢复了带注释的边；Fold算法将描述折叠到边属性中，生成更简洁但有损的LPG表示。实验表明，所有变体都能线性扩展，Structural算法的通用性没有运行时开销，而将描述折叠到边记录中可以显著减少边数。
AI.conclusion: 三种翻译算法在RDF 1.2图到LPG的转换方面各有优劣，研究者可以根据具体需求选择合适的算法，以在数据保真度、简洁性和运行时性能之间取得平衡。
AI.translation: RDF 1.2引入了报表级构造，例如三元组项、反向器和描述，这些都为将RDF数据转换为标记属性图（LPG）带来了新的挑战。这项工作提出了三种将RDF 1.2数据转换为LPG的算法，并进行了比较，每种算法对RDF 1.2反向词汇的解释程度不同。Structural算法不解释任何词汇，通过将三元组项显式表示为节点来无损地支持任意RDF 1.2图；Direct算法解释rdf:reifies以恢复带注释的边，同时将反向器保留为图对象；Fold算法此外还将反向器描述折叠到边属性中，从而生成更简洁但有损的LPG表示。我们定义了三种翻译，分析了每种翻译所保留的RDF 1.2图的类别，并对其实现进行了实验评估。实验证实了预测的权衡：所有变体在测试的工作负载上都呈线性扩展，Structural的通用性没有运行时开销，并且将描述折叠到边记录中可以显著减少描述密集型数据上的边数。
AI.summary: 本研究提出并比较了三种将RDF 1.2数据转换为标签属性图（LPG）的算法：Structural、Direct和Fold。Structural算法通过显式表示三元组项节点来无损地支持任意RDF 1.2图；Direct算法利用 `rdf:reifies` 恢复带注释的边；Fold算法将描述折叠到边属性中以获得更简洁但有损的表示。研究定义了这些翻译，分析了它们的属性，并通过实验评估了它们的性能。结果表明，所有算法都具有线性扩展性，Structural算法的通用性没有性能损失，而Fold算法能有效减少复杂图中的边数。
AI.keywords: RDF 1.2, 标签属性图, 翻译算法, 反向器, 数据转换
AI.comments: 这项工作解决了RDF 1.2到LPG转换中的一个重要问题，提供了三种具有不同权衡的实用算法。实验评估提供了有价值的见解，证实了理论分析。然而，对于不同类型RDF 1.2图的适用性以及在更大规模数据集上的性能表现，可能还需要进一步的研究。

title: DualPace: Decoupled Scheduling and Cooperative GPU--CPU Decoding for LLM Serving
summary:
Large language model (LLM) serving relies on batching to improve inference throughput, but the key-value (KV) cache grows with sequence length and limits GPU-resident concurrency. CPU offloading can expand KV capacity using host memory, yet existing systems remain largely GPU-gated: CPU-resident requests make progress only when the GPU scheduler exposes suitable overlap opportunities. As a result, host memory and CPU compute cannot act as an independent serving resource, leading to bursty CPU-side progress and inflated tail inter-token latency (ITL) under load.
  We present DualPace, an LLM serving runtime that turns the host into an independently scheduled decode engine. DualPace separates scheduling authority across two engines: the GPU engine executes prefills and GPU-resident decodes, while an AMX-enabled CPU engine independently batches and advances CPU-resident decodes. The engines are decoupled in scheduling but cooperative in execution: the CPU can execute a complete decode iteration locally or selectively invoke GPU Dense Assist for dense stages, while offline profiles guide hardware-specific batching and routing.
  Our evaluations show that, in decode-oriented scenarios, DualPace improves serving throughput by 6.9--43.2\% over NEO, a state-of-the-art open-source CPU-offloading system, and by 11.5--90.6\% over vLLM, a widely used GPU serving system, while maintaining the same level of latency. DualPace also preserves NEO's P99 time-to-first-token (TTFT) advantage over vLLM while sustaining 7.3--50.5\% higher request rates than NEO at the same level of P99 ITL.

AI.title_translation: 双节奏：LLM服务解耦调度和协同GPU-CPU解码
AI.tldr: DualPace通过将CPU和GPU作为独立的解码引擎，并允许它们协同工作，解决了LLM服务中KV缓存限制GPU并发性和CPU利用率不足的问题，显著提高了吞吐量和请求速率，同时保持了延迟。
AI.motivation: 现有的LLM服务系统在批处理以提高吞吐量时，KV缓存随着序列长度的增长限制了GPU的并发性。CPU卸载虽然可以利用主机内存扩展KV容量，但CPU驻留的请求只能在GPU调度器提供重叠机会时才能取得进展，导致CPU端进展断续且尾部迭代延迟（ITL）升高。
AI.method: DualPace将调度权分离到两个引擎：GPU引擎执行预填充和GPU驻留解码；AMX启用的CPU引擎独立地对CPU驻留解码进行批处理和推进。这两个引擎在调度上是解耦的，但在执行上是协同的。CPU可以完全在本地执行解码迭代，或者选择性地为密集阶段调用GPU密集辅助（Dense Assist）。离线配置文件指导硬件特定的批处理和路由。
AI.result: 与最先进的开源CPU卸载系统NEO相比，DualPace在面向解码的场景中将服务吞吐量提高了6.9%–43.2%，与广泛使用的GPU服务系统vLLM相比，提高了11.5%–90.6%，同时保持了相同的延迟水平。DualPace还保留了NEO相对于vLLM的P99首次令牌时间（TTFT）优势，同时在相同的P99 ITL水平下，请求速率比NEO高出7.3%–50.5%。
AI.conclusion: DualPace通过将调度权分离到独立的GPU和CPU解码引擎，并实现协同执行，成功地将主机内存和CPU计算转化为独立的、可调度的服务资源。这显著提高了LLM服务的吞吐量和请求速率，同时有效控制了延迟。
AI.translation:
大型语言模型（LLM）服务依赖于批处理来提高推理吞吐量，但键值（KV）缓存会随着序列长度的增长而增大，并限制GPU驻留的并发性。CPU卸载可以通过使用主机内存来扩展KV容量，但现有的系统在很大程度上仍然是GPU门控的：CPU驻留的请求只有在GPU调度器暴露合适的重叠机会时才能取得进展。因此，主机内存和CPU计算不能作为独立的服务资源，导致在负载下CPU端的进展断续和迭代间延迟（ITL）升高。
我们提出了DualPace，一个LLM服务运行时，它将主机变成一个独立调度的解码引擎。DualPace将调度权限分离到两个引擎：GPU引擎执行预填充和GPU驻留解码，而一个启用了AMX的CPU引擎独立地对CPU驻留解码进行批处理和推进。这两个引擎在调度上是解耦的，但在执行上是协同的：CPU可以完全在本地执行一个完整的解码迭代，或者选择性地为密集阶段调用GPU密集辅助（Dense Assist），而离线配置文件指导硬件特定的批处理和路由。
我们的评估表明，在面向解码的场景中，与最先进的开源CPU卸载系统NEO相比，DualPace的服务吞吐量提高了6.9%–43.2%，与广泛使用的GPU服务系统vLLM相比，提高了11.5%–90.6%，同时保持了相同的延迟水平。DualPace还保留了NEO相对于vLLM的P99首次令牌时间（TTFT）优势，同时在相同的P99 ITL水平下，请求速率比NEO高出7.3%–50.5%。
AI.summary: DualPace是一种新的LLM服务运行时，它通过将调度权分离到独立的GPU和CPU解码引擎，并使它们能够协同工作，来解决现有系统中的性能瓶颈。该系统能够独立地推进CPU驻留的请求，从而更有效地利用主机内存和CPU计算资源。实验结果表明，DualPace在吞吐量和请求速率方面显著优于现有系统，同时保持了可比的延迟水平。
AI.keywords: LLM服务, GPU-CPU协同, 解码引擎, 调度解耦, KV缓存
AI.comments: DualPace通过将调度权分离到独立的GPU和CPU解码引擎，并实现协同执行，成功地将主机内存和CPU计算转化为独立的、可调度的服务资源。这显著提高了LLM服务的吞吐量和请求速率，同时有效控制了延迟。该方法具有创新性，并且在实际应用中显示出优越的性能。

title: Novel or Not? PatEx-Gym: Agentic Prior-Art Search for Novelty Assessment in Patent Examination
summary: Patent examination is a challenging real-world task that requires agents to discover sparse prior art, iteratively refine queries, inspect technical evidence, and produce novelty assessments documented in Office Actions (OAs) across heterogeneous scientific and technical domains. However, existing benchmarks largely focus on static and limited candidate sets, leaving the full search--reasoning--assessment process underexplored. We present PatEx-Gym, the first framework for developing and evaluating agents for patent examination, which integrates three components. First, PatEx-Bench provides 1K realistic examination tasks, two large-scale retrieval corpora containing over 1M patents and 52K scientific papers, and a harness runtime supporting iterative search, document visits, reasoning, and OA generation. Second, we introduce PASS, an annotation-free Prior-Art Agentic Search Trajectory Synthesis framework. Specifically, it exploits document visits as implicit relevance signals and evidence-acquisition anchors to model intra-turn query behavior, inter-turn search progression, and trajectory-level evidence and outcome quality, yielding PatEx-SynData. Third, we train PatEx-Agent at the 4B scale via supervised fine-tuning on the curated trajectories, establishing a lightweight baseline. Extensive experiments show that final decision accuracy alone does not fully reflect examination quality, while prior-art discovery remains difficult even for strong frontier models. Our PatEx-Agent achieves competitive performance against substantially larger general-purpose agents. These results show that training on PatEx-SynData enables a compact 4B model to serve as a competitive baseline for prior-art search and patent examination. We view patent examination as a demanding testbed for agentic search and deep research agents.

AI.title_translation: 新颖性？PatEx-Gym：用于专利审查中新颖性评估的代理先艺术搜索
AI.tldr: 该论文提出了PatEx-Gym，一个用于专利审查代理的框架，包含一个包含1K个真实审查任务、1M+专利和5.2万篇科学论文的基准，以及一个支持迭代搜索、文档访问、推理和审查意见书生成的系统。它还引入了PASS框架来合成先艺术搜索轨迹数据（PatEx-SynData），并训练了一个4B参数的PatEx-Agent。实验表明，虽然最终决策准确性很重要，但发现先艺术仍然很困难，即使是强大的模型。PatEx-Agent在与更大的通用代理相比时表现出竞争力，表明合成数据训练的小型模型可以作为先艺术搜索和专利审查的有力基准。
AI.motivation: 现有的专利审查基准主要关注静态和有限的候选集，未能充分探索整个搜索-推理-评估过程，而专利审查是一个需要发现稀疏先艺术、迭代优化查询、检查技术证据并生成审查意见书的复杂任务。
AI.method: 提出了PatEx-Gym框架，包括：1. PatEx-Bench：包含1K个审查任务、两个大规模检索语料库（1M+专利和5.2万篇科学论文）以及一个支持迭代搜索、文档访问、推理和审查意见书生成的运行环境。2. PASS：一个无标注的先艺术代理搜索轨迹合成框架，利用文档访问作为隐式相关性信号和证据获取锚点，来模拟查询行为、搜索进展以及轨迹层面的证据和结果质量，从而生成PatEx-SynData。3. PatEx-Agent：一个在PatEx-SynData上通过监督微调训练的4B参数模型，作为基线。
AI.result: 最终决策准确性并不能完全反映审查质量；即使是强大的前沿模型，发现先艺术仍然很困难。PatEx-Agent取得了与更大通用代理相比具有竞争力的性能。在PatEx-SynData上进行训练使得一个紧凑的4B模型能够作为先艺术搜索和专利审查的竞争性基准。
AI.conclusion: 专利审查是一个对代理搜索和深度研究代理要求很高的测试平台。通过在合成数据上训练，一个小型模型（如4B参数的PatEx-Agent）可以成为先艺术搜索和专利审查的有力基准。
AI.translation: 专利审查是一项具有挑战性的现实世界任务，需要代理发现稀疏的先艺术、迭代地改进查询、检查技术证据，并在跨越异构科学和技术领域的审查意见书中记录新颖性评估。然而，现有的基准主要关注静态和有限的候选集，使得整个搜索-推理-评估过程未得到充分探索。我们提出了PatEx-Gym，第一个用于开发和评估专利审查代理的框架，它集成了三个组成部分。首先，PatEx-Bench提供了1K个真实的审查任务、包含超过100万篇专利和5.2万篇科学论文的两个大规模检索语料库，以及支持迭代搜索、文档访问、推理和审查意见书生成的运行环境。其次，我们引入了PASS，一个无标注的先艺术代理搜索轨迹合成框架。具体来说，它利用文档访问作为隐式相关性信号和证据获取锚点，来模拟轮内查询行为、轮间搜索进展以及轨迹层面的证据和结果质量，从而生成PatEx-SynData。第三，我们在4B规模上通过在精心设计的轨迹上进行监督微调来训练PatEx-Agent，建立了一个轻量级的基线。广泛的实验表明，最终决策准确性本身并不能完全反映审查质量，而且即使对于强大的前沿模型来说，发现先艺术仍然很困难。我们的PatEx-Agent在与实质上更大的通用目的代理相比时，实现了具有竞争力的性能。这些结果表明，在PatEx-SynData上进行训练使得一个紧凑的4B模型能够作为先艺术搜索和专利审查的竞争性基准。我们将专利审查视为代理搜索和深度研究代理的一个要求很高的测试平台。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了PatEx-Gym，一个用于评估专利审查代理的新框架。该框架包括一个包含大量真实任务和数据的基准（PatEx-Bench），一个用于生成搜索轨迹数据的合成器（PASS），以及一个训练好的基线模型（PatEx-Agent）。实验结果表明，现有的模型在发现先艺术方面仍有困难，但PatEx-Gym框架能够训练出性能具有竞争力的模型，即使是较小的模型也能表现出色，并强调了评估专利审查的复杂性。
AI.keywords: 专利审查, 先艺术搜索, 代理框架, 新颖性评估, 合成数据
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一个创新的框架PatEx-Gym，解决了现有专利审查基准的局限性，即未能充分模拟真实的搜索-推理-评估过程。通过引入合成数据生成和评估新颖性，该框架为开发更强大的专利审查代理提供了坚实的基础。然而，未来研究可以进一步探索不同规模模型在真实世界场景中的泛化能力，以及如何更有效地整合不同类型的证据来提高审查质量。

title: FreqPKC: Frequency-Aware PeakConv for Radar Semantic Segmentation
summary: Automotive millimeter-wave (mmWave) radar has attracted increasing attention for semantic segmentation in autonomous driving, owing to its robustness under adverse weather and lighting conditions. Recent works have introduced radar-specific neural operators such as PeakConv (PKC), inspired by constant false alarm rate (CFAR) detection, to better model the peak-dominated characteristics of radar images. However, existing methods typically treat the guard bandwidth as learnable parameters, without explicitly characterizing the frequency response of the PKC operator. In this work, we revisit PKC from a frequency-domain perspective and propose Frequency-Aware PeakConv (FreqPKC), which explicitly models and exploits its underlying spectral characteristics. By analyzing the frequency response of PKC, FreqPKC enables the network to capture a broader range of frequency components and adaptively adjust its effective bandwidth. With the proposed Frequency-Aware (FA) module, the network can infer appropriate guard bandwidths to balance high- and low-frequency information: it enhances high-frequency components in target regions for more precise segmentation while suppressing noise through low-frequency filtering in background areas. Building on FreqPKC, we further develop FreqPKC-Net, a radar semantic segmentation (RSS) framework that integrates frequency-guided adaptive modulation with cross-view fusion for multi-view inputs, and can also be adapted to single-view data. Experiments on the public datasets CARRADA, CARRADA-RAC, and a self-built dataset named RS-SAR demonstrate that FreqPKC-Net consistently outperforms existing SoTA methods on both range-Doppler and range-angle views.

title: MimicAll: Structured Embodiment Conditioning for Cross-Humanoid Whole-Body Motion Tracking
summary: Humanoid motion trackers reproduce diverse behaviors, but sharing a policy across bodies requires accounting for differences in structure, morphology and dynamics. We present MimicAll, a reinforcement-learning framework for shared whole-body motion tracking across heterogeneous humanoids. A structured embodiment descriptor is encoded into global and joint-aligned conditions, which are combined with observation history and body-matched motion references to predict joint-target offsets. Physics-consistent embodiment randomization, body-calibrated retargeting and heterogeneous simulation support training across 4,096 variants from 16 humanoid families. We introduce a benchmark of 464 bodies across five distribution strata to evaluate motion generalization, within-family embodiment shifts and unseen-family transfer. Controlled ablations show that embodiment information improves motion completion with simple concatenation, while self-attention yields the lowest global position errors. With equal training transitions, shared training achieves 99.4% 30-second success on randomized G1 bodies in 100STYLE, versus 42.9% for a single-body specialist. With Flat-MLP encoding and concatenation, continued training on a motion subset excluding obstacle categories achieves 98.3% and 93.5% 30-second success on 100STYLE for sampled training bodies and out-of-distribution variants within seen families, respectively. On an eight-motion LAFAN1 subset excluding ground and get-up sequences across 464 bodies, mismatched body conditions reduce self-attention's 30-second success from 61.7% to 47.0%, demonstrating a closed-loop benefit from embodiment information.

AI.title_translation: MimicAll：用于跨人形机器人的全身运动跟踪的结构化具身条件
AI.tldr: MimicAll 是一个强化学习框架，可以通过结构化具身条件实现跨不同人形机器人的全身运动跟踪，提高了运动泛化能力和训练效率。
AI.motivation: 在跨不同结构、形态和动力学的人形机器人之间共享策略需要解决它们之间的差异。目前的运动跟踪方法在处理异构人形机器人时存在挑战。
AI.method: MimicAll 框架通过将结构化具身描述符编码为全局和关节对齐的条件，并结合观察历史和身体匹配的运动参考来预测关节目标偏移。该框架利用物理一致性具身随机化、身体校准重定向和异构模拟来支持跨 16 个人形机器人家族的 4,096 个变体的训练。
AI.result: MimicAll 在跨 4,096 个变体的 16 个人形机器人家族上进行了训练，并在 464 个身体的基准测试中进行了评估。结果表明，MimicAll 在运动泛化、家庭内部具身变化和未见过家庭迁移方面表现出色。与单身体专家相比，共享训练在随机 G1 身体上实现了 99.4% 的 30 秒成功率，而单身体专家仅为 42.9%。具身信息通过简单的连接提高了运动完成度，而自注意力机制则产生了最低的全局位置误差。
AI.conclusion: MimicAll 框架通过结构化具身条件有效地实现了跨异构人形机器人的全身运动跟踪，显著提高了运动泛化能力和训练效率，为未来人形机器人运动控制和仿真的研究提供了新的方向。
AI.translation: 人类运动跟踪器可以复制各种行为，但跨身体共享策略需要考虑结构、形态和动力学上的差异。我们提出了 MimicAll，一个用于跨异构人形机器人共享全身运动跟踪的强化学习框架。结构化具身描述符被编码为全局和关节对齐的条件，这些条件与观察历史和身体匹配的运动参考相结合，以预测关节目标偏移。物理一致性具身随机化、身体校准重定向和异构模拟支持跨 16 个人形机器人家族的 4,096 个变体的训练。我们引入了一个包含五个分布层级的 464 个身体的基准，以评估运动泛化、家庭内部具身变化和未见过家庭的迁移。受控的消融研究表明，具身信息通过简单的连接可以改善运动完成度，而自注意力机制可以产生最低的全局位置误差。在相同的训练转换下，共享训练在 100STYLE 的随机 G1 身体上实现了 99.4% 的 30 秒成功率，而单身体专家为 42.9%。使用 Flat-MLP 编码和连接，在排除障碍物类别的运动子集上继续训练，在 100STYLE 上对采样的训练身体和可见家庭中的未分布变体分别实现了 98.3% 和 93.5% 的 30 秒成功率。在排除地面和起身序列的八运动 LAFAN1 子集上，跨 464 个身体，不匹配的身体条件将自注意力的 30 秒成功率从 61.7% 降低到 47.0%，这表明具身信息具有闭环优势。
AI.summary: MimicAll 框架通过引入结构化具身条件，实现了跨异构人形机器人的全身运动跟踪。该方法通过编码具身信息并结合历史观察和运动参考来预测关节目标偏移，并在大规模模拟环境中进行了训练和评估。实验结果表明，MimicAll 显著提高了运动泛化能力，并优于单一身体的专业方法。
AI.keywords: MimicAll, 结构化具身条件, 跨人形机器人运动跟踪, 强化学习, 运动泛化
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种新颖的 MimicAll 框架，通过结构化具身条件解决了跨异构人形机器人的全身运动跟踪问题。该方法在处理不同机器人结构、形态和动力学差异方面具有显著优势，并在大规模模拟和基准测试中取得了优异的性能。研究结果表明，具身信息对于提高运动跟踪的泛化能力和鲁棒性至关重要。然而，该研究在实际应用中的部署和效率方面仍有待进一步探索。

title: Can Agentic Code Review Catch Vulnerabilities Before They Are Merged?
comments: 20 pages, 2 figures, 10 tables. Benchmark: https://github.com/secprbench/secprbench Results website: https://secprbench.github.io
summary: LLM agents have been increasingly adopted for security-focused code review, but existing benchmarks mostly derive the reviewed changes from their later fixes instead of the real-world bug-introducing commits. In this paper, we present SecPRBench, the first comprehensive benchmark for evaluating agentic security review on validated real-world code changes. More specifically, we have built an automated agentic pipeline to autonomously harvest, build, and validate massive real-world bug-introducing commits for popular software systems. To ensure precise evaluation, we also adopt LLM-as-a-judge to credit the findings matching ground-truth vulnerabilities. To date, we have collected 265 tasks from nine critical systems, including Firefox, V8, and OpenSSL with millions of lines of code. Across eight frontier models, recall ranges from 32.5% to 78.1%, with Grok 4.6 and GPT-6 sol ranking at the top. Our study also shows that most misses are not simply oversights: in 68% of them, the agent reports on a file that holds the flaw but argues for a different mechanism. Security-focused harnesses also behave differently: OpenAI's Codex Security lowers recall by 8.3 points, mostly by abstaining, while Anthropic's Defending Code harness raises it by 7.7 points, at a higher cost.
comment: 20 pages, 2 figures, 10 tables. Benchmark: https://github.com/secprbench/secprbench Results website: https://secprbench.github.io

title: DiffRouter: A Differentiable Routing Framework for UltraScale FPGAs
summary: Routing has become a major bottleneck in large-scale FPGA design flows, where traditional routers rely on sequential net-by-net processing and rip-up-reroute heuristics. This inherent sequentialism limits parallelism, leads to suboptimal utilization of routing resources, and significantly increases runtime on modern FPGAs. This paper introduces DiffRouter, the first differentiable, gradient-based FPGA routing framework with GPU acceleration. By lifting routing into a continuous optimization space, DiffRouter enables highly concurrent routing and improved global optimality before projecting solutions back onto the discrete fabric. The framework consists of three key stages: (1) Resource-pruned preprocessing, which extracts compact routing variables per net to reduce memory footprint and problem complexity; (2) Differentiable global routing via gradient descent, which formulates routing as a Lagrangian-relaxed optimization that minimizes wirelength while iteratively enforcing connectivity and congestion constraints as relaxed terms; and (3) Postprocessing, which maps the continuous wire distributions to a valid UltraScale routing solution and completes solutions by detailed routing. Experiments on the FPGA 2024 Routing Contest benchmarks show that DiffRouter outperforms state-of-the-art parallel routers, achieving over 5x speedup over RWRoute and 2x over Vivado, and running 18% faster than the state-of-the-art academic FPGA router Potter while delivering competitive critical path wirelength.

title: Towards a Learnable Retriever for Textual Graph Question Answering
summary: Textual graph question answering (GraphQA) and graph-based retrieval-augmented generation (GraphRAG) have gained increasing attention as a way to ground large language models (LLMs) on structured knowledge. Despite extensive efforts, existing methods still face two key gaps. The first is an architectural gap: existing methods typically fine-tune an LLM-based generator, but do not also make the retriever itself a learnable LLM for graph evidence selection within one end-to-end retrieve-then-generate pipeline. The second is a retrieval-supervision gap: existing retrievers rarely use gold answer signals to supervise evidence selection. As a result, they may fail to recall evidence nodes required for reasoning, resulting in insufficient coverage of the gold answer set; meanwhile, naive attempts to boost recall often introduce excessive irrelevant information that compromises compactness and overwhelms the LLM. To address these gaps, we propose TaLenT, an LLM-based end-to-end retriever-generator framework for textual GraphQA. To bridge the architectural gap, TaLenT pairs a learnable LLM-based retriever for evidence selection with a fine-tuned LLM-based generator within one unified retrieve-then-generate pipeline. To bridge the retrieval-supervision gap, we leverage gold answer signals as retriever supervision. Specifically, we stratify graph nodes into gold answers, answer-related nodes, and irrelevant noise. We then adopt a weighted pseudo-label loss to prioritize gold answers and preserve answer-related nodes for coverage, while discarding irrelevant noise for compactness. Experimental results across three GraphQA datasets demonstrate that TaLenT consistently improves downstream performance.

title: Eat Your Precision: Precision Objective Mitigates Reward Hacking in Rubric-based RL
summary: Rubric-based rewards enable effective reinforcement learning on non-verifiable tasks. However, because these rewards are typically defined as a weighted measure of rubric coverage, models are trained primarily to maximize a recall objective. As a result, RL-trained models produce responses that are more complete but also more verbose and contain more unnecessary or factually incorrect content, leading them to be less preferred than responses from the base model. To address this issue, we present the FORK reward, which jointly optimizes recall and a novel precision objective, which requires each unit of a model response to be both necessary and factually correct, as measured by rubric-driven necessity credits and a factual-correctness grader, respectively. Our experimental results show that FORK outperforms existing rubric-based RL methods and achieves Pareto-optimal performance that balances rubric coverage and overall response quality. Compared to the original recall-based reward, FORK substantially improves precision and reduces response length while achieving similar rubric coverage, which leads to significantly higher win rate compared to the base policy (e.g., from 10.6% to 68.0% on RubricHub-Medical and from 22.1% to 74.1% on HealthBench).

title: Overlap-Aware Sub-hypergraph Pattern Frequencies for Hypergraph-Level Classification
summary: Classifying whole hypergraphs requires a fixed-length description of inputs whose numbers of vertices and hyperedges vary. Frequent sub-hypergraph patterns provide such a description, but previous work records only whether each pattern is present, which loses two kinds of information: how large the overlap between two hyperedges is, and how much of a hypergraph each pattern makes up. We extend frequent sub-hypergraph mining with overlap labels, the binned intersection size of two pattern hyperedges inherited from the target hypergraph, and represent each hypergraph by the relative frequency of each mined pattern. The vocabulary is mined from training hypergraphs only and then frozen, and validation and test hypergraphs are matched against it. A support rule that depends on pattern size keeps the vocabulary small. On the six hypergraph-classification datasets of DHG-Bench, with a single configuration chosen on validation scores, the method has a higher mean Macro-F1 than the best published mean on five datasets, by 18.67 points on Twitter-Friend and 10.02 points on Steam-Player; on RHG-3 it is 0.21 points lower. Ablations show that on Steam-Player and Twitter-Friend, replacing relative frequencies with presence lowers Macro-F1 by about 18 points, and that removing overlap labels lowers it by 4 to 9 points.

title: Collective Collaboration of Recursive Autonomous Agents
summary: Smart factories must translate order-level objectives into production tasks at multiple scales and combine the capabilities of individual units into an overall delivery capability. To address repeated adaptation of organizational mechanisms across equipment, workshops, and factories, as well as coordination across levels under changing production conditions, this paper develops a framework for the collective collaboration of recursive autonomous agents (RAAs). A common task and capability interface supports the recursive decomposition of production objectives from the top down and the aggregation of conditional capabilities through peer collaboration from the bottom up. Composite units can therefore participate in higher-level organizations as agents of the same kind. We formulate organizational models for leaf and composite units, specify interface closure under composition and conditions for finite task expansion, and develop operational mechanisms linking task decomposition, resource commitments, result aggregation, and coordination within the scope affected by change. A production network integrating machining, inspection, and logistics across multiple workshops illustrates how a common organizational kernel is instantiated at the equipment-service, workshop, and factory scales. The framework connects recursive organization with explicit task responsibilities, capability conditions, and execution interfaces for manufacturing systems.

title: One Model, Two Paths: Balancing Single-Pass and Looped Performance in Language Models
summary: Repeating Transformer layers can improve language-model performance without adding parameters. A pretrained model can be adapted to support both single-pass and looped inference by reusing middle-layer weights for additional computation. Because both paths share weights, training to improve looped predictions can degrade single-pass quality. We study joint training strategies using weighted losses on both outputs, with guidance from the frozen original model. Joint supervision substantially reduces single-pass degradation compared to looped-only training, while preserving looped gains over ordinary continued training. Most of this benefit comes from adjusting the single-pass loss weight, with guidance from the frozen original model further improving the looped output. With validation-selected weights, our method preserves single-pass quality within a predefined tolerance of ordinary continued training while improving looped predictions.

title: Component Pooling Trained Across Orientations for Few-Shot Remote Sensing Scene Classification
summary: Few-shot remote sensing scene classification (FSRSSC) aims to recognize novel scene categories from only a few labeled images. Most FSRSSC methods summarize the feature map of an image by global average pooling, which treats the few objects that define an aerial scene and the large background around them alike, and they rarely consider that aerial images have no canonical orientation. To address these issues, we propose RoCoP, a parameter-free component pooling network trained across orientations. RoCoP consists of a feature extractor, a non-negative decomposition module (NDM) and a component scoring module (CSM). NDM factorizes the local descriptors of each image into a few additive components with a deterministic initialization and a single multiplicative update, so that the positions of one object are grouped together. CSM weights each component by its activation magnitude and converts the weights into a soft mask for pooling. Because both modules are invariant to permutations of feature positions, the only rotation-sensitive part of the pipeline is the backbone, which we train to classify randomly rotated views of every image. Experiments on NWPU-RESISC45, AID and UC Merced show that component pooling and rotated-view training are complementary: together they improve a strong transfer-learning baseline by about 2.5 points in 5-way 1-shot accuracy on NWPU-RESISC45 and AID, without adding parameters at inference. Under an identical protocol, RoCoP outperforms re-implemented metric-based and task-adaptive methods, and NDM and CSM also improve existing methods when plugged into them. We further identify the regime in which the method does not apply, namely very small base sets.

title: Promise and Limits of Cross-Architecture Knowledge Distillation for Lightweight Medical Vision Transformers (LiteMed-ViT)
comments: 6 pages, including references. Accepted at the International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Secure Communication Systems (ICICSCS 2026)
summary: Running deep models for medical image analysis at the point of care is challenging with standard architectures: convolutional neural networks (CNNs) are often too heavy for edge devices, while Vision Transformers (ViTs) require massive training datasets to compensate for missing inductive biases. This study investigates how far the dual-token distillation used to train data-efficient ViTs can be pushed when applied across architectures, from a CNN-based teacher into a lightweight ViT student. LiteMed-ViT is introduced as a dual-token ViT featuring a convolutional stem and a class-balanced distillation objective; at 0.234M parameters, LiteMed-ViT carries 47.8x fewer parameters than its ResNet18 teacher at a memory footprint of just 0.89 MB. Evaluated against three compact CNN baselines on three MedMNIST subsets of varying modality and class balance, LiteMed-ViT attains higher accuracy than all three baselines on BloodMNIST (95.05%) and two on PathMNIST (89.15%). Under MedMNIST-C corruptions, it is at least as robust as every compact CNN across all subsets, outperforming them on BloodMNIST and PathMNIST without declining in relative standing as severity increases. Particular attention is devoted to identifying the exact conditions where performance plateaus. On DermaMNIST, LiteMed-ViT's balanced accuracy remains up to 1.9 points below the strongest compact CNNs and does not benefit from higher input resolutions up to 224 pixels, where ResNet18 gains 12.6 points. Stronger teachers do not yield a more accurate student, and overconfident ones lower its DermaMNIST balanced accuracy unless calibrated.
comment: 6 pages, including references. Accepted at the International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Secure Communication Systems (ICICSCS 2026)

title: Communication Complexity of Integer Matrix Singularity
summary:
Alice and Bob hold complementary halves of the columns of an $n\times n$ matrix of $k$-bit integers and decide whether it is singular over $\mathbb Q$. Up to constant-factor dimension growth, this partitioned problem is equivalent to additive singularity, where Alice and Bob hold $n\times n$ matrices $A,B$ of $k$-bit integers and test the singularity of $A+B$ over $\mathbb Q$. We prove a bounded-error quantum lower bound $Ω(\min\{n^{3/2}\sqrt{k\log n},n^2\log(nk)\})$ and a randomized upper bound $O(n^2\min\{k,\log(k+\log n)\})$. The bounds match at $Θ(n^2\log(nk))$ for $k\ge n\log n$. The lower bound holds even under the promise of rank $n-1$ versus $n$. Its proof combines an integer witness with a local digit encoding, while the upper-bound protocol lifts modular kernel relations using short messages.
  Bitwise sharing changes how the communication complexity depends on the entry bit length $k$. If Alice and Bob instead hold $n\times n$ matrices $A,B$ of $k$-bit integers and test whether their entrywise bitwise XOR $A\oplus B$ is singular over $\mathbb Q$, we prove a quantum lower bound $Ω(n^2k)$, matching the trivial upper bound. This lower bound holds even under the promise of rank $n-1$ versus $n$. Our proof uses a dense weighted equation and a signed Fourier witness whose exceptional dyadic frequencies can be removed at small variation cost.

title: Optimizing Physical Neural Networks through Device Variable Selection
summary: Physical neural networks (PNNs) leverage device physics in electronics, optics, and related domains to enable energy-efficient neural networks. Broken-isomorphism PNNs replace linear operations with multivariate physical transformations, modifying how input signals are mapped to device variables. We exploit network architectures emerging from these mappings by treating the routing between signals and input variables of physical devices as trainable parameters. This approach expands device-level tunability of the physical transformations while, at the system level, demonstrating improved expressivity of PNNs with negligible additional inference overhead. This discrete routing is optimized by training a categorical distribution using Gumbel-Softmax reparametrization. We evaluate this approach using experimentally calibrated differentiable models of multivariate electronic RNPUs for MNIST and CIFAR-10 classification. Using variable selection, we improve the MNIST classification accuracy for a small CNN model from 94.5% to 96.9% and the accuracy of CIFAR-10 from 62.8% to 68.0%. Our method uniquely leverages the induced biases of broken-isomorphism PNN architectures, paving the way towards more efficient physics-based neural network inference.

title: Pacifo: An Efficient Fully Homomorphic Encryption-based Lightweight ResNet for Trustworthy Machine Learning as a Service
summary: Machine Learning as a Service (MLaaS) has become a popular paradigm for deploying AI applications. However, it raises significant privacy concerns that the raw client data needs to be uploaded to the server for inference services. Private inference using Fully Homomorphic Encryption (FHE) offers a solution by allowing computations directly on encrypted data, with only the final results decrypted on a client side. However, current practical implementations still suffer from large computational overhead and high latency due to the cost of FHE operations. In this paper, we propose Pacifo, a framework that adapts customized fine-tuning strategies to efficiently evaluate the ResNet20 model in the context of FHE. Specifically, Pacifo introduces a public-private layer partitioning scheme and an efficient ReLU approximation, significantly reducing the number of private layers and costly FHE operations during inference. It also offers flexible security configurations to accommodate varying client privacy requirements. Compared to state-of-the-art FHE implementations of ResNet20, Pacifo achieves a speedup of $3.7-21.7\times$ in runtime while effectively preserving $95\%-99\%$ of the original plaintext model accuracy across downstream tasks. Pacifo is open-sourced at https://github.com/BryceYangLi/Pacifo.

title: Security evaluation of 6G-oriented and O-RAN networks through targeted attacks
summary: The sixth generation (6G) of networks is supported by increased bandwidth, automation through the use of O-RAN technologies. Simultaneously though autonomous operation leads to an extensive threat surface and sophisticated attacks. Understanding the attack impact, the Tactics, Techniques and Procedures that are used by attackers is extremely challenging, but however is crucial for developing defense and mitigation strategies against them. This paper evaluates a targeted attack chain against a virtualized, 6G-oriented O-RAN testbed in which the F1 midhaul interface is accessible to an attacker and transport-layer protection is not enabled. The attack disrupts the legitimate O-DU association, introduces a rogue O-DU using observed configuration parameters, and intercepts user-plane traffic. The attack was evaluated in a fully virtualized testbed based on Open5GS, the srsRAN Project, FlexRIC, and an Electric Vehicle (EV) charging infrastructure based on OCPP 1.6.

title: Implicit Beliefs as Scalable Process Rewards for Strategic Persuasion
comments: NeurIPS 2026 Workshop (Large Language Models for Social Reasoning and Simulation)
summary: Training large language models (LLMs) for multi-turn strategic persuasion faces two coupled obstacles: (i) realistic simulation of psychologically grounded persuadees, and (ii) dense, faithful supervision for credit assignment in strategic dialogues. Outcome-only rewards are sparse and uninformative about which conversational moves drove success, while LLM-judge process rewards are expensive and decoupled from the underlying interaction dynamics. We address both challenges with a unified framework. First, we introduce PersuArena, a persuasion simulation environment that produces realistic, non-monotonic trajectories. Second, building directly on this environment, we propose Process Rewards via Online Belief Elicitation for Relative Policy Optimization (Probe-RPO), an online RL framework that converts the persuadee's internal state into dense process rewards. At each turn, three introspective probes are read from the frozen persuadee's logits, yielding a multi-dimensional reward signal that is faithfully aligned with persuasion dynamics. With extensive experiments on PersuArena spanning healthcare, financial advising, workplace management, education, and personal relationships, we demonstrate that our Probe-RPO achieves the full acceptance rate of 52.5%, compared with the 35.8% for the strongest GRPO ablation and 25.8% for the best off-the-shelf LLM. We also conduct comprehensive analyses on the generalization across persuadee models and the persuasion dynamics across conversations. Our work offers a promising paradigm that can provide effective process supervision for strategic dialogue.
comment: NeurIPS 2026 Workshop (Large Language Models for Social Reasoning and Simulation)

title: SkillShift-Bench: Benchmarking Skill Learning under Environment Evolution for Web Agents
comments: 70 pages, 8 figures. Accepted to EMNLP 2026 (Main Conference)
summary: Skill learning enables web agents to reuse prior experience for long-horizon interactive tasks. However, learned skills are typically evaluated in closed environments, overlooking the fact that real-world web deployment involves continuous shifts in invocation context, perceptual grounding, and execution feasibility. To this end, we introduce SkillShift-Bench, the first benchmark for evaluating skill learning with controlled open-environment shifts. SkillShift-Bench simulates Contextual Shift, Perceptual Shift, and Execution Shift across three self-hosted web systems, and evaluates agents with diagnostics covering task success, interaction cost, skill use, and skill failure. Comprehensive experiments reveal systematic robustness degradation under controlled shifts, characterized by lower success rates, higher interaction costs, and more frequent skill failures, with Execution Shift exerting the strongest pressure. We further formulate shifted skill execution as a nonstationary local executability problem and provide both a dynamic-regret analysis and a practical test-time adaptation method, demonstrating the feasibility of improving learned-skill execution without relearning the skill library. Code, tasks, environments, documentation, and the leaderboard are available at https://skillshift-bench.github.io/.
comment: 70 pages, 8 figures. Accepted to EMNLP 2026 (Main Conference)

title: Clustering of High-Dimensional Human Gene Score Data for Target Cell Classification
summary: The goal is to investigate whether the total human gene-score dataset and the selected human kinase-gene dataset exhibit the same number of clusters when analysed using the same set of 769 features. Two datasets were considered: the complete gene score dataset and a subset containing selected kinase genes. Two missing-data strategies were investigated. In Case I, rows containing missing gene-score values were removed. In Case II, rows with more than 20% missing values were excluded and the other missing values were replaced by the corresponding column mean. For each case, the data were scaled and principal component analysis (PCA) was performed before clustering. Four clustering approaches were considered: K-Means, Hierarchical Clustering, Fuzzy C-Means, and Graph-based Clustering. Across both datasets and both missing-data treatments, the optimal number of clusters was found to be two. In the absence of an optimal number of clusters, the quality of clustering was assessed using the Silhouette score. Relatively high Silhouette scores were obtained in all cases.

title: FraudSociety: A Generative Agent-Based Society for the Financial-Fraud Economy
summary: Financial fraud caused over \$15.9 billion in losses in the United States in 2025, according to the Federal Trade Commission~\citep{ftc2026databook}. Understanding such large-scale harm requires jointly modeling informational and financial dynamics. Yet existing simulators typically capture only one side of this interaction, leaving a gap in modeling how fraud unfolds in the real world. To bridge this gap, we introduce \textsc{FraudSociety}, the first LLM-agent-based simulator that jointly models these coupled dynamics. It integrates a dynamic social environment for information exposure and communication, persistent financial ledgers that preserve payment and loss histories, and a Need-Intent-Action architecture for civilian decision making. Fraudsters further adapt their communication and financial actions to individual interaction histories and ledger states, forming a closed feedback loop between the two dynamics. We validate \textsc{FraudSociety} across macro-level outcomes, micro-level behavior, and intervention effects. At the macro level, the simulated fraud outcomes closely match real-world patterns across multiple key statistics. At the micro level, it reproduces strong loss concentration, with the top 10\% of victimization records accounting for 81.1\% of total losses, consistent with Canadian Anti-Fraud Centre statistics~\citep{cafc2025annual}. Counter-fraud experiments further reveal variation across intervention strategies, with the best-performing personalized intervention reducing the repeat-payment rate from 49.4\% to 10.9\%. These results establish \textsc{FraudSociety} as both a high-fidelity simulator and a scalable testbed for evaluating anti-fraud strategies under diverse intervention conditions, thereby advancing research on financial fraud and its prevention.

title: An improved fast iterative moment method for the simulation of near-continuum gas flows with Shakhov model
summary: The fast iterative moment (FIM) method developed in [G. Li, C. Wang, and Z. Hu, Comput. Fluids, 311 (2026), 107031] achieves fast convergence for near-continuum gas flows modeled by the Boltzmann-BGK equation through alternating iterations between the high-order moment system and the consistent hydrodynamic equations. In this paper, we extend the FIM solver to the Shakhov model and improve it in the following aspects. A finite volume method with linear reconstruction is employed for high-resolution spatial discretization of both systems. Following the original FIM method, an implicit-explicit scheme treating the Shakhov collision term implicitly is adopted for the high-order moment system. A local Fourier analysis of a linearized one-dimensional BGK model reveals the need for more hydrodynamic iterations at smaller Knudsen numbers and their slower convergence on refined grids. Motivated by these findings, a Newton-multigrid method with a new regularization strategy is introduced for the hydrodynamic equations, generally providing an effective hydrodynamic correction with one step per alternating iteration, thereby reducing the need for empirical tuning. Numerical experiments for planar Couette flow, lid-driven cavity flow, and heat transfer in a bottom-heated cavity are carried out to investigate the performance of the improved FIM solver. The results demonstrate improved efficiency and robustness over the original FIM method, particularly at small Knudsen numbers, and favorable performance with both first- and second-order spatial discretizations.

title: Tokenised Sukuk: A Verifiable Architecture for Asset Evidence and Programmable Shariah Compliance
summary: Security-token standards such as ERC-3643 decide who may hold a token, not what stands behind it. For a sukuk this gap matters: whether a certificate may trade at a negotiated price depends on what its portfolio contains, and a token that checks only investor identity keeps trading after every non-debt asset has been sold. We ask whether this tradability condition can be enforced on-chain, and at what cost. We encode the tradability conditions of the 2023 resolution of the Shariah Advisory Council of the Securities Commission Malaysia on Sukuk Wakalah bi al-Istithmar as issuance and transfer policies that read EIP-712 claims, signed by separate institutional roles, about each asset's rights, valuation, encumbrance and Shariah classification and about the allocation of proceeds. Across 26 scenarios that we constructed on a synthetic instrument, an identity-only baseline wrongly allowed 13 operations that the encoded policy denies, and asset evidence without the Shariah rule still allowed 6. The full policy matched every expected outcome and added 35,834 gas (71.0%) per transfer, independent of portfolio size. Our evaluation also exposes a trade-off that the constructed scenarios had missed. Checking the continuing condition through a single nominated asset keeps the cost of a transfer constant but can block trades the ruling allows, and a bounded fallback scan narrows this gap at about 12,050 gas per scanned asset. Our results indicate that Shariah tradability conditions can be enforced on-chain against attributable asset evidence, and that the way a ruling is encoded shapes which lawful trades a token permits. GitHub repo: https://github.com/rischanlab/tokenized_sukuk

title: CoEvolve: Counterfactual-Guided Co-Evolution of Memory and Collaboration in Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems have demonstrated remarkable capabilities across diverse tasks. Yet their memory and collaboration architectures often remain static, constraining continued adaptation and improvement over time. Recent work addresses this limitation by evolving memory or collaboration based on interaction experience. However, updates to these interdependent components are not necessarily aligned: an evolved workflow may require experience that memory does not provide, while evolved memory may encode guidance that the workflow cannot use. To address this problem, we propose CoEvolve, a skill-centered framework for aligned memory--collaboration evolution. CoEvolve represents reusable local collaboration patterns as skills that link evolving collaboration decisions to their supporting memories. It further compares original and counterfactual trajectories to identify local evolution signals, which coordinate updates to the skill library, skill memory, and executor memories across rounds. Experiments on the ALFWorld and WebShop benchmarks confirm that CoEvolve achieves the best overall performance among the evaluated baselines, while ablation studies further validate the effectiveness of aligned co-evolution and counterfactual-guided evolution.

title: Patch-Derived or Register Tokens? Comparing Variable-Length Image Tokenizers
summary: Image tokenizers convert pixels into compact latent sequences for efficient generative modeling. Most approaches arrange latents on a downsampled two-dimensional grid, tying sequence length to image resolution. We compare two variable-length strategies: computationally efficient patch-derived tokens, which inherit explicit spatial organization, and more demanding register tokens, which have no predefined spatial layout. Our reconstruction results reveal that patch-derived tokens perform substantially better under extreme compression, whereas register tokens achieve slightly better reconstruction quality at intermediate budgets. At high token budgets, both approaches achieve similar reconstruction quality. For downstream generative tasks, register tokens outperform patch-derived tokens. Adding representation alignment with external pretrained visual encoders substantially improves the generative performance of patch-derived tokens, allowing them to match or outperform register tokens depending on the token budget. We further find that both approaches learn spatially localized representations. Patch-derived tokens largely retain their explicitly imposed spatial organization, while register tokens develop an implicit two-dimensional spatial structure despite having no predefined layout. Representation alignment reduces this spatial organizational constraint, enabling individual tokens to exert a stronger non-local influence.

title: SEDATE: Do Large Language Models Share an Aggression Circuit Across Languages?
summary: As the applications of AI continue to expand across various multimodal and multilingual domains, ensuring safe and responsible deployment of these systems has become an important concern. A wide-range of interventions have been proposed to make AI responses safer and more reliable. They often incur substantial computational or annotation costs, or cannot be extended to multilingual settings. In this work, we propose Selective Detection And Targeted Editing (SEDATE), a training-free approach based on detect-edit-verify strategy. SEDATE first detects the responsible neurons, edits them as and when necessary and finally verifies the model responses; all without any additional model training. We evaluate SEDATE across 7 languages and 4 model families. We further evaluate its effectiveness across 4 out-of-distribution languages and 4 additional datasets. We show that SEDATE achieves substantially superior safety scores across all languages and models over the best-performing baseline while retaining the general capabilities and incurring negligible overhead. Our results are robust, with the trends remaining similar for out-of-distribution languages and datasets.

title: Learning When to Collaborate: Selective Multi-Agent Medical Reasoning via Uncertainty-Aware Routing
summary: Multi-agent systems have emerged as a promising paradigm for multimodal medical reasoning, but existing methods rely on two assumptions that hinder practical deployment: (i) always-active dense collaboration among multiple agents, and (ii) dependence on large cloud-based models that raise privacy and efficiency concerns. In this paper, we challenge both assumptions and propose SMART-Med, a fully local multi-agent method that treats collaboration as a learnable decision rather than a default behavior. Our key insight is that not every medical query requires costly multi-agent deliberation: many can be reliably solved by a single well-trained agent, while only uncertain cases benefit from expert collaboration. Based on this insight, SMART-Med introduces an uncertainty-driven routing mechanism that adaptively decides when to answer directly and when to recruit a small subset of expert agents, effectively converting dense multi-agent reasoning into selective, query-adaptive coordination. To make this routing reliable, we curate a new multimodal medical dataset MedVR-3K with high-quality reasoning traces and a difficulty hierarchy, and then fine-tune local agents using GRPO with two complementary rewards: a certainty-aware accuracy reward and a vision-language reward model for correctness and reasoning quality respectively. Experiments on four medical visual question answering benchmarks show that SMART-Med achieves competitive performance compared to existing MAS approaches while substantially reducing inference cost (reducing inference time by more than 3.8x and token usage by 72%). Moreover, after fine-tuning on MedVR-3K, SMART-Med yields an average improvement of 6.7% across Slake, PathVQA, VQA-RAD, and PMC-VQA.

title: MOON: Learning When to Forget and How to Move On in Vision-and-Language Navigation
summary: Recent vision-and-language navigation (VLN) policies act on their visual history, and an incorrect action can take them off the instructed route. Paired interventions on four VLN policies show that clearing the history doubles pooled success at the onset of a deviation but lowers it on route, while later in a deviation, removing only the off-route frames helps much less. After a deviation, the retained history keeps the policy from turning where a turn is needed, which we call behavioral inertia. We propose MOON, a framework that equips a frozen VLN policy with two lightweight modules, adding less than 1% of its parameters. A deviation judge decides when to forget, raising an alarm that clears the history when it predicts that the agent is off route. A recovery policy, trained with GRPO from alarm states, learns how to move on, turning more of the successes found only by sampling into a single greedy rollout. Experiments on R2R-CE and RxR-CE show that MOON reaches the highest R2R-CE success rate among the compared methods and raises the success rate of its frozen base by 5.2 and 6.0 points, and an ablation with a random trigger indicates that this gain depends on when the history is cleared.
