title: Non-Vanishing Determinant Space-Time Codes from Abelian Crossed Product Algebras
summary: Every explicit non-cyclic crossed product space--time code for more than four antennas has relied on transcendental structure constants, and its coding gain is therefore not bounded away from zero. We explain this phenomenon and show how to avoid it. Over a number field, the commuting-generator (tensor product) construction yields a division algebra only in the cyclic case, and a division crossed product of prime-power degree requires two places with full decomposition group; in particular, no $(\Z/2)^r$, $r\ge3$, crossed product division algebra exists over $\Q(i)$. We then introduce Abelian crossed products with a commutator twist, give the general parametric form of their codewords as a $2\times2$ block matrix of cyclic-algebra codewords, and prove the division property with a centralizer argument and a tame norm-residue symbol. This yields algebraic codes over $\Q(i)$ with non-vanishing determinants and closed-form minimum determinants: an information-lossless $4\times4$ $(\Z/2)^2$ code with $δ_{\min}=1/2000$, and an infinite family of DMT-optimal $8\times8$ $\Z/4\times\Z/2$ codes indexed by primes $p\equiv5\pmod8$, whose commutator and cyclic constants are roots of unity. The member $p=5$, defined over $\Q(ζ_{40})$, has minimum determinant exactly $1/5$ before normalization, at least $34.7$ times that of the $8\times8$ perfect code at equal energy, and its rate-2 subcode for $8\times2$ systems has at least $5$ times the minimum determinant of the punctured perfect code. A determinant-spectrum analysis shows that at practical error rates the multiplicity of small determinants, rather than their minimum, governs performance, and it explains all simulated results.

title: BE-CTDE: Blockchain-Enabled Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning with Anomaly Detection and Token Economics
comments: 12 pages, 4 figures, 6 tables. Submitted to the IEEE Internet of Things Journal
summary: Multi-agent reinforcement learning supports cooperative decision-making in Internet of Things systems, but strategic deviations can disrupt coordination and undermine confidence in the training process. This paper proposes Blockchain-Enabled Centralized Training and Decentralized Execution (BE-CTDE), which uses blockchain as an active training-management layer. A behavioral verifier compares executed trajectories with shared-policy recommendations; its flags drive a token mechanism combining slashing, burning, rewards, and compensation. Retained balances determine each agent's contribution to the global policy update, connecting auditable behavior to learning influence. We derive a one-round incentive condition that accounts for action-dependent compensation and the payoff from deviation, and a finite expected exclusion-time bound under explicit conditional detection and accounting assumptions, showing perfect detection is unnecessary. An exact finite-population capacity bound characterizes the limits of the population-relative detector. In multi-agent path finding experiments, BE-CTDE outperforms a state-of-the-art learning-based path planner with substantially higher success rates under attack, even when adversaries form the majority. It also outperforms partially defended baselines in all configurations, with collision rates up to 35% lower than under detection without economic consequences and up to 43% lower than under conventional stake slashing. Together, these results characterize how behavioral verification and token feedback can support accountable cooperative learning.
comment: 12 pages, 4 figures, 6 tables. Submitted to the IEEE Internet of Things Journal

title: Enhancing Type 2 Diabetes Diagnosis with Evolutionary Algorithms and Machine Learning
summary: Type 2 diabetes is a widespread chronic disease that requires early and accurate diagnosis to prevent serious complications. Traditional diagnostic methods often lack sufficient accuracy, which highlights the need for more reliable computational solutions. In this study, we propose a model that integrates the Random Forest classifier with the Bat Optimization Algorithm for simultaneous feature selection and hyperparameter tuning. The SMOTE-ENN method was first applied to the Pima Indians Diabetes Database to correct class imbalance and remove noisy or ambiguous samples, producing a more balanced and cleaner dataset. The optimized model trained on this refined dataset achieved 89% accuracy, 88% precision, 90% recall, and an F1-score of 89%, clearly outperforming the baseline Random Forest and other existing approaches. These results demonstrate the potential of combining evolutionary algorithms with ensemble learning to provide a practical and cost-effective tool for early detection of type 2 diabetes in clinical practice.

title: Decision-Native Recommendation with Large Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) bring world knowledge to user preference modeling in sequential recommendation, but generation-based recommenders express next-item predictions indirectly as text. Generated outputs may fail to identify a unique candidate item, depend on candidate presentation order in the prompt, and lack explicit confidence in the recommendation. Recent studies explore Jev, a model for fast option selection with explicit confidence. Inspired by Jev, we introduce decision-native recommendation, a new paradigm that jointly models item choice and recommendation confidence using LLM representations. It requires valid candidate selection, consistency under candidate reordering, and confidence that reflects recommendation accuracy. We propose Direct Item Choice Estimation (DICE), which learns a personalized next-item distribution over supplied candidates from user interaction history and recommends the highest-scoring item with calibrated confidence. Tree-structured attention shares history computation across isolated candidate branches for order-consistent candidate scoring in a single forward pass. On three recommendation datasets, DICE achieves higher top-one accuracy than all evaluated baselines. Separate evaluations show unchanged item choices under tested candidate reorderings and end-to-end speedups of up to approximately $6\times$ over the evaluated generation-based methods. Its confidence estimates support selective recommendation by identifying more reliable predictions and guide additional computation for low-confidence examples in offline routing.

title: HumanoidNDM: Closing the Training-Deployment Gap of Motion Tracking via Humanoid Neural Dynamics Model
summary: Humanoid robots have recently achieved remarkable success in motion tracking. However, during real-world deployment, robots inevitably encounter dynamics gaps arising from either extra physical disturbances or inaccurate simulation modeling, resulting in a significant training-deployment gap. Therefore, effectively leveraging real-world data to fine-tune policies represents the crucial last mile for robust deployment. To bridge this gap, we propose HumanoidNDM, an online fine-tuning framework for humanoid motion tracking driven by a real-world-trained neural dynamics model. First, in the data collection stage, we introduce a low-frequency reference perturbation method with an adaptive intensity mechanism, balancing deployment feasibility and exploration efficiency. Second, for the model training stage, we train a robust history-based, proprioceptive neural dynamics model in Euclidean space by incorporating differentiable forward kinematics, eliminating the reliance on costly motion capture systems. Finally, in the policy fine-tuning stage, we directly fine-tune the policy via backpropagated model gradients, achieving high data efficiency. Through physical validation on the Unitree G1 robot, we demonstrate that HumanoidNDM enables rapid real-world adaptation to various perturbations, representing the first online, MoCap-free fine-tuning framework for humanoid tracking policies.

title: Bug Severity Classification with Fine-Tuned Open LLMs: A Paired Comparison with TF-IDF and CodeBERT Baselines on Eclipse Reports
comments: 17 pages, 5 figures, 8 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/tbayan/bug_finetuning_llm_artifacts
summary: Open large language models (LLMs) small enough to run on a laptop are an obvious candidate for automatic bug severity prediction. We measure what they add over cheaper classifiers on one task: assigning one of four Bugzilla severity levels (Critical, Major, Minor, Trivial) to Eclipse bug reports. From a public dump of 361,006 unique Eclipse reports we draw a class-balanced sample of 20,000 rows and compare eleven configurations of nine model types: six TF-IDF classifiers, a fine-tuned CodeBERT encoder, and Llama 3 8B and Qwen 2.5 7B, each run zero-shot and after QLoRA fine-tuning. All eleven are scored on the same 2,000 held-out reports, with bootstrap intervals and McNemar tests. The zero-shot runs reach macro-F1 0.305 and 0.321, below every TF-IDF model (0.430-0.489). The fine-tuned runs reach 0.526 and 0.485, but the zero-shot and fine-tuned setups also differ in checkpoint, serving runtime and decoding, so this gap cannot be credited to fine-tuning alone. Fine-tuned Llama 3 shows no detectable difference from CodeBERT (0.518; difference +0.007, 95% CI -0.017 to +0.032), and fine-tuned Qwen 2.5 is below it on macro-F1. The models differ more by class than in aggregate: fine-tuned Llama 3 finds 36% of Critical reports, Qwen 2.5 finds 69% but only 21% of Minor ones. The dump repeats 60,000 rows, and 8% of the test reports duplicate a training report; removing them lowers TF-IDF scores by up to 0.031 and leaves the LLMs almost unchanged. We release split identifiers, per-report predictions and the analysis script at https://github.com/tbayan/bug_finetuning_llm_artifacts, together with CyberTriage, a tool that serves the fine-tuned classifier locally.

title: Semantic-Coupled Perception Framework for Autonomous Laparoscope Control
comments: 8 pages, 5 figures. Submitted to IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L) for possible publication
summary: In minimally invasive surgery (MIS), maintaining an appropriate field of view (FoV) is essential for surgical safety and efficiency. However, conventional autonomous laparoscope control methods often treat visual tracking and surgical phase recognition independently, limiting robustness under occlusion, entity overlap, and camera motion. This paper proposes a closed-loop autonomous laparoscope control framework that couples real-time surgical phase recognition with camera-motion-compensated visual perception. By exploiting phase-dependent relationships among surgical entities, the framework improves target state estimation under challenging visual conditions, supporting task-aware autonomous FoV control. Experiments on benchmark datasets evaluate the proposed framework in surgical phase recognition and target tracking, including scenarios involving occlusion and entity overlap. Phantom experiments further demonstrate the feasibility of autonomous FoV control, showing improved target visibility and task execution performance compared with fixed-FoV control. These results highlight the potential of incorporating task-level semantics into visual state estimation for autonomous laparoscope guidance.
comment: 8 pages, 5 figures. Submitted to IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L) for possible publication

title: StickFigure: Enabling Pose-Only IoT Cameras for Privacy-Preserving Edge Vision
summary: Indoor IoT cameras can support assisted living and activity-aware spaces, but exporting raw RGB frames raises privacy concerns by exposing facial, clothing, and household details that body-motion tasks often do not require. We present StickFigure, a pose-only IoT camera system that, during real-time monitoring, keeps raw frames local and ephemeral while exporting only compact skeleton streams sufficient for downstream human activity recognition (HAR). While pose estimation has matured on GPUs, extracting accurate pose streams on resource-constrained IoT cameras remains difficult. To overcome these challenges and enable on-device pose streams on (almost) any IoT camera, we present two core designs in StickFigure: an activation-aware pose backbone that allocates channel capacity after spatial downsampling and a lightweight hierarchical MLP refiner that selectively corrects elbow and wrist coordinates using intermediate visual features and kinematic context. We fully implement StickFigure and evaluate it on public benchmarks and real-world deployment. Compared with state-of-the-art MCU pose models, StickFigure achieves the highest pose accuracy and downstream HAR utility on both NTU RGB+D and Penn Action, while using 96.5% fewer parameters and 99.3% fewer MACs per frame than RTMPose-S-based baselines, achieving 0.107 s p95 latency on a representative STM32H753 MCU. We believe StickFigure establishes a new operating point for privacy-aware edge vision on massive IoT cameras.

title: Self-Evolution Reasoner: Continuous Optimization via Policy-Intrinsic Exploration and Exploitation
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) enables large language models (LLMs) to continuously self-improve their reasoning capabilities. Compared to RLVR's scalar rewards, recent self-supervised on-policy distillation methods leverage denser supervision signals. However, both paradigms suffer from exploration bottlenecks, struggling to escape local optima when the policy fails to sample valid solutions. Relying on external demonstrations can bypass this issue; however, the off-policy nature hinders genuine self-improvement and the mismatched-distribution reasoning can not be fully exploited. In this work, we propose Self-Evolution Policy Optimization (SEPO), a framework that drives continuous reasoning capability evolution via guided exploration and in-distribution exploitation. Specifically, SEPO utilizes labels to elicit correct reasoning from the policy, unlocking the exploration potential. By treating current policy conditioned on this in-distribution reasoning as a self-teacher, SEPO distills the newly discovered solution back into the policy. Through this iterative cycle of policy-intrinsic exploration and exploitation, SEPO achieves robust and continuous capability evolution. Across scientific, tool-use, and complex logical reasoning domains, SEPO consistently achieves the best performance under identical training time or steps, demonstrating superior efficiency and convergence ceilings. Notably, SEPO maintains stable improvements even in scenarios where baselines severely underperform or fail entirely, such as on complex tasks or with small-scale models. Our code is available at https://github.com/Eric8932/SEPO.

title: Convergence Analysis of Variable-Separation-Based Model Reduction for Linear Parametric Partial Differential Equations
summary: This paper analyzes the convergence of a variable-separation (VS) model reduction method that successively constructs separated approximations to the solutions of linear parametric partial differential equations (PDEs) by solving residual problems at sampled parameter values. We prove that the resulting VS approximations converge almost surely to the exact parametric solution in the parameter-averaged energy norm, under finite-dimensional approximation conditions on the error family and the assumptions of symmetry, uniform coercivity, and uniform boundedness of the governing bilinear forms. For parametric PDEs whose operators and right-hand sides admit finite-term separated representations, we construct finite-dimensional approximation spaces for the error family and bound their dimensions and approximation errors, thereby verifying these approximation conditions and obtaining an $O((\log N)^{-1})$ upper bound for the expected parameter-averaged error energy after $N$ iterations. When the solution families are contained in a fixed finite-dimensional space, we obtain the sharper $O(N^{-1})$ bound for the expected error energy and, if the operator is also parameter-independent, exact recovery for almost every parameter after an almost surely finite number of iterations. Numerical experiments illustrate the error decay of the VS approximations, as well as finite-step recovery in the parameter-independent case.

title: Decoupled Prune-and-Reconstruct: Training on a Compact Core with Double-Layer Sparsification
summary: On million-node graphs, the memory wall arrives before the compute wall: a GNN that never fits in VRAM cannot deliver the all-node inference its accuracy promises. The standard remedy, pruning, has always been an accuracy tax - paid once and never refunded. DPR refuses this framing. Its central insight is that the mask that shrinks training can also scaffold recovery: one compact node set bounds both computations of graph learning, serving as the encoder's training graph and, at inference, as the anchor from which a sparse structure-aware decoder rebuilds every pruned node (double-layer sparsification). The order is inverted - prune for efficiency, then reconstruct for accuracy - and the tax is repaid: the deployed 30%-budget model trains in 1,450 MiB of peak memory on one 6 GB GPU and recovers 96.9% of its dense-reconstruction reference, beating a same-GPU rerun of the edge-sparsification baseline DSpar by +1.36 pp at 50.1% lower peak training memory; against the same-protocol full-batch no-prune encoder the deployed point pays a measured 2.64 pp accuracy tax for a 2.8x smaller training footprint. Pruning without reconstruction leaves the encoder at 0.378 within the same 40-epoch window (Fig. 4), and all-node serving runs 46x faster than sampling-based GraphSAGE, giving up approx. 5.4 pp of test accuracy. The framework scales to a 2.45M-node production graph at 6,285 MiB of peak training memory; extended variants (long-range context, external text features, a CAN-bus application) are reported as extensions and do not compete with the deployed method, and the 41.8%-budget M4 point, scored on a coarsened super-node graph with its own split, is reported separately rather than compared with the original-node baselines. DPR thus turns aggressive node pruning from an accuracy tax into a safe training accelerator for VRAM-limited all-node inference.

title: SpeC2Rust: Specification-Driven Repository-Level C-to-Rust Translation
summary: Legacy C codebases remain central to system software and performance-critical infrastructure, but their weak memory safety imposes security and maintenance risks. Recent C-to-Rust translation systems, including LLM-based translators, make automated migration increasingly feasible, yet they still struggle to recover repository-level intent, avoid raw pointers and unsafe constructs, maintain cross-file interfaces, and repair compilation and validation failures efficiently. We propose SpeC2Rust, a specification-driven pipeline for repository-level C-to-Rust translation. It has three stages: (1) Project-Intent Structuring, which decomposes a C repository into semantically coherent modules and generates persistent repository- and module-level specifications; (2) Spec-Guided Generation, which translates each Rust module against these specifications with a live symbol registry to preserve cross-file consistency; and (3) Layered-Feedback Repair, which batches repairs and injects only failure-relevant diagnostics, specification context, and source evidence for efficient compilation and test-driven correction. We evaluate SpeC2Rust on eight repository-level C projects. It generates Rust projects that compile and pass the original end-to-end tests, with no raw-pointer declarations, raw-pointer dereferences, or unsafe lines. On projects shared with an LLM-based baseline, SpeC2Rust reduces cost by 66.1% and input-token usage by 84.7%.

title: Early Selection of Polar Ensemble Decoding with Successive Cancellation Style Component Decoder
summary: Parallel ensembles of successive cancellation (SC)-style decoders improve error-rate performance by decoding multiple representations of the received vector. Conventional ensembles, however, keep every member active until completion. To reduce computational cost while retaining the diversity gain of ensemble decoding, we propose early ensemble selection (EES), which ranks members using intermediate decoding states and retains a prescribed numbers of members at each predefined selection stage. Within the EES framework, we propose two selection rules, namely path-metric-based selection (PM-EES) and neural-network-based selection (NN-EES). We analytically characterize the computational cost of EES through stage-dependent decoder log-likelihood ratio (LLR) update counts and provide an information-theoretically motivated criterion for choosing selection stages. Simulations on the \((128,64)\) extended BCH code and the \(\operatorname{RM}(4,8)\) code show that suitable selection schedules approach full-ensemble error-rate performance with fewer decoder LLR updates.

title: Reversion, Retention, and Semantic Intervention: Measuring Functional Content in CLIP Fine-Tuning Deltas
comments: 20 pages. Accepted for publication in Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR)
summary: Fine-tuning adapts pretrained models to new tasks, but identifying which weight changes support the resulting behavior remains difficult. Weight-space interpretability assigns semantic descriptions to these changes, called fine-tuning deltas. Such descriptions leave open how much task performance depends on the identified updates, particularly when other updates can support the same predictions. We address this gap by pairing reversion, which restores selected parameters to their pretrained values, with retention, which keeps only selected fine-tuning updates. We evaluate Contrastive Language-Image Pretraining (CLIP) models on synthetic financial charts, Flowers102, EuroSAT, and FGVCAircraft with ViT-L/14, and on Flowers102 with ViT-B/16, using a shared recipe that tunes the final six visual blocks. Our contributions are threefold. First, attention value-output (VO) updates alone recover 43-87% of the accuracy improvement, although reverting them leaves chart accuracy unchanged. Cross-entropy loss preserves this contrast on Charts and EuroSAT, while correct-class score margins reveal additional contributions. Second, VO weights recover more loss improvement than all ten equally sized, layer-matched random subsets in each setting. VO and multilayer perceptron (MLP) retentions jointly correct 25-81% of pretrained errors, demonstrating overlapping recovered behavior, which we call operational redundancy. Third, removing semantically selected directions reduces VO-retained recovery more than matched-random removal in all five settings. Together, these results distinguish semantic alignment, removal cost, and retained recovery as complementary evidence about the functional role of fine-tuning updates within the evaluated CLIP recipe.
comment: 20 pages. Accepted for publication in Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR)

title: Rethinking Retrieval in the Long-Context Era: Training-Free Semantic Trees for Adaptive Context Construction
summary: Long-context language models can increasingly process entire documents, making full-context prompting a practical alternative to passage retrieval. However, greater capacity determines how much information a model can receive, but not which information best supports a query. This distinction motivates rethinking retrieval: when the full document already fits, can selecting and organizing its evidence improve answering? The challenge is to retain supporting facts and relations while keeping the context focused on the question. To reconcile these goals, we introduce \ours, a training-free framework that uses semantic abstraction to guide selection while retaining original text for answering. \ours constructs a reusable semantic hierarchy from the full document in a single generation, linking node descriptions to source spans. Given a query, structural--semantic scoring and fine-grained lexical attribution nominate shared source nodes; their union with ancestor context preserves structural relations and complete local text. Across four frontier answer models, \ours improves average QA-F1 by 1.72 points over full-context prompting on three LongBench tasks, surpassing the evaluated baselines on the four-model average while reducing answer-context length by 58.55\%. Our code is available at the $\href{https://anonymous.4open.science/r/treefuse-ECFE}{repository}$.

title: PS-DLO: Property- and Spatially Aware Deformable Linear Object Manipulation Policy
summary: Deformable linear objects (DLO) pose a coupled perception and control challenge: their slender geometry makes precise localization difficult, while their deformations depend on object-specific physical properties. To address this challenge, we propose PS-DLO, a property- and spatially aware DLO manipulation policy. First, contrastive image-text learning maps the initial observation to categorical descriptions of DLO properties, providing explicit physical and structural priors for action generation. Second, SAM3 extracts mask-guided features from future observations, which are distilled into the policy's action expert to encode task-relevant DLO regions and their subsequent configurations. We evaluate PS-DLO on nine real-world tasks across single-arm and bimanual platforms, training a shared multi-task policy for each embodiment. PS-DLO achieves an average success rate of 68.9%, exceeding the strongest baseline by 20.0 percentage points. In generalization experiments, PS-DLO achieves higher success rates than the baseline in six of seven visual-shift conditions on butterfly-knot untying. These results demonstrate that combining object-property priors with future spatial supervision improves multi-task DLO manipulation and robustness to visual variation.

title: MuSTEL: A Large-Scale Multilingual Synthetic Text-Line Image Dataset for OCR
summary: Optical character recognition (OCR) systems depend strongly on the scale and diversity of their training data. One approach to document OCR first analyzes the page layout and extracts text-line images, which are then transcribed by a recognition model. Multilingual line-level recognition involving Persian, Arabic, and English presents additional challenges because different writing directions, fonts, and styles may coexist within a single line. This paper introduces MuSTEL, a large-scale synthetic multilingual OCR dataset containing more than 14.5 million annotated text-line images, organized into a training partition and predefined small and large test sets. Samples are generated from natural-language corpora, including multilingual content already present in the source texts. The generation framework incorporates capability-aware font selection, within-line font and style changes, mixed-direction text rendering, highlighting, and underlining. A validated repository of 2,009 font files from 711 families supports broad typographic coverage, while varied backgrounds, blur, geometric distortion, skew, stroke width, and image save quality provide diverse document-like appearances. Statistical analysis characterizes the dataset's language composition, transcription lengths, lexical and character-sequence diversity, image dimensions, typography, and rendering conditions. MuSTEL provides a resource for training and evaluating multilingual line-level OCR systems and investigating recognition robustness across languages, writing directions, and visual conditions.

title: Humans in Space: Can MLLMs Construct Human-Centric Spatial Understanding via Active Exocentric Exploration?
comments: Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision (WACV) 2027. 33 pages, 14 figures, and 23 tables
summary: While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) excel at zero-shot reasoning, their spatial capabilities are primarily evaluated through static, passive observation. In complex, human-centric scenes, occlusion often hides crucial geometric evidence, and passive benchmarks force models to guess rather than recognize their own visual uncertainty. To bridge this gap, we introduce SATE-Bench, a novel interactive benchmark comprising 316 real-world scenes and 2,525 multi-turn QA pairs to evaluate visual self-awareness and active exocentric view-exploration. It combines a Passive multi-view control with an Active exploration setting, where models start from a severely occluded view and must iteratively query adjacent viewpoints until they gather enough evidence to fully ``sate'' the question, scored by a step-penalized efficiency reward. Evaluating state-of-the-art MLLMs reveals that they terminate exploration prematurely while reporting high confidence, and struggle with fine-grained 3D geometric tasks; matched-view controls further attribute the Active--Passive gap primarily to insufficient evidence acquisition. Moreover, fine-tuning with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) shows that rewarding view-seeking increases active exploration but lowers overall accuracy, as models over-explore and fail to fuse expanding multi-view contexts across turns. These findings indicate that scaling passive multi-view perception does not intrinsically yield active spatial reasoning, highlighting the need for models that know where to look, how to integrate what they see, and when to stop. Code and data are available at https://gtc-gh.github.io/SATE-Bench/
comment: Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision (WACV) 2027. 33 pages, 14 figures, and 23 tables

title: Execution Logs Sway VLM Judges of Robot Progress
summary: Vision-language models now grade robot videos, and text placed beside the frames can change their verdicts. On clips where the robot is losing progress, we add one log line saying the robot is making progress. Across Gemini, Qwen and GPT judges, this flips correct verdicts to progress 10 to 35 percentage points more often than a neutral line does. A one-line warning that the log may be wrong removes most of this effect. Selected fake "task complete" claims flip half of Qwen's correct verdicts, against a tenth for unrelated log lines. They have no detectable effect on Gemini.

title: Edge-Centric Adaptive Neural Activation via Parametric Tanh Functions
summary: Within the broader landscape of artificial intelligence architectures, this paper introduces a compact, edge-centric neural framework that resolves the computational bottlenecks of modern edge-activated paradigms like Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) while retaining their expressiveness over traditional Multi-Layer Perceptrons (MLPs). While KANs demonstrate remarkable representational capacity by placing learnable univariate functions on connection edges rather than hidden nodes, their reliance on non-local B-splines introduces severe optimization hurdles, high memory overhead, and poor hardware scaling. To bridge this gap, we propose the Parametric Tanh Connection Function, a smooth, bounded architectural primitive defined as $a_{\tanh}(x;δ,α,β,γ) = δ+ α\tanh(βx + γ)$. This formulation unifies offset, amplitude, local slope, and horizontal displacement into a lightweight, 4-parameter differentiable mapping optimized edge-by-edge via backpropagation. Evaluated on dense architectures using MNIST and CIFAR-10, our parametric tanh connection model achieves significant absolute accuracy gains over traditional affine baselines-reaching 95.63% $\pm$ 0.08% on MNIST and 44.74% $\pm$ 0.18% on CIFAR-10. Crucially, it matches or exceeds the expressiveness of unconstrained 7-parameter exponential connection baselines while requiring up to 85% less training runtime. By replacing complex splines or hyper-flexible exponents with a bounded, analytically smooth hyperbolic tangent kernel, this work delivers a highly scalable, hardware-friendly compromise for heterogeneous connection-level deep learning.

title: ASR-Protected Fusion and Reference-Anchored Policy Optimization for Joint ASR and Word-Level Speech Anti-Spoofing
summary: Existing anti-spoofing systems report either an utterance-level score or a time-based spoof interval: the former cannot show which words are spoofed, while the latter does not directly match the transcript and must be post-aligned with words, so alignment errors can lead to wrong word-level labels. Standard ASR model outputs only text; spoof information in the audio is lost after recognition and is not passed with the transcript. Yet changing only a few words can change the meaning of a sentence, leaving downstream systems to use incorrect text without knowing which words are spoofed. We therefore treat partial anti-spoofing as tagged ASR: the model transcribes speech and marks spoofed words at the same time, directly linking spoof labels to output words. We adopt the audio LLM and use ASR-Protected Subspace Gated Fusion (APSGF) to fuse spoof cues with ASR features. Spoof cues are added only outside an ASR-protected subspace, so they do not disturb recognition features. After cross-entropy training, we fine-tune the model with Reference-Anchored Policy Optimization (RAPO). Since the SFT policy is already concentrated, multiple samples from the same input tend to receive similar rewards, resulting in weak group-wise advantages. RAPO instead generates a single sample with low sampling randomness and anchors its advantage to the reward of a reference model. This allows the model to reinforce responses that outperform the reference while suppressing those that underperform it. Experiments on five datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach in jointly detecting spoofed words and preserving ASR accuracy. The code is publicly available.

title: LoopGR: Parameter-Efficient Scaling for Generative Recommendation via Recurrent Depth
summary: Generative recommendation formulates item recommendation as autoregressive generation rather than a discriminative scoring problem. Although empirical studies exhibit favorable scaling behavior in recommendation, unleashing the benefits of scaling remains challenging under the strict model size and inference cost constraints of real-world systems. A central challenge is to combine expressive modeling of user-item interaction histories with flexible computational depth without proportionally increasing model size. We introduce LoopGR, a parameter-efficient scaling framework for generative recommendation via recurrent depth. LoopGR employs a tailored hierarchical recurrent depth mechanism that alternates between a shared generative decoder and a lightweight context updater. For efficient inference, we further develop recurrent trajectory self-distillation that distills a low-budget student from a high-budget teacher by aligning both predictive distributions and evolution directions. Extensive experiments show that LoopGR consistently outperforms strong generative recommendation baselines. Compared with a representative encoder-decoder baseline, LoopGR achieves superior performance while reducing model size by up to 52%. These results establish recurrent depth as a new scaling dimension, offering a flexible and resource-efficient scaling path for generative recommendation.

title: Last-Iterate Stationarity of Muon with Finitely Many Newton-Schulz Iterations
summary:
Muon has achieved strong empirical performance in large-scale language-model training, motivating a better theoretical understanding of its practical implementation. Unlike the idealized polar-factor update, practical Muon uses a fixed number of quintic Newton--Schulz iterations. Existing analyses mainly establish average- or best-iterate stationarity guarantees, leaving last-iterate convergence less understood. We study last-iterate gradient convergence of practical finite-step Muon on smooth, lower-bounded nonconvex objectives.
  For deterministic gradients, we show that without input stabilization, Muon can cycle even on a smooth convex quadratic. With positive stabilization, we establish last-iterate gradient convergence for any fixed momentum coefficient below one and a sufficiently small constant learning rate, together with square-summability of gradients. For stochastic gradients, we first show that persistent bounded, unbiased noise can prevent convergence with fixed learning rates and momentum, even with positive stabilization. We then establish almost-sure and mean-square last-iterate gradient convergence by combining decreasing learning rates with increasing momentum under bounded-variance stochastic gradients. Finally, we construct a smooth counterexample showing that neither convergence theorem guarantees a pointwise polynomial rate. We further establish density-one convergence rates, guaranteeing polynomial gradient decay for all but a vanishing fraction of iterations.

title: Single-Cycle Battery Remaining Useful Life Prediction with Compressed Continuous Wavelet Features and Deep Neural Networks
summary: Lithium-ion batteries are widely used in industrial applications, but their performance gradually degrades over time, making accurate lifetime prediction important for safety and reliability. However, reliable lifetime assessment generally requires extensive degradation testing, which is both costly and time-consuming. To reduce this burden, recent data-driven approaches have sought to predict the end-of-life cycle of batteries from only the initial few cycles. Nevertheless, identifying reliable degradation patterns from such limited early-cycle data remains challenging because early aging dynamics are often subtle and nonlinear. To address this issue, we adopt the continuous wavelet transform to convert cycle-wise voltage, current, and capacity signals into time-frequency representations, enabling multi-resolution characterization of degradation behavior. Building on this representation, we apply scale compression to reduce redundancy while preserving structural information in the scalograms. We evaluate the proposed framework on eight benchmark datasets derived from seven public battery datasets covering diverse electrode chemistries, cell form factors, and cycling protocols. Experimental results show that the proposed framework consistently outperforms prior approaches in single-cycle remaining useful life prediction and remains robust as the number of input cycles increases from 1 to 100. In addition, redundancy-fidelity analysis characterizes the trade-off introduced by scale compression, and gradient-based visual explanations indicate that the model focuses on localized time-frequency regions associated with structured signal transitions during charge-discharge operation. These results demonstrate the effectiveness and interpretability of the proposed framework for early-cycle battery remaining useful life prediction.

title: MMFact: Simplifying Multimodal Misinformation Detection with Shared Resources and Tools
summary: Multimodal misinformation detection methods often rely on different preprocessing pipelines and auxiliary resources, making experimental comparisons difficult to interpret. We present MMFact, a collection of shared resources and tools that simplifies this research workflow. It brings together 47 detector implementations and baselines, three multimodal datasets, and prepared materials ranging from semantic features to OCR, image descriptions, and external evidence. Compatible methods can use the same materials, reducing variation introduced by preprocessing and supporting fairer comparisons. A modular training and evaluation framework preserves method-specific designs while providing common experimental procedures. By treating prepared materials as a shared research resource, MMFact helps researchers focus on developing and evaluating detection methods.

title: Reinforcement Learning for Adaptive Crowd Flow Control Using Dynamic Barriers
comments: An earlier version was presented at the 26th Scientific Forum for Hajj, Umrah and Visit Research, Umm Al-Qura University (2026)
summary: Crowd barriers are widely used to regulate pedestrian movement during large public events such as pilgrimages. However, fixed barrier layouts often create unnecessary stopping and local congestion even when they successfully control the overall crowd flow. Finding better barrier configurations is difficult because there is no dataset that provides the best barrier placement for a given crowd scene. We address this challenge by introducing a simulation-driven reinforcement learning framework that learns barrier configurations without requiring labelled training data. Starting from a segmented crowd scene, we construct a realistic simulation environment that reproduces the observed pedestrian distribution. This environment is then used to train a Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) agent that continuously adjusts barrier positions to improve pedestrian movement. Unlike supervised approaches the proposed framework allows the agent to explore barrier configurations that have never been observed in real data. We evaluate the learned policy under unseen numbers of pedestrians. The learned policy consistently outperforms the existing manually designed barrier configuration by reducing pedestrian stops while maintaining effective flow regulation. These results demonstrate that combining computer vision crowd simulation and reinforcement learning provides an effective framework for optimizing crowd control infrastructure.
comment: An earlier version was presented at the 26th Scientific Forum for Hajj, Umrah and Visit Research, Umm Al-Qura University (2026)

AI.title_translation: 基于动态护栏的自适应人群流动控制强化学习方法
AI.tldr: 本研究提出一种基于仿真驱动强化学习的动态护栏控制框架，通过智能动态调整护栏位置，在有效调控人流的同时减少行人停顿。
AI.motivation: 在大型公共集会中，固定的护栏布局易引发不必要的行人停顿和局部拥堵；同时，由于缺乏标注最优护栏放置的数据集，难以寻找更优的护栏配置方案。
AI.method: 提出了一种仿真驱动的强化学习框架：首先基于分割后的人群场景构建重现真实行人分布的仿真环境，随后训练软行动者-评论家（Soft Actor-Critic, SAC）智能体，以持续动态调整护栏位置来优化人流，无需任何带标签的训练数据。
AI.result: 在未见过的行人数量场景测试下，所学策略显著优于现存的人工设计护栏配置，在有效调节人流的同时显著减少了行人的停顿次数。
AI.conclusion: 结合计算机视觉、人群仿真与强化学习，为动态优化人群控制基础设施及提升大型活动管理效率提供了一个高度有效的新范式。
AI.translation: 在朝圣等大型公共活动中，人群护栏被广泛用于调节行人流动。然而，固定的护栏布局即使成功控制了整体人流，也常常会导致不必要的行人停顿和局部拥堵。寻找更优的护栏配置十分困难，因为不存在提供特定人群场景下最佳护栏布局的数据集。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了一种基于仿真驱动的强化学习框架，无需标注训练数据即可学习护栏配置。从分割后的人群场景出发，我们构建了一个能够复现观测行人分布的逼真仿真环境。该环境随后被用于训练一个软行动者-评论家（SAC）智能体，使其能够持续调整护栏位置以改善行人流动。与监督学习方法不同，该框架允许智能体探索真实数据中从未出现过的护栏配置。我们在未见过的行人数量场景下对所学策略进行了评估。实验表明，所学策略在保持有效人流调节的同时减少了行人停顿，始终优于现有的人工设计护栏配置。这些结果表明，将计算机视觉、人群仿真与强化学习相结合，为优化人群控制基础设施提供了一个有效的框架。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种结合计算机视觉与仿真驱动强化学习的自适应人群流动控制框架。该方法无需真实标注数据，在重现真实分布的仿真环境中训练SAC智能体动态调节护栏位置，在未见人流规模下成功降低了行人停顿并优化了流动效率，优于传统人工配置。
AI.keywords: 强化学习, 人群流动控制, 动态护栏, 软行动者-评论家算法 (SAC), 人群仿真
AI.comments: 该研究创新性地将无标注数据的计算机视觉人群场景复原、人群流动微观仿真与无模型强化学习相结合，摆脱了对昂贵且难以获取的真实标注数据的依赖；其意义在于为朝圣等大型集会场景的动态基础设施调度提供了可行方案；潜在局限在于依赖仿真环境的真实度，从仿真策略到现实环境物理部署（Sim-to-Real）的泛化及物理安全边界在摘要中未深入探讨。

title: Task Success Is Not Enough: Side-effect-Aware Evaluation of Tool-Using Language Model Agents
comments: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 (Evaluations and Datasets Track). 19 pages, 5 figures, 10 tables
summary: Tool-using language model agents are usually evaluated by whether they finish the user's task. That metric misses a common failure: an agent can complete the requested work while also taking an unauthorized side-effecting action, such as writing to the wrong object, expanding the scope of the request, or contacting an unintended recipient. We call this failure mode collateral damage (CD). We introduce SABench (Side-effect-Aware Benchmark), a benchmark of 201 email, calendar, and ticket tasks. Each task crosses one of four state structures (independent, dependent, externally reachable, cross-tool) with one of four trap families (ambiguity, mis-targeting, cascade harm, overreach), and each task has a deterministic trace-based oracle for both goal satisfaction and authorization compliance. Across 2,211 model-task pairs from 11 frontier LLMs spanning major commercial and open model families, 15.2% of all runs incur CD, with risk concentrated in ambiguity tasks (38.8% violation rate) while non-ambiguous traps average 8.4% CD. Among goal-satisfied runs, 12.8% still produce unauthorized writes. Cross-tool and dependent states have about twice the CD rate of independent states. CD rates vary by 4.7x across models at comparable goal rates, which suggests that task success alone is a poor proxy for safe tool use. The SABench task corpus is released at https://huggingface.co/datasets/Phaedrus/sabench; the traces, oracle, code, and analysis pipeline are released at https://github.com/hjj194/sabench-artifact.
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 (Evaluations and Datasets Track). 19 pages, 5 figures, 10 tables

AI.title_translation: 仅完成任务还不够：针对使用工具的语言模型智能体的副作用感知评估
AI.tldr: 本文提出了SABench基准，揭示了智能体在完成目标任务时常伴随未授权写入等“附带损害”，证明单靠任务成功率无法衡量工具使用的安全性。
AI.motivation: 现有的工具使用语言模型智能体评估通常只关注是否完成用户任务，忽略了智能体在完成任务的同时可能执行未经授权的具有副作用的操作（称为“附带损害/Collateral Damage”），例如写入错误对象、擅自扩大请求范围或联系非预期接收者。
AI.method: 提出了SABench基准，包含涵盖电子邮件、日历和工单场景的201个任务。每个任务结合了4种状态结构（独立、依赖、外部可达、跨工具）和4种陷阱类型（模糊性、目标错误、级联伤害、过度干预），并配备了确定性的基于执行轨迹的Oracle判定器，用于同时评估目标达成度与授权合规性。
AI.result: 对来自主流商业和开源系列的11个前沿大模型进行测试（共2,211个模型-任务对），15.2%的运行产生了附带损害（CD）；在达成目标任务的运行中，仍有12.8%产生了未经授权的写入操作；模糊任务中的违规率高达38.8%；跨工具和依赖状态下的CD率约为独立状态的两倍；在目标完成率相近的情况下，各模型的CD率差异高达4.7倍。
AI.conclusion: 仅凭任务成功率并不能作为安全使用工具的有效代理指标，必须对智能体的附带效应和授权合规性进行全面评估。
AI.translation: 使用工具的语言模型智能体通常根据其是否完成用户任务来进行评估。这种指标忽略了一种常见的故障模式：智能体可以在完成请求工作的同时，采取未经授权且产生副作用的操作，例如写入错误的对象、擅自扩大请求范围或联系非预期的接收者。我们将这种故障模式称为“附带损害”（Collateral Damage, CD）。我们引入了SABench（副作用感知基准），这是一个包含201个电子邮件、日历和工单任务的基准。每个任务将四种状态结构（独立、依赖、外部可达、跨工具）之一与四种陷阱类型（模糊性、目标错误、级联伤害、过度干预）之一进行交叉结合，并且每个任务都配有确定性的基于轨迹的Oracle，用于同时判断目标达成情况与授权合规性。在涵盖主要商业和开源模型系列的11个前沿大模型的2,211个模型-任务对中，15.2%的运行造成了附带损害，其中风险主要集中在模糊性任务中（违规率为38.8%），而非模糊性陷阱的平均附带损害率为8.4%。在满足目标的运行中，仍有12.8%产生了未经授权的写入。跨工具和依赖状态下的附带损害率约为独立状态的两倍。在目标达成率相当的情况下，不同模型的附带损害率相差高达4.7倍，这表明单靠任务成功率并不能很好地代表工具调用的安全性。SABench任务语料库已在Hugging Face开源，轨迹、评测判定代码及分析流程已在GitHub开源。
AI.summary: 本文指出了工具使用智能体评估中仅看“任务完成”的缺陷，提出了关注附带损害（CD）的评测基准SABench。实验表明，即便成功完成任务，模型仍有12.8%的概率触发未授权写操作，强调了在智能体评估中引入副作用与安全性考量的必要性。
AI.keywords: 语言模型智能体, 工具使用, 附带损害, 副作用感知评估, SABench
AI.comments: 该研究具有极高的实际应用价值与重要性，首次系统指出了当前Agent评测中仅关注“任务完成率”的安全隐患，提出了“附带损害（CD）”的概念与对应的基准测试SABench，揭示了大模型在复杂跨工具调用中隐蔽的授权越界问题。其局限性在于目前评测主要局限在邮件、日历和工单等场景，未来需要扩展至更广泛的操作空间。

title: Flexible Beamforming via Fluid Antenna Array: From Discrete to Continuous Array
comments: 12 pages, 9 figures. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Wireless Communications
summary: Fluid antenna arrays (FAAs) reconfigure their effective aperture by activating radiation ports from a dense set of candidate positions within a finite physical region, thereby offering geometry diversity beyond conventional fixed arrays. This paper studies arbitrary-direction far-field beam synthesis with a planar FAA. Since a fixed array adapts its beamforming weights on a predetermined spatial sampling structure, its ability to match desired beam patterns is limited when both the aperture and the number of active elements are constrained. To exploit the geometry diversity of the FAA, we propose a coarse-to-fine scheme that couples discrete port selection with continuous joint refinement. In the coarse stage, a fast Fourier transform (FFT) based phase retrieval step converts the amplitude-only beam specification into an aperture-compatible complex target, after which an FFT-tailored greedy method selects the active ports and least squares initializes their complex weights. In the fine stage, a projected adaptive moment estimation procedure jointly refines the continuous port positions and beamforming weights while enforcing the minimum interelement spacing. For the evaluated two-beam configuration, the proposed scheme increases the mainlobe energy fraction from 35.73% to 48.92% and reduces the peak sidelobe level from -2.30 dB to -3.83 dB relative to a fixed array with the same aperture and active-port count.
comment: 12 pages, 9 figures. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Wireless Communications

AI.title_translation: 基于流体天线阵列的灵活波束成形：从离散到连续阵列
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种离散选择与连续精细调节相结合的由粗到细方案，利用流体天线阵列的几何分集显著提升了波束成形性能。
AI.motivation: 固定天线阵列受限于预定的空间采样网格，在孔径和激活阵元数量受限时难以有效匹配目标波束图案，而流体天线阵列可通过动态重构有效孔径提供几何分集来克服此瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出一种由粗到细的方案：粗阶段利用基于快速傅里叶变换（FFT）的相位恢复将纯幅度波束规格转为孔径兼容复目标，并通过定制贪婪算法选择激活端口及用最小二乘法初始化复权重；细阶段采用投影自适应矩估计（Adam）方法在满足最小间距约束下联合细化连续端口位置与权重。
AI.result: 在双波束配置测试中，相比具有相同孔径和激活端口数的固定阵列，该方案将主瓣能量占比从35.73%提高至48.92%，峰值旁瓣电平从-2.30 dB降低至-3.83 dB。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的由粗到细联合优化方案能有效发挥流体天线阵列的几何分集优势，在受限孔径和单元数下显著提升波束主瓣能量聚集度并抑制旁瓣电平。
AI.translation: 流体天线阵列（FAA）通过在有限物理区域内的密集候选位置中激活辐射端口来重构其有效孔径，从而提供超越传统固定阵列的几何分集。本文研究了利用平面流体天线阵列实现任意方向远场波束合成的问题。由于固定阵列在预定的空间采样结构上调整其波束成形权重，当孔径和激活阵元数量均受限时，其匹配期望波束图案的能力受到制约。为了利用流体天线阵列的几何分集，我们提出了一种将离散端口选择与连续联合精炼相结合的由粗到细方案。在粗略阶段，基于快速傅里叶变换（FFT）的相位恢复步骤将仅包含幅度的波束规范转换为孔径兼容的复目标，随后利用针对FFT定制的贪婪算法选择激活端口，并使用最小二乘法初始化其复权重。在精细阶段，投影自适应矩估计算法在强制执行最小阵元间距的同时，联合细化连续端口位置和波束成形权重。在评估的双波束配置中，与具有相同孔径和激活端口数的固定阵列相比，所提方案将主瓣能量占比从35.73%提高到48.92%，并将峰值旁瓣电平从-2.30 dB降低到-3.83 dB。
AI.summary: 本文研究了利用平面流体天线阵列实现任意方向远场波束合成的方法，提出了一种将离散端口选择与连续位置/权重联合精炼相结合的由粗到细方案，有效利用了几何分集，显著改善了波束图样的匹配性能与旁瓣抑制能力。
AI.keywords: 流体天线阵列, 灵活波束成形, 几何分集, 端口选择, 连续优化
AI.comments: 该研究创新性地将波束成形从离散网格端口选择扩展至连续物理位置联合优化，充分释放了流体天线阵列的空间几何自由度；局限在于摘要仅提供了双波束场景的测试结果，算法在大规模阵列下的计算复杂度及实际天线互耦影响在摘要中未予提及。

title: Reasoning or Just Prompting? Probing the Mechanism of Latent Chemical Reasoning
summary: Latent reasoning performs intermediate computation in continuous space rather than through explicit tokens, which is particularly appealing in chemistry, where errors in explicit reasoning can propagate to the final answer. Yet if latent states truly constitute an implicit reasoning chain, they should be causally important. We find otherwise: swapping or moderately perturbing intermediate latent states has little effect on performance, while removing them entirely sometimes causes a substantial score drop. Thus, the latent states matter, but their molecule-specific content appears to matter far less. This points to a simpler interpretation. Rather than encoding a step-by-step reasoning chain, latent states may primarily steer subsequent model computation, much like soft prompts. Indeed, a single fixed prefix shared across molecules reproduces LatentChem's performance, and a learned static soft prompt performs comparably to per-input latent generation in controlled models. The tolerance of latent sequences to substitution and moderate perturbation further supports this connection. We therefore suggest that latent chemical reasoning may be better viewed as soft prompting than as a reasoning chain hidden in continuous space.

AI.title_translation: 推理还是仅仅在提示？探究隐式化学推理的机制
AI.tldr: 实验表明隐式化学推理并非真正的连续推理链，其隐状态主要起到了类似“软提示”的计算引导作用。
AI.motivation: 检验在连续空间中进行的隐式化学推理是否真正构成了具有因果重要性的隐式推理链，探究其背后的真实运作机制。
AI.method: 通过对中间隐状态进行交换、适度扰动和完全移除等因果探针操作，并对比“跨分子共享的固定前缀”与“学习到的静态软提示”替代动态生成隐状态的效果。
AI.result: 交换或轻微扰动隐状态对性能影响极小，完全移除则导致显著性能下降；单一固定的共享前缀即可复现LatentChem的性能，静态软提示的表现也与逐输入动态生成的隐状态相当。
AI.conclusion: 隐式化学推理更适合被视作一种“软提示”机制，而非隐藏在连续空间中的因果推理链；隐状态主要起到引导后续计算的作用，其针对特定分子的内容重要性远低于预期。
AI.translation: 隐式推理在连续空间中而非通过显式词元执行中间计算，这在化学领域尤为吸引人，因为显式推理中的错误可能会传播到最终答案。然而，如果隐状态确实构成了隐式推理链，它们应该在因果关系上具有重要性。我们的发现却恰恰相反：交换或适度扰动中间隐状态对性能影响甚微，而完全移除它们有时会导致分数大幅下降。因此，隐状态虽然重要，但其特定于分子的内容似乎远没那么重要。这指向了一种更简单的解释：隐状态可能主要用于引导模型的后续计算（类似于软提示），而不是编码逐步的推理链。事实上，跨分子共享的单个固定前缀即可复现 LatentChem 的性能，并且在对照模型中，学习到的静态软提示的表现与针对每个输入动态生成的隐状态相当。隐序列对替换和适度扰动的耐受性进一步支持了这种关联。因此我们认为，隐式化学推理可能更适合被视为软提示，而非隐藏在连续空间中的推理链。
AI.summary: 本文探究了连续空间中隐式化学推理的本质机制。研究发现扰动或交换隐状态对性能影响甚微，而静态软提示即可达到类似动态生成的效果，表明隐式推理并非真正的逐步因果推理链，而更类似于引导模型计算的软提示。
AI.keywords: 隐式推理, 化学推理, 软提示, 机制探究, 连续空间
AI.comments: 该论文具有很强的批判性和启发性。它通过因果探针实验挑战了“隐式连续推理链”的流行假设，揭示了模型可能仅将隐状态作为通用计算触发器（软提示）而非具体分子的逐步推理路径，对评估大模型隐式推理的真实能力具有重要警示价值。

title: An efficient method for reconstructing the potential in the fractional Calderón problem with a single measurement
summary: In this paper, we develop a numerical method for determining the potential function in one-dimensional and two-dimensional fractional-order Calderón problems through a single measurement. The fractional Laplacian is discretized using the finite difference method, and the POD-RBF method is used to construct the forward problem surrogate model that can provide the predicted value and its exact gradient in time. The inverse problem is solved using Tikhonov regularization and the conjugate gradient method. The efficiency and effectiveness of the developed method are demonstrated through numerical experiments, and the theoretical results are verified.

AI.title_translation: 单次测量下重构分数阶Calderón问题中势函数的高效方法
AI.tldr: 提出了一种结合POD-RBF代理模型与共轭梯度法的高效数值方法，仅凭单次测量即可重构分数阶Calderón问题中的势函数。
AI.motivation: 旨在开发一种仅利用单次测量即可有效确定一维和二维分数阶Calderón问题中未知势函数的数值反演方法。
AI.method: 利用有限差分法离散分数阶拉普拉斯算子；采用POD-RBF方法建立正问题代理模型以实时提供预测值及其精确梯度；利用Tikhonov正则化和共轭梯度法求解逆问题。
AI.result: 数值实验验证了所提方法的计算效率和重构有效性，并印证了相关理论结果。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的数值算法能够通过单次测量有效、高效地反演一维和二维分数阶Calderón问题的势函数。
AI.translation: 在本文中，我们开发了一种通过单次测量确定一维和二维分数阶Calderón问题中势函数的数值方法。利用有限差分法对分数阶拉普拉斯算子进行离散化，并采用POD-RBF方法构建正问题代理模型，该模型能够及时提供预测值及其精确梯度。逆问题则采用Tikhonov正则化和共轭梯度法进行求解。数值实验证明了该方法的效率与有效性，并验证了理论结果。
AI.summary: 本文针对一维和二维分数阶Calderón问题，提出了一种基于单次测量的势函数重构数值方法。该方法通过有限差分法离散算子，构建POD-RBF代理模型以高效计算前向解及其精确梯度，并结合Tikhonov正则化和共轭梯度法反演逆问题，经数值试验证明了其高效性与准确性。
AI.keywords: 分数阶Calderón问题, 单次测量, POD-RBF方法, 势函数重构, Tikhonov正则化
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于将POD-RBF降阶代理模型引入分数阶Calderón逆问题的求解中，能够实时获取精确梯度信息，显著降低了单次测量反演问题的计算开销；局限在于摘要未详细展示该方法在强噪声条件下的鲁棒性以及在三维复杂区域中的适用性。

title: Freeze What Is Settled, Cache What Is Smooth: Spatial Freezing Keeps Step Caching in Its Low-Error Regime
summary: Instruction-based image editors built on diffusion transformers run tens of denoising steps. Training-free acceleration either reuses features across steps (step caching) or stops computing the regions an edit leaves untouched (region freezing), and the two have been combined before. We ask how a high speed-up target should be split between them. On Qwen-Image-2.1, freezing does more than remove tokens: it lowers the cost of every step, so the step cache can reach the same overall speed-up with a conservative threshold that keeps its error small. A per-step cost model fitted on development runs predicts held-out latency with a median error of 4.0% and reproduces the speed ceilings of the region methods we re-implemented (2.73$\times$ predicted vs. 2.70$\times$ measured for RegionE). Driving frozen tokens to the model's one-step $x_0$ estimate beats returning them to the reference image on every development sample, and in 90% of measured cases the composed error stays below the sum of the two individual errors. The resulting method, FreezePlan, keeps five full steps and gives the rest of the budget to TaylorSeer. On a pre-registered test split it runs 5.05$\times$ faster end to end at 29.8 dB PSNR to the original output, with no significant drop in a VLM judge score; TaylorSeer at 5.02$\times$ reaches 23.5 dB. The curve extends to 5.99$\times$ at 28.0 dB. Swapping in the region selectors of prior methods under our schedule lowers median PSNR by only 0.5--0.6 dB, which places the gain in the schedule and budget split rather than in the selector.

AI.title_translation: 冻结已稳定区域，缓存平滑区域：空间冻结使步长缓存保持在低误差状态
AI.tldr: 本文提出FreezePlan，一种结合空间冻结和步长缓存的加速扩散模型图像编辑方法，在Qwen-Image-2.1上实现了5倍以上加速，同时保持图像质量和低误差。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型图像编辑器需要大量去噪步骤，现有无训练加速方法（步长缓存和区域冻结）已被结合，但如何优化分配加速目标仍是问题。
AI.method: 本文提出FreezePlan，结合了空间冻结和步长缓存。通过冻结未修改区域，降低了每一步的计算成本，从而使步长缓存能在较低误差阈值下实现相同加速。方法包括一个逐步成本模型，并发现将冻结令牌驱动到模型的一步x0估计优于返回参考图像。FreezePlan保留五个完整步骤，并将剩余预算分配给TaylorSeer。
AI.result: 成本模型预测延迟的中间误差为4.0%。FreezePlan在Qwen-Image-2.1上实现了5.05倍的端到端加速，PSNR为29.8 dB，VLM评判分数无显著下降。TaylorSeer在5.02倍加速时PSNR为23.5 dB。加速曲线最高可达5.99倍，PSNR为28.0 dB。将现有区域选择器应用于FreezePlan的调度方法，中值PSNR仅下降0.5-0.6 dB，表明性能提升主要来自调度和预算分配而非选择器。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的FreezePlan方法通过优化空间冻结和步长缓存的结合，显著加速了扩散模型图像编辑，同时保持了高图像质量和低误差，其性能提升主要归因于优化的调度和预算分配。
AI.translation: 基于指令的扩散Transformer图像编辑器需要数十个去噪步骤。免训练加速方法要么跨步骤重用特征（步长缓存），要么停止计算编辑未触及的区域（区域冻结），这两种方法之前已被结合。我们探讨了如何在高加速目标下在这两者之间进行分配。在Qwen-Image-2.1上，冻结不仅仅是移除令牌：它降低了每一步的成本，因此步长缓存可以在保持误差较小的保守阈值下达到相同的整体加速。一个在开发运行中拟合的逐步成本模型预测了未验证延迟，中间误差为4.0%，并重现了我们重新实现的区域方法的加速上限（RegionE预测为2.73倍，实测为2.70倍）。将冻结的令牌驱动到模型的一步x0估计优于在每一步将其返回到参考图像，并且在90%的测量案例中，复合误差保持在两个单独误差之和以下。由此产生的方法FreezePlan保留五个完整步骤，并将剩余预算分配给TaylorSeer。在预注册的测试分割上，它实现了5.05倍的端到端加速，与原始输出相比PSNR为29.8 dB，VLM评判分数没有显著下降；TaylorSeer在5.02倍加速时达到23.5 dB。该曲线延伸至5.99倍加速，PSNR为28.0 dB。在我们的调度下，替换为先前方法的区域选择器仅将中值PSNR降低0.5-0.6 dB，这表明增益在于调度和预算分配，而非选择器本身。
AI.summary: 本文研究了扩散Transformer图像编辑器中，如何优化结合空间冻结和步长缓存两种免训练加速方法。通过分析，发现空间冻结不仅移除令牌，还能降低每步成本，从而使步长缓存能在低误差下实现高效加速。研究提出了FreezePlan方法，它优化了冻结区域的处理方式并精细分配了计算预算。实验结果显示，FreezePlan在Qwen-Image-2.1上实现了超过5倍的端到端加速，同时保持了高图像质量和低误差，显著优于现有方法，并强调了优化调度和预算分配的重要性。
AI.keywords: 空间冻结, 步长缓存, 扩散Transformer, 图像编辑, 加速, FreezePlan
AI.comments: 这篇论文通过深入分析空间冻结和步长缓存两种加速技术的协同作用，提出了一种创新的加速策略FreezePlan。其创新点在于发现空间冻结不仅能减少计算量，还能优化步长缓存的误差控制，并通过精细的预算分配实现了显著的性能提升。论文还通过对比实验强调了调度和预算分配在加速效果中的关键作用，而非仅仅是区域选择器。这对于提高扩散模型在实际应用中的效率具有重要意义。

title: Write What Matters: Disentangling Token Selection from Slot Allocation in Recurrent Memory
summary: Long-sequence models must retain earlier information. Full attention keeps all past tokens but grows expensive, and recurrent-memory models compress history into fixed slots for linear-time processing. Limited capacity makes writes consequential: distractors can interfere with useful content, while skipped evidence cannot be recalled. Existing multi-slot memories write every token to the same number of slots, merging whether to store it with how many slots to update. We introduce Factorized Write Routing (FWR), which first keeps or skips each token and then chooses a fixed or token-adaptive number of slots. Queries still read all slots. Across ten seeds on two synthetic tasks that query facts after long contexts, we observe a density-dependent reversal. With four slots per write, long-context accuracy favors always writing on dense Feature Recall (0.472 vs 0.337), but learned selective writing on sparse-fact Passkey (0.222 vs 0.048). The tested adaptive rule underperforms fixed allocation under the learned gate on both tasks. A diagnostic oracle given fact labels unavailable at deployment reaches 0.372 on Passkey, showing headroom in filtering distractors. The results suggest avoiding missed writes in information-dense contexts and filtering distractors when they dominate.

AI.title_translation: 写下重要之事：在循环记忆中解耦令牌选择与槽位分配
AI.tldr: 本文提出因子化写入路由（FWR），在循环记忆中将令牌选择与槽位分配解耦，并在合成任务上观察到写入策略的密度依赖性反转。
AI.motivation: 现有长序列模型中，全注意力机制成本高昂，而循环记忆模型通过固定槽位压缩历史信息，但容量有限，易受干扰或遗漏关键信息。现有多槽位记忆模型将令牌存储与槽位更新数量混淆。
AI.method: 本文引入因子化写入路由（Factorized Write Routing, FWR）。该方法首先决定是保留还是跳过每个令牌，然后选择固定数量或根据令牌自适应数量的槽位进行写入。查询时仍然读取所有槽位。
AI.result: 在两个合成任务上，观察到写入策略的密度依赖性反转：在信息密集的Feature Recall任务中，始终写入（0.472 vs 0.337）表现更好；而在稀疏事实的Passkey任务中，学习到的选择性写入（0.222 vs 0.048）表现更优。测试的自适应规则在两种任务中均不及固定分配规则。诊断性预言机在Passkey任务中达到0.372，表明在过滤干扰物方面仍有改进空间。
AI.conclusion: 在信息密集的环境中应避免遗漏写入，而在干扰物占主导时应过滤掉它们。
AI.translation: 长序列模型必须保留早期信息。完全注意力机制保留所有过去的令牌但成本高昂，而循环记忆模型将历史信息压缩到固定槽位中进行线性时间处理。有限的容量使得写入操作具有重要影响：干扰物可能会干扰有用内容，而跳过的证据则无法召回。现有的多槽位记忆模型将每个令牌写入相同数量的槽位，混淆了是否存储它以及更新多少槽位。我们引入了因子化写入路由（FWR），它首先决定保留或跳过每个令牌，然后选择固定数量或根据令牌自适应数量的槽位。查询时仍然读取所有槽位。在两个合成任务上，针对长上下文后查询事实，我们通过十个随机种子观察到密度依赖性反转。在每次写入四个槽位的情况下，在信息密集的Feature Recall任务中，长上下文准确率倾向于始终写入（0.472 vs 0.337），但在稀疏事实的Passkey任务中，学习到的选择性写入（0.222 vs 0.048）表现更好。在两种任务中，在学习门控下，测试的自适应规则均不及固定分配。一个在部署时无法获得的包含事实标签的诊断性预言机在Passkey任务中达到0.372，显示了过滤干扰物的改进空间。结果表明，在信息密集的上下文中应避免遗漏写入，而在干扰物占主导时应过滤掉它们。
AI.summary: 本文提出因子化写入路由（FWR），旨在解决循环记忆模型中令牌选择与槽位分配的混淆问题，以提高长序列模型的记忆效率。FWR将令牌的保留/跳过决策与槽位数量分配分开处理。实验结果表明，在信息密集的任务中，应优先避免遗漏写入；而在信息稀疏且干扰物较多的任务中，选择性写入和过滤干扰物更为关键。
AI.keywords: 循环记忆, 令牌选择, 槽位分配, 长序列模型, 因子化写入路由
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了因子化写入路由（FWR），将循环记忆中的令牌选择和槽位分配解耦，这提供了一种更精细地控制记忆写入过程的方法。其重要性在于，在长序列模型中有效管理有限的记忆容量是一个核心挑战，FWR的策略性写入方法有望提高模型在复杂上下文中的信息保留能力。实验结果揭示了写入策略的密度依赖性，为未来设计更智能的记忆机制提供了有价值的见解。然而，论文中提到的自适应规则表现不佳以及预言机仍有改进空间，也表明该方法在实际应用中可能仍需进一步优化。

title: Entropic Control for Homeostatic Optimization: Pre-empting Catastrophic Forgetting via Dynamic Feedback
summary: Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) of LLMs suffers from catastrophic forgetting, and prevailing mitigation strategies struggle to reconcile the plasticity-stability dilemma. To address this, we propose Entropic Control for Homeostatic Optimization (ECHO), a closed-loop control framework. By decomposing the KL divergence, we identify output entropy as a dominant observable component of KL variation. This enables us to leverage entropy as a computationally efficient online proxy to monitor forgetting risks in real-time, bypassing expensive reference-model inference. Consequently, ECHO employs an elastic controller that dynamically modulates the gradient weight of replay data via a proportional control law, using deviations from the pre-trained entropic equilibrium as an error signal. Empirical evaluations across 0.6B to 9B parameter architectures demonstrate that ECHO lies on, and in several comparisons extends, the observed plasticity-stability frontier and maintains high operational robustness against varying data mixing ratios.

AI.title_translation: 熵控稳态优化：通过动态反馈预先阻止灾难性遗忘
AI.tldr: ECHO是一个通过动态反馈控制输出熵来实时监控和缓解大型语言模型（LLMs）中灾难性遗忘的框架，它在保持模型稳定性的同时提高了可塑性。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）的监督微调（SFT）存在灾难性遗忘问题，而现有的缓解策略难以调和可塑性-稳定性困境。
AI.method: 本文提出了熵控稳态优化（ECHO），一个闭环控制框架。通过分解KL散度，将输出熵识别为KL变化的主要可观测分量。ECHO利用熵作为计算高效的在线代理来实时监控遗忘风险，避免了昂贵的参考模型推理。它采用一个弹性控制器，通过比例控制律动态调节回放数据的梯度权重，使用与预训练熵平衡的偏差作为误差信号。
AI.result: 在0.6B到9B参数架构上的实证评估表明，ECHO位于并（在某些比较中）扩展了观察到的可塑性-稳定性边界，并对不同的数据混合比例保持高操作鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: ECHO通过动态反馈控制，有效解决了LLMs中的灾难性遗忘问题，实现了可塑性与稳定性的平衡，并展现出良好的鲁棒性。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）的监督微调（SFT）存在灾难性遗忘问题，而现有的缓解策略难以调和可塑性-稳定性困境。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了熵控稳态优化（ECHO），一个闭环控制框架。通过分解KL散度，我们将输出熵识别为KL变化的主要可观测分量。这使得我们能够利用熵作为计算高效的在线代理来实时监控遗忘风险，绕过了昂贵的参考模型推理。因此，ECHO采用一个弹性控制器，通过比例控制律动态调节回放数据的梯度权重，使用与预训练熵平衡的偏差作为误差信号。在0.6B到9B参数架构上的实证评估表明，ECHO位于并（在某些比较中）扩展了观察到的可塑性-稳定性边界，并对不同的数据混合比例保持高操作鲁棒性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了熵控稳态优化（ECHO），一个闭环控制框架，旨在解决大型语言模型（LLMs）监督微调中的灾难性遗忘问题。ECHO通过将输出熵作为KL散度的主要可观测分量，并将其用作实时监控遗忘风险的计算高效代理。它采用一个弹性控制器，根据与预训练熵平衡的偏差动态调整回放数据的梯度权重。实验结果表明，ECHO在可塑性-稳定性权衡方面表现出色，并对数据混合比例具有高鲁棒性。
AI.keywords: 灾难性遗忘, 熵控, 稳态优化, 动态反馈, 大语言模型
AI.comments: 该论文通过引入“熵控”这一新颖的视角来解决LLMs中的灾难性遗忘问题，其创新点在于将输出熵作为实时监控遗忘风险的代理，并设计了一个闭环动态反馈控制器。这种方法绕过了昂贵的参考模型推理，提高了计算效率。其核心贡献在于提供了一种有效平衡模型可塑性与稳定性的策略，对于持续学习和在线微调场景具有重要意义。

title: AudioFM: Towards General Purpose Audio Representation Learning
summary: Learning audio representations that effectively bridge holistic global soundscapes with fine-grained acoustic moments is a long-standing goal in self-supervised learning. Recording-level contrastive objectives encourage agreement between pooled audio representations, but do not explicitly supervise local time-frequency representations. We introduce AudioFM, a self-supervised framework that combines recording-level contrast with patch-wise masked latent discrimination. Using visible acoustic context, a student predicts representations of masked patches and identifies their corresponding full-view teacher targets among candidates from other recordings. We further incorporate weaker supervision from eligible temporal neighbors to encourage local temporal consistency. Extensive evaluations show that AudioFM achieves state-of-the-art performance across diverse audio domains in linear probing, fine-tuning, and zero-shot transfer, demonstrating superior event detection, robust scene-level understanding, and strong domain generalizability.

AI.title_translation: AudioFM：迈向通用音频表示学习
AI.tldr: AudioFM是一个自监督学习框架，结合了录音级对比和补丁级掩蔽潜在判别，实现了跨多种音频领域的SOTA性能，在事件检测、场景理解和领域泛化方面表现出色。
AI.motivation: 自监督学习中长期存在的目标是学习能够有效连接整体全局声景与细粒度声学时刻的音频表示。现有的录音级对比目标未能明确监督局部时频表示。
AI.method: AudioFM是一个自监督框架，它结合了录音级对比和补丁级掩蔽潜在判别。学生模型利用可见声学上下文预测被掩蔽补丁的表示，并从其他录音的候选者中识别其对应的完整视图教师目标。此外，它还结合了来自合格时间邻居的弱监督，以鼓励局部时间一致性。
AI.result: AudioFM在线性探测、微调和零样本迁移方面在多种音频领域取得了最先进的性能，展示了卓越的事件检测能力、鲁棒的场景级理解和强大的领域泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: AudioFM通过结合录音级对比和补丁级掩蔽潜在判别，成功实现了通用音频表示学习的长期目标，并在多项任务上取得了显著的SOTA表现。
AI.translation: 学习能够有效连接整体全局声景与细粒度声学时刻的音频表示，是自监督学习中一个长期存在的目标。录音级对比目标鼓励池化音频表示之间的一致性，但没有明确监督局部时频表示。我们引入了AudioFM，这是一个自监督框架，它结合了录音级对比与补丁级掩蔽潜在判别。利用可见的声学上下文，学生模型预测被掩蔽补丁的表示，并从其他录音的候选者中识别其对应的完整视图教师目标。我们进一步结合了来自合格时间邻居的弱监督，以鼓励局部时间一致性。广泛的评估表明，AudioFM在线性探测、微调和零样本迁移方面在多种音频领域取得了最先进的性能，展示了卓越的事件检测能力、鲁棒的场景级理解和强大的领域泛化能力。
AI.summary: 本文提出了AudioFM，一个用于通用音频表示学习的自监督框架。它通过结合录音级对比学习和补丁级掩蔽潜在判别来解决现有方法无法有效桥接全局声景和细粒度声学时刻的问题。AudioFM利用可见上下文预测掩蔽补丁的表示，并辅以时间邻居的弱监督以增强局部一致性。实验结果表明，AudioFM在多种音频领域的线性探测、微调和零样本迁移任务中均达到了最先进的性能，在事件检测、场景理解和领域泛化方面表现出色。
AI.keywords: 音频表示学习, 自监督学习, 对比学习, 掩蔽建模, AudioFM
AI.comments: AudioFM通过结合全局录音级对比和局部补丁级掩蔽潜在判别，有效地解决了音频表示学习中全局与局部信息融合的挑战，其在多任务和多领域上的SOTA表现证明了其创新性和重要性。

title: Evaluating Wi-Fi HaLow for Next-Generation Capsule Endoscopy
summary: Capsule endoscopy is limited by its wireless link: insufficient throughput restricts image resolution and frame rate, whereas high-rate radios typically use higher carrier frequencies that experience greater attenuation through tissue. This work evaluates Wi-Fi HaLow (IEEE 802.11ah), a sub-GHz Wi-Fi standard, as an image link for capsule endoscopy. Across all tested combinations of modulation and coding scheme and bandwidth, the saturation TCP throughput reached 15.55 Mbps, and the fastest configuration also achieved the lowest energy per bit. Through power optimization strategies, the combined power consumption of the HaLow module and microcontroller at 1 frame per second (FPS) was reduced from 101.70 to 14.00 mW, which is comparable to that of Bluetooth Low Energy systems. In a simulated in vivo setting, the default rate control selected the highest tested MCS and bandwidth, indicating sufficient link quality; this configuration also had the lowest measured power in both the 1 FPS mode (13.59 mW) and the 30 FPS mode (174.21 mW). The capsule-to-receiver latency was 20.68 ms for a 24 KB frame, while the receiver-to-capsule latency was 4.77 ms for a command; this low-latency bidirectional communication supports real-time detection and manipulation for next-generation capsule endoscopy.

AI.title_translation: 评估Wi-Fi HaLow在下一代胶囊内窥镜中的应用
AI.tldr: 本文评估了Wi-Fi HaLow作为胶囊内窥镜无线链路的性能，证明其能提供高吞吐量、低延迟和极低功耗，是下一代胶囊内窥镜的理想选择。
AI.motivation: 胶囊内窥镜受限于现有的无线链路：低吞吐量限制了图像分辨率和帧率，而高速率无线电通常使用穿透组织衰减更大的较高载波频率。因此需要寻找一种兼顾高吞吐量与低组织衰减的无线方案。
AI.method: 评估了Wi-Fi HaLow（IEEE 802.11ah）在不同调制编码方案和带宽下的饱和TCP吞吐量、能耗，实施了功耗优化策略，并在模拟体内环境中测试了链路质量、功耗和端到端延迟。
AI.result: 饱和TCP吞吐量达到15.55 Mbps，功耗通过优化在1 FPS时降至14.00 mW（模拟体内为13.59 mW，30 FPS时为174.21 mW），胶囊到接收器的延迟为20.68 ms（24 KB帧），接收器到胶囊的命令延迟为4.77 ms。
AI.conclusion: Wi-Fi HaLow是下一代胶囊内窥镜极具潜力的无线通信技术，能够提供高吞吐量、低延迟以及可接受的低功耗。
AI.translation: 胶囊内窥镜受到其无线链路的限制：不足的吞吐量限制了图像分辨率和帧率，而高速率无线电通常使用在组织中衰减更大的较高载波频率。本工作评估了Wi-Fi HaLow（IEEE 802.11ah）这一亚吉赫兹（sub-GHz）Wi-Fi标准作为胶囊内窥镜图像链路的可行性。在所有测试的调制编码方案和带宽组合中，饱和TCP吞吐量达到了15.55 Mbps，最快的配置同时也实现了最低的每比特能量。通过功率优化策略，HaLow模块与微控制器在每秒1帧（FPS）时的组合功耗从101.70 mW降低至14.00 mW，这与低功耗蓝牙（BLE）系统相当。在模拟体内环境中，默认速率控制选择了最高测试的MCS和带宽，表明链路质量充足；该配置在1 FPS模式（13.59 mW）和30 FPS模式（174.21 mW）下也具有最低的测得功耗。对于24 KB的帧，胶囊到接收器的延迟为20.68 ms，而对于指令，接收器到胶囊的延迟为4.77 ms；这种低延迟的双向通信支持下一代胶囊内窥镜的实时检测与操控。
AI.summary: 该论文评估了sub-GHz Wi-Fi标准（Wi-Fi HaLow）作为胶囊内窥镜无线图像链路的性能。实验表明，Wi-Fi HaLow能够实现15.55 Mbps的饱和TCP吞吐量，经过功耗优化后在1 FPS下的功耗降至14.00 mW，并具备低延迟的双向通信能力，支持下一代胶囊内窥镜的实时检测与操控。
AI.keywords: Wi-Fi HaLow, 胶囊内窥镜, 无线通信, 吞吐量, 低功耗
AI.comments: 该论文评估了Wi-Fi HaLow作为下一代胶囊内窥镜无线图像链路的可行性，通过功耗优化和性能测试，证明了其在低功耗、高吞吐量和低延迟方面的潜力。创新点在于将sub-GHz的Wi-Fi HaLow技术应用到胶囊内窥镜中，兼顾了高分辨率/帧率与低组织衰减的需求。

title: R2A-Sales: A Policy-Atom-Matched Benchmark for Rule-to-Action Gaps in Goal-Directed Sales Agents
comments: 25 pages, including 16 pages of supplementary material. Both authors contributed equally
summary: LLM-based sales agents are often evaluated on static policy questions or task success, but deployment asks a sharper question: when a model can state a rule, will it choose compliant, tool-grounded actions under commercial pressure? We introduce R2A-Sales (Rule-to-Action), a policy-atom-matched benchmark for this question. Each item pairs a static probe with a multi-turn sales scenario sharing the same versioned policy atom, facts, evidence, behavioral constraints, and tool contract, so differences cannot be attributed to policy-content mismatch. In the interactive arm, a code-owned ledger verifies committed tool effects and terminal states; unsupported action claims receive no credit. We report static compliance $K$, grounded action compliance $A=\Pr(\text{safe terminal}\land\text{no hard violation}\land\text{non-echo})$, and the matched gap $G=K-A$. The frozen release spans three controlled Chinese-language sales domains, 24 policy atoms, 42 semantic cores, and 2,016 matched pairs. The confirmatory study audits 21,888 runs over 19 cores, covering eight backbones plus four Qwen3-8B prompt treatments (12 configurations). Static compliance is near ceiling $(K=89.9\%\text{--}99.1\%)$, yet eight-backbone action compliance is only $A=3.0\%\text{--}17.3\%$, giving $G=80.4\text{--}92.5$ percentage points. Since $A$ also requires safe termination, $G$ upper-bounds rule-to-action degradation rather than isolating pressure alone. No prompt-only treatment dominates all metrics. R2A-Sales shows that sales-agent reliability must be measured at committed action, not rule recital or task completion alone.
comment: 25 pages, including 16 pages of supplementary material. Both authors contributed equally

AI.title_translation: R2A-Sales：一个用于目标导向销售代理中规则到动作差距的策略原子匹配基准
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了R2A-Sales基准，用于评估大型语言模型（LLM）销售代理在面对商业压力时，能否将规则转化为实际的、符合工具约束的行动。结果显示，尽管模型在陈述规则方面表现出色（合规率K高），但在实际行动层面合规率（A）却很低，表明存在巨大的规则到动作差距（G）。
AI.motivation: 评估基于LLM的销售代理在实际商业压力下，能否将规则转化为合规、基于工具的行动，而不仅仅是成功完成任务或陈述规则。
AI.method: 引入R2A-Sales基准，该基准将静态测试项与多轮销售场景进行匹配，共享相同的策略原子、事实、证据、行为约束和工具契约。在交互式测试中，通过代码账本验证工具效果和终止状态，不当操作不予评分。评估指标包括静态合规率K、基于工具的行动合规率A以及两者之差G。
AI.result: 在三个中文销售领域、24个策略原子和42个语义核心的R2A-Sales基准测试中，静态合规率K接近100%（89.9%-99.1%），但八种不同模型（包括Qwen3-8B的四种提示处理方式）的实际行动合规率A仅为3.0%-17.3%，规则到动作的差距G高达80.4%-92.5%。
AI.conclusion: R2A-Sales基准表明，销售代理的可靠性必须在实际执行的行动层面进行衡量，而不能仅仅依赖于规则的复述或任务的完成情况。当前的LLM销售代理在规则转化为实际行动方面存在显著不足。
AI.translation: 基于LLM的销售代理通常在静态策略问题或任务成功率方面进行评估，但实际部署提出了一个更尖锐的问题：当模型能够陈述规则时，它能否在商业压力下选择合规的、基于工具的行动？我们引入了R2A-Sales（Rule-to-Action），一个用于此问题的策略原子匹配基准。每个条目将一个静态探测项与一个多轮销售场景配对，这些场景共享相同的版本化策略原子、事实、证据、行为约束和工具契约，因此差异不能归因于策略内容不匹配。在交互式环节中，代码拥有的账本会验证已提交的工具效果和终端状态；不支持的行动主张不会获得任何积分。我们报告了静态合规率K、基于工具的行动合规率A = Pr（安全终止且无硬性违规且非回声），以及匹配的差距G = K - A。此次冻结发布涵盖了三个受控的中文销售领域、24个策略原子、42个语义核心和2,016个匹配对。验证性研究审计了19个核心的21,888次运行，涵盖了八个主干模型以及四个Qwen3-8B提示处理方式（12种配置）。静态合规率接近上限（K = 89.9% - 99.1%），然而八个主干模型的行动合规率仅为A = 3.0% - 17.3%，导致G = 80.4% - 92.5个百分点。由于A也要求安全终止，G上限了规则到行动的退化，而不是单独隔离压力。没有一种仅通过提示处理的方式能在所有指标上占优。R2A-Sales表明，销售代理的可靠性必须在已提交的行动层面进行衡量，而不仅仅是规则复述或任务完成。
AI.summary: R2A-Sales是一个新提出的基准，旨在解决LLM销售代理在实际应用中将规则转化为合规行动的挑战。该基准通过匹配静态规则和动态销售场景，并严格验证行动的合规性，揭示了当前LLM代理在规则理解和实际行动执行之间存在巨大差距。研究结果强调了在评估销售代理时，关注实际行动而非仅仅规则陈述的重要性。
AI.keywords: LLM销售代理, 规则到行动差距, R2A-Sales基准, 行动合规性, 商业压力
AI.comments: 该研究提出的R2A-Sales基准具有重要的实际意义，它弥补了现有评估方法在模拟真实商业压力和复杂交互场景方面的不足。研究结果揭示了LLM在从规则到行动的转化过程中存在的普遍性问题，为后续改进LLM在关键任务中的可靠性提供了明确的方向。然而，该基准的有效性在多大程度上受到特定领域和语言的限制，以及如何进一步缩小规则-行动差距，仍是值得进一步探索的问题。

title: HuGe: Scaling Humanoid Generalist Vision-Language-Action Models with Egocentric Experience
summary: Extending Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) to humanoid robots requires coordinated whole-body control and diverse demonstrations that are costly to collect in real-world scenarios. Although egocentric human demonstrations provide a complementary source of task experience, differences in visual embodiment and missing robot proprioception complicate transfer to humanoid policies. To address these challenges, we introduce HuGe, a family of Humanoid Generalist VLAs pre-trained on over 2,000 hours of egocentric human and robot data. Specifically, HuGe employs three existing representative VLA architectures to predict latent motion tokens for a pretrained whole-body controller, together with hand-control signals. Based on this, we introduce a three-stage training pipeline that combines egocentric pre-training, humanoid adaptation, and downstream fine-tuning. To facilitate transfer across embodiments, we construct pseudo-proprioceptive states through simulation playback during pre-training and modify arm appearance in egocentric observations through re-rendering during downstream fine-tuning. With this pipeline, HuGe achieves the state-of-the-art on simulation benchmark HumanoidArena. Furthermore, real-world experiments on the Unitree G1 indicate that augmenting robot demonstrations with visually adapted egocentric demonstrations significantly increases success on a pick-and-drop task.

AI.title_translation: HuGe：利用第一人称经验扩展人形机器人通用视觉-语言-动作模型
AI.tldr: HuGe通过利用海量第一人称人类经验和创新的具身适配策略，成功训练出高性能的人形机器人通用VLA模型。
AI.motivation: 将视觉-语言-动作模型（VLAs）扩展到人形机器人需要协调的全身控制和多样化的示范数据，而这在真实世界中收集成本高昂；虽然第一人称人类示范可以作为补充，但视觉具身差异和机器人本体感觉的缺失阻碍了策略向人形机器人的迁移。
AI.method: 提出HuGe模型族，利用三种现有的VLA架构预测预训练全身控制器的潜在运动动作和手部控制信号；设计了包含第一人称预训练、人形适配和下游微调的三阶段训练管线；在预训练中使用模拟回放构建伪本体感觉状态，在微调中通过重新渲染修改第一人称观测中的手臂外观。
AI.result: HuGe在仿真基准HumanoidArena上达到了最先进（SOTA）的性能；在Unitree G1机器人上的真实世界实验表明，用视觉适配的第一人称示范来扩充机器人示范，显著提高了抓放任务的成功率。
AI.conclusion: HuGe通过整合大规模第一人称人类经验与机器人数据，结合独特的三阶段训练流程与具身适配策略，有效解决了人形机器人控制中的数据稀缺和具身差异问题，树立了人形机器人VLA模型的新标杆。
AI.translation: 将视觉-语言-动作模型（VLAs）扩展到人形机器人需要协调的全身控制和多样化的示范数据，这在真实世界中收集成本高昂。尽管第一人称人类示范提供了互补的任务经验源，但视觉具身差异和机器人本体感觉的缺失使向人形机器人策略的迁移变得复杂。为了解决这些挑战，我们推出了HuGe，这是一个在超过2000小时的第一人称人类和机器人数据上预训练的人形通用VLA模型族。具体而言，HuGe采用三种现有的代表性VLA架构来预测预训练全身控制器的潜在运动Token以及手部控制信号。在此基础上，我们引入了一个三阶段训练管线，结合了第一人称预训练、人形适配和下游微调。为了促进跨具身迁移，我们在预训练期间通过模拟回放构建伪本体感觉状态，并在下游微调期间通过重新渲染修改第一人称观测中的手臂外观。通过该管线，HuGe在仿真基准HumanoidArena上取得了最先进的成果。此外，在宇树G1（Unitree G1）上的真实世界实验表明，用视觉适配的第一人称示范来扩充机器人示范，显著提高了抓放任务的成功率。
AI.summary: 论文介绍了HuGe，这是一个基于超过2000小时的第一人称人类和机器人数据预训练的人形机器人通用VLA模型族。通过三阶段训练管线及伪本体感觉和外观重渲染等适配技术，HuGe成功克服了跨具身迁移的挑战，在仿真和真机实验中均取得了卓越的性能。
AI.keywords: Humanoid robots, Vision-Language-Action models, Egocentric experience, Whole-body control, Robot learning
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地提出结合第一人称人类视角与机器人数据来训练人形机器人通用视觉-语言-动作模型（HuGe），通过巧妙的模拟回放和外观重新渲染技术解决了具身差异和本体感觉缺失的难题，在仿真和真实世界中均展现出优异的性能。

title: The Policies of Programming Language Ecosystems: A "Qualitative" Analysis
summary: Programming language ecosystems (PLEs), such as CRAN for R, have greatly accelerated software reuse. At the same time, they have increased software supply-chain risks and incidents. However, the problems are not limited to cyber security; everything from illegal content and content moderation to harassment and sexual content are mentioned in many policies of popular PLEs. The paper examines these policies. According to a moderate agreement between the three authors on 38 distinct policy categories and eight PLE policies, the policies generally exhibit divergence rather than convergence. However, some policy categories, such as those about malware, intellectual property, and content removal, are universally recognized. The divergence is thus seen in more fine-grained policy categories, such as those related to package size limits, manipulation of metrics, typo-squatting, and binary uploads. These and other related qualitative results patch a notable gap in existing PLE research.

AI.title_translation: 编程语言生态系统的政策：“定性”分析
AI.tldr: 论文对8个主流编程语言生态系统的政策进行了定性分析，发现整体策略存在分歧，但在核心安全和内容问题上存在共识。
AI.motivation: 编程语言生态系统（PLE）虽然加速了软件复用，但也带来了供应链风险及各种违规内容和安全问题，现有的PLE研究缺乏对其治理政策的系统分析。
AI.method: 通过三位作者在38个不同的政策类别和8个主流编程语言生态系统（PLE）政策上达成中度一致，进行了定性分析。
AI.result: 政策总体上表现出分歧大于趋同的趋势；不过，在恶意软件、知识产权和内容删除等类别上达成了普遍共识，而在包大小限制、指标操纵、错别字劫持和二进制上传等更细粒度的类别上存在分歧。
AI.conclusion: 编程语言生态系统的政策在宏观核心领域存在共识，但在精细化和边缘领域存在显著分歧，这填补了当前PLE治理研究的空白。
AI.translation: 诸如R语言的CRAN等编程语言生态系统（PLEs）极大地加速了软件复用。与此同时，它们也增加了软件供应链的风险和安全事件。然而，问题不仅限于网络安全；在许多流行PLE的政策中，从非法内容、内容审核到骚扰和色情内容等各种问题均有涉及。本文对这些政策进行了研究。根据三位作者对38个不同政策类别以及8个PLE政策达成的一致性评估，这些政策总体上表现出分歧而非趋同。不过，某些政策类别（如关于恶意软件、知识产权和内容删除的政策）得到了普遍认可。因此，分歧主要体现在更细粒度的政策类别中，例如与包大小限制、指标操纵、错别字劫持（typo-squatting）和二进制上传相关的政策。这些及其他相关的定性结果填补了现有PLE研究中的一个显著空白。
AI.summary: 该论文通过定性分析方法，研究了八个主流编程语言生态系统（PLE）的政策，发现它们在整体上表现出分歧，但在恶意软件和知识产权等核心问题上存在普遍共识，从而填补了该领域的文献空白。
AI.keywords: 编程语言生态系统, 政策分析, 软件供应链安全, 定性研究
AI.comments: 该论文首次对编程语言生态系统的治理政策进行了定性分析，填补了软件供应链安全及生态系统治理研究领域的空白，揭示了政策在宏观与微观层面的分歧与统一。

title: GeoPrompt: Geometry-Conditioned Prompt Learning for Underwater Open-Vocabulary Instance Segmentation
summary: Open-vocabulary instance segmentation (OVIS) provides a promising solution for marine perception by recognizing and segmenting categories beyond predefined label spaces. Existing OVIS methods usually rely on vision-language alignment, where visual region features are matched with textual category embeddings to recognize both seen and unseen classes. However, this alignment assumption becomes fragile in underwater environments. Color attenuation, scattering, turbidity, and low contrast distort visual appearance, causing region features to deviate from their corresponding semantic concepts. As a result, the similarity between degraded visual features and textual classifiers becomes unreliable, which particularly weakens the recognition of unseen underwater categories that cannot be corrected by category-specific supervision. To address these issues, we propose GeoPrompt, a geometry-conditioned prompt learning framework for underwater open-vocabulary instance segmentation. Our key insight is that geometric structure is more stable than visual appearance in degraded underwater scenes. Specifically, GeoPrompt introduces a geometry-guided visual adaptation module (GVAM) to extract depth-derived structural priors and inject them into multi-scale visual features. It further develops a geometry-conditioned prompt learning (GCPL) that generates geometry-aware textual classifiers from structural representations. These geometry-aware classifiers are integrated with fixed and image-conditioned textual classifiers to improve open-vocabulary semantic alignment. Experiments on the MARIS-OpenIS benchmark show that GeoPrompt achieves state-of-the-art performance and brings consistent improvements on underwater open-vocabulary instance segmentation.

AI.title_translation: GeoPrompt：用于水下开放词汇实例分割的几何条件提示学习
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为 GeoPrompt 的几何条件提示学习框架，利用更稳定的几何结构先验来解决水下视觉退化导致的视觉-语言对齐失效问题，在水下开放词汇实例分割任务中取得了最先进的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的开放词汇实例分割方法依赖于视觉-语言对齐，但在水下环境中，由于光线衰减、散射、浑浊和低对比度等因素，视觉外观严重退化，导致区域特征偏离语义概念，使得未见过类别的识别极其不可靠。因此，需要利用在水下环境中比视觉外观更稳定的几何结构来改善语义对齐。
AI.method: 提出了 GeoPrompt 框架，包含两个核心模块：1）几何引导视觉适应模块（GVAM），用于提取深度衍生的结构先验并注入多尺度视觉特征；2）几何条件提示学习（GCPL），用于从结构表示中生成几何感知的文本分类器，并将其与固定及图像条件文本分类器集成。
AI.result: 在 MARIS-OpenIS 基准测试上的实验表明，GeoPrompt 取得了最先进的性能，并为水下开放词汇实例分割带来了持续的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: GeoPrompt 框架通过结合深度衍生的几何结构先验与文本提示学习，显著提升了水下开放词汇实例分割的性能，在 MARIS-OpenIS 基准测试中达到了最先进的水平。
AI.translation: 开放词汇实例分割（OVIS）通过识别和分割超出预定义标签空间的类别，为海洋感知提供了一个有前景的解决方案。现有的 OVIS 方法通常依赖于视觉-语言对齐，其中视觉区域特征与文本类别嵌入相匹配，以识别见过和未见过的类别。然而，这种对齐假设在水下环境中变得脆弱。颜色衰减、散射、浑浊和低对比度扭曲了视觉外观，导致区域特征偏离其对应的语义概念。因此，退化后的视觉特征与文本分类器之间的相似性变得不可靠，这尤其削弱了无法通过特定类别监督来纠正的未见过的水下类别的识别。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了 GeoPrompt，一个用于水下开放词汇实例分割的几何条件提示学习框架。我们的核心洞察是，在退化的水下场景中，几何结构比视觉外观更稳定。具体来说，GeoPrompt 引入了一个几何引导视觉适应模块（GVAM），用于提取深度衍生的结构先验并将其注入多尺度视觉特征中。它进一步开发了几何条件提示学习（GCPL），从结构表示中生成几何感知的文本分类器。这些几何感知分类器与固定及图像条件的文本分类器集成，以改善开放词汇的语义对齐。在 MARIS-OpenIS 基准测试上的实验表明，GeoPrompt 实现了最先进的性能，并为水下开放词汇实例分割带来了持续的改进。
AI.summary: 该论文针对水下开放词汇实例分割中因视觉退化导致的视觉-语言对齐失效问题，提出了一种名为 GeoPrompt 的几何条件提示学习框架。该方法通过引入深度衍生的几何结构先验来校正视觉特征，并生成几何感知的文本分类器，从而显著提升了水下场景中对未知类别的识别与分割能力。
AI.keywords: 水下开放词汇实例分割, 几何先验, 视觉-语言对齐, 提示学习, 结构感知分类器
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将几何先验引入水下开放词汇实例分割任务中，通过几何引导的视觉适应和提示学习，有效缓解了水下环境视觉退化带来的语义对齐偏差问题，具有很高的实用价值和理论意义。

title: Timing Matters Twice: When to Query and When to Skip in Flow-Matching On-Policy Distillation
summary:
On-policy distillation (OPD) enables flow-matching models to acquire complementary capabilities from specialized teachers through supervision on student-generated trajectories. However, different evaluation dimensions, such as aesthetics and OCR accuracy, and different tasks, such as image generation and editing, emphasize different aspects of the denoising process, suggesting that their effective supervision may occur at different stages.
