AI.translation: 由于多模态传感器在成像视点上的固有差异以及视野不匹配问题，现有的融合方法长期以来难以实现超越传感器视野限制的完整场景级信息整合。因此，生成的融合结果通常包含特定模态区域和融合伪影，限制了场景结构和语义信息的全面表示。为了解决这一挑战，我们提出了一个生成式配准-融合框架，命名为SeeRF。具体来说，它首先引入基于微分同胚平稳速度场的变形生成策略，结合视觉基础模型引导的特征提取和从粗到精的渐进式多模态图像配准模块，以实现精确的跨模态流估计并生成有效的视野掩码。随后，配准模块与生成扩散模块紧密耦合进行多模态补全和融合，其中跨模态控制编码模块和控制残差特征编解码器机制提供有效指导。通过利用生成扩散模型强大的先验建模能力，所提出的框架克服了共享视野的限制，并实现了对非重叠视野区域的有效补全和自然融合。在多个公共数据集和真实世界场景上的广泛实验表明，所提出的方法取得了卓越的性能，验证了其有效性、优越性和鲁棒性。代码将发布在 https://github.com/XunpengYi/SeeRF。
AI.summary: 本文提出了SeeRF，一个生成式配准-融合框架，旨在解决多模态传感器因视点和视野不匹配导致现有融合方法无法实现完整场景信息整合的问题。SeeRF通过结合基于微分同胚平稳速度场的变形生成、视觉基础模型引导的特征提取和渐进式多模态图像配准，实现精确的跨模态流估计和视野掩码生成。随后，将配准模块与生成扩散模型紧密耦合，利用其强大的先验建模能力进行多模态补全和融合，从而有效处理非重叠视野区域。实验结果验证了SeeRF在克服共享视野限制、实现有效补全和自然融合方面的优越性能。
AI.keywords: 生成式图像配准, 多模态融合, 超越视野, 扩散模型, 场景补全
AI.comments: 这篇论文通过引入生成扩散模型来解决多模态图像融合中视野不匹配的根本性挑战，具有创新性。它不仅仅关注重叠区域的融合，更进一步实现了对非重叠区域的补全，这在实际应用中具有重要意义，例如在自动驾驶和遥感等领域。结合视觉基础模型引导的特征提取也增强了方法的鲁棒性。

title: FedAvgIm: Federated Learning for Multi-Site Impedance Identification of Inverter-Based Resources
comments: Author-accepted manuscript (not the IEEE version of record)
summary: With the increasing integration of inverter-based resources (IBRs) into power systems, assessing small-signal interaction stability has become essential. Impedance/admittance models enable frequency-domain characterization of IBR dynamics without requiring access to proprietary internal control details, but measurement-based identification is time-consuming and must be repeated across operating points. This paper proposes FedAvgIm, a privacy-aware federated-learning framework for multi-site dq-admittance identification under severe local data scarcity and raw-data-locality constraints. Each IBR site trains a local feed-forward neural network using a small set of operating-point-frequency samples, while only model parameters are shared with a cloud aggregator that performs sample-size-weighted FedAvg to update a global model and broadcast it back to all sites. To demonstrate effectiveness, EMT measurement-based admittance datasets are constructed for nine grid-following IBRs with different parameters, architectures, measurement-noise levels, and non-IID settings, where each client has only 40-390 training samples. Results show that FedAvgIm achieves performance close to centralized training and consistently outperforms local-only learning and raw-data-locality-preserving transfer-learning baselines. Additional studies show that FedAvgIm maintains stable learning behavior under measurement noise and remains beneficial under moderate non-IID conditions. The estimated dq-admittance models are further applied to generalized Nyquist stability analysis and validated against EMT time-domain simulations under multiple operating points and grid-strength conditions.
comment: Author-accepted manuscript (not the IEEE version of record)

AI.title_translation: FedAvgIm：基于逆变器资源的多站点阻抗识别联邦学习
AI.tldr: FedAvgIm是一个联邦学习框架，用于在数据稀缺和隐私约束下，对多站点逆变器资源进行dq-导纳识别，并表现出接近集中式训练的性能。
AI.motivation: 随着基于逆变器的资源(IBRs)日益融入电力系统，评估小信号相互作用稳定性变得至关重要。阻抗/导纳模型可以表征IBRs的频率域动态，但基于测量的识别耗时且需要在不同运行点重复进行，同时面临本地数据稀缺和原始数据本地化限制。
AI.method: 论文提出了FedAvgIm，一个隐私感知的联邦学习框架，用于在多站点进行dq-导纳识别。每个IBRs站点使用少量运行点频率样本训练一个本地前馈神经网络，仅将模型参数共享给云聚合器。聚合器执行样本量加权的FedAvg来更新全局模型，并将其广播回所有站点。
AI.result: FedAvgIm的性能接近集中式训练，并持续优于单独本地学习和原始数据本地化保留的迁移学习基线。FedAvgIm在测量噪声下保持稳定的学习行为，并在适度的非独立同分布(non-IID)条件下仍然有益。估计的dq-导纳模型进一步应用于广义奈奎斯特稳定性分析，并通过EMT时域仿真在多个运行点和电网强度条件下得到验证。
AI.conclusion: FedAvgIm为解决基于逆变器资源的多站点阻抗识别中的数据稀缺和隐私问题提供了一个有效且鲁棒的联邦学习解决方案，其识别出的导纳模型可成功应用于系统稳定性分析。
AI.translation: 随着基于逆变器的资源（IBRs）日益融入电力系统，评估小信号相互作用稳定性已变得至关重要。阻抗/导纳模型能够对IBRs的频率域动态进行表征，而无需访问专有的内部控制细节，但基于测量的识别既耗时又必须在不同运行点重复进行。本文提出了FedAvgIm，一个隐私感知的联邦学习框架，用于在严重的本地数据稀缺和原始数据本地化约束下进行多站点dq-导纳识别。每个IBRs站点使用少量运行点频率样本训练一个本地前馈神经网络，同时只有模型参数与云聚合器共享，聚合器执行样本量加权的FedAvg来更新全局模型并将其广播回所有站点。为了证明其有效性，本文构建了九个具有不同参数、架构、测量噪声水平和非独立同分布（non-IID）设置的并网IBRs的EMT测量导纳数据集，其中每个客户端只有40-390个训练样本。结果表明，FedAvgIm的性能接近集中式训练，并持续优于单独本地学习和保留原始数据本地化的迁移学习基线。额外的研究表明，FedAvgIm在测量噪声下保持稳定的学习行为，并在适度的非独立同分布条件下仍然有益。估计的dq-导纳模型进一步应用于广义奈奎斯特稳定性分析，并通过EMT时域仿真在多个运行点和电网强度条件下得到验证。
AI.summary: 本文提出了FedAvgIm，一个针对基于逆变器资源（IBRs）的多站点dq-导纳识别的隐私感知联邦学习框架。面对数据稀缺和隐私限制，FedAvgIm允许各站点训练本地神经网络并仅共享模型参数进行全局模型聚合。实验证明，FedAvgIm在性能上接近集中式训练，优于基线方法，且在噪声和非独立同分布条件下表现稳定，其识别出的导纳模型可有效用于系统稳定性分析。
AI.keywords: 联邦学习, 逆变器资源, 阻抗识别, dq-导纳, 电力系统稳定性
AI.comments: 这篇论文通过引入联邦学习解决了基于逆变器资源阻抗识别中数据稀缺和隐私保护的关键挑战。其创新性在于将FedAvg范式应用于电力系统阻抗识别，在不共享原始数据的情况下实现了多站点模型协同训练。这对于保障电网稳定性和推动可再生能源并网具有重要意义，尤其是在数据隐私日益受到关注的背景下。

title: Dolphin broadband transient vocalization detection in impulsive ambient noise
summary: Passive acoustic monitoring in tropical waters such as those in Southeast Asia is hampered by the persistent, high-level impulsive noise of snapping shrimp. This is a particularly daunting challenge for detecting broadband transient vocalizations of dolphins - clicks, buzzes and burst-pulses. These vocalizations, unlike frequency-modulated whistles, share the broadband, impulsive character of the shrimp snaps and cannot be easily separated from them by frequency-localized or energy-based means. We develop TRIDENT, a lightweight waveform-based detector for these vocalizations, and apply it to 54.2 recorder-months of data from ten island sites around Singapore. We show that the training-data pipeline and the architecture are both important: controlled signal-to-noise-ratio based mixing to generate training data, appropriate normalization and hard negative mining, together steer the detector toward learning transient temporal structure rather than energy shortcuts. A single joint detector handles all three signal types better than specialized models for each, and outperforms established baselines. Applied to long-term recordings, it reveals tightly clustered, predominantly daytime activity, motivating days-with-detections as a robust indicator of cetacean presence.

AI.title_translation: 脉冲环境噪声下海豚宽带瞬时发声检测
AI.tldr: 本文开发了一种名为TRIDENT的轻量级波形检测器，成功在枪虾脉冲噪声干扰严重的热带水域中实现了对海豚宽带瞬时发声的高效检测。
AI.motivation: 热带水域中持续的高强度枪虾脉冲噪声阻碍了被动声学监测，特别是海豚的宽带瞬时发声（点击声、蜂鸣声和突发脉冲声）与枪虾脉冲具有相似的宽带和脉冲特征，难以通过常规的频率局部化或基于能量的方法进行分离。
AI.method: 开发了名为TRIDENT的轻量级波形检测器，采用了基于信噪比的控制混合训练数据生成、适当的归一化和难负样本挖掘等训练策略，并处理了来自新加坡十个岛屿地点的长期录音数据。
AI.result: 实验表明，单个联合检测器处理所有三种信号类型的效果优于针对每种信号的专用模型，并且性能优于现有的基线方法；长期应用揭示了海豚紧密聚集的、主要是日间的活动模式。
AI.conclusion: TRIDENT检测器能够有效克服枪虾噪声干扰，准确检测海豚宽带瞬时发声，并揭示了新加坡海域海豚的昼间活动模式。
AI.translation: 东南亚等热带水域的被动声学监测常常受到枪虾持续、高强度脉冲噪声的阻碍。这对于检测海豚的宽带瞬时发声（点击声、蜂鸣声和突发脉冲声）构成了特别严峻的挑战。这些发声与频率调制哨声不同，它们具有与枪虾喀哒声相同的宽带和脉冲特征，无法通过局频或基于能量的方法轻易将它们分离。我们开发了TRIDENT——一种针对这些发声的轻量级波形检测器，并将其应用于新加坡周围十个岛屿地点的54.2个录音机月的 数据中。我们表明，训练数据管道和架构都非常重要：基于信噪比控制混合生成训练数据、适当的归一化和难负样本挖掘，共同引导检测器学习瞬态时间结构而不是能量捷径。单个联合检测器处理所有三种信号类型的效果比每个信号的专用模型更好，并且优于已建立的基线。将其应用于长期录音，它揭示了紧密聚集的、主要是白天的活动，这使得“有检测的天数”成为鲸类存在的强大指标。
AI.summary: 论文提出了TRIDENT——一种轻量级的波形检测器，用于在充满枪虾噪声的热带海域中检测海豚的宽带瞬时发声。通过创新的训练数据管道和网络架构，该检测器成功克服了噪声干扰，优于现有基线，并成功应用于新加坡海域的长期监测。
AI.keywords: 被动声学监测, 海豚宽带发声, 枪虾噪声, 波形检测器, TRIDENT
AI.comments: 该论文针对热带海域（如东南亚）中枪虾脉冲噪声干扰严重的难题，开发了名为TRIDENT的轻量级波形检测器，用于海豚宽带瞬时发声的检测。创新点在于通过精心设计的训练数据管道（信噪比混合、归一化、难负样本挖掘）引导模型学习瞬时时间结构而非能量捷径，且单一体化模型效果优于专用模型。

title: VPR-Space: A Benchmark for Visual Place Recognition in Space Analog Domains
summary: Visual Place Recognition (VPR) is an important means for loop closure detection in visual Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM). While state-of-the-art VPR and SLAM approaches excel in urban and feature-rich natural environments, the vast and feature-poor environments of extraterrestrial surfaces like on the Moon or Mars pose severe challenges for existing approaches. This paper presents a novel benchmark, VPR-Space, to evaluate VPR capabilities on extraterrestrial surfaces. There are three contributions: (1) We collected sixteen VPR database-query datasets based on existing data from Space Analog Domains (SAD), terrestrial environments that resemble properties of the Moon or Mars. The collection includes a range of challenges regarding environment, viewpoint change, and illumination conditions. (2) To address the ill-posed nature of VPR, we propose a novel approach to generate the ground-truth information in VPR benchmarks. Instead of defining that a query and datbase image show the same place if and only if their camera poses are within fixed position and viewing direction thresholds, we propose to make the decision dependent on whether the match would be valuable in the downstream SLAM task. To avoid the overhead and restrictions of evaluating VPR in-the-loop within SLAM systems, we provide VPR ground-truth (GT) matrices based on the performance of an ensemble of state-of-the-art Relative Pose Estimators (RPE). Under this GT we require a VPR method to identify exactly those image pairs for which a subsequently applied RPE is expected to provide a valuable pose estimate in a SLAM context. (3) We evaluated nine state-of-the-art VPR approaches. The results show considerable room for improvement and indicate directions for future research. We provide a pre-release version of the dataset on github: $\texttt{https://github.com/rfechner/VPR-Space}$

AI.title_translation: VPR-Space: 空间模拟领域视觉地点识别基准
AI.tldr: 本文提出了VPR-Space，一个用于在类地外表面评估视觉地点识别（VPR）的新基准，并评估了现有方法，发现有很大的改进空间。
AI.motivation: 现有的视觉地点识别（VPR）和同步定位与建图（SLAM）方法在城市和特征丰富的自然环境中表现出色，但在月球或火星等外星表面广阔且特征贫乏的环境中面临严峻挑战。因此，需要一个基准来评估VPR在外星表面的能力。
AI.method: 1. 收集了十六个基于现有空间模拟领域（SAD）数据的VPR数据库-查询数据集，涵盖了环境、视角变化和光照条件等方面的挑战。2. 提出了一种新颖的VPR基准地面真实信息生成方法，该方法不再仅仅依赖于固定位置和视线方向阈值，而是根据匹配在下游SLAM任务中的价值来决定，并通过最先进的相对位姿估计器（RPE）集成来提供VPR地面真实（GT）矩阵。3. 评估了九种最先进的VPR方法。
AI.result: 评估结果显示，现有方法仍有相当大的改进空间，并为未来的研究指明了方向。
AI.conclusion: 现有的VPR方法不足以应对外星表面环境的挑战。VPR-Space基准为评估和开发在该类具有挑战性领域中鲁棒的VPR系统提供了宝贵的工具，并指明了未来的研究方向。
AI.translation: 视觉地点识别（VPR）是视觉同步定位与建图（SLAM）中闭环检测的重要手段。尽管最先进的VPR和SLAM方法在城市和特征丰富的自然环境中表现出色，但月球或火星等外星表面广阔且特征贫乏的环境对外现有方法构成了严峻挑战。本文提出了一个新颖的基准VPR-Space，用于评估外星表面上的VPR能力。本文有三个贡献：(1) 我们基于现有空间模拟领域（SAD）的数据收集了十六个VPR数据库-查询数据集，SAD是类似于月球或火星特征的地面环境。这些数据集涵盖了环境、视角变化和光照条件等一系列挑战。(2) 为了解决VPR的病态性质，我们提出了一种新颖的方法来生成VPR基准中的地面真实信息。我们不再定义查询和数据库图像仅在其相机位姿在固定位置和视线方向阈值内时才显示相同地点，而是建议根据匹配在下游SLAM任务中是否有价值来做出决定。为了避免在SLAM系统内循环评估VPR的开销和限制，我们提供了基于最先进的相对位姿估计器（RPE）集成的VPR地面真实（GT）矩阵。在此GT下，我们要求VPR方法识别出那些后续应用的RPE有望在SLAM上下文中提供有价值位姿估计的图像对。(3) 我们评估了九种最先进的VPR方法。结果表明，仍有相当大的改进空间，并为未来的研究指明了方向。我们在github上提供了数据集的预发布版本：$	exttt{https://github.com/rfechner/VPR-Space}$
AI.summary: 本文介绍了VPR-Space，一个用于评估在外星表面等挑战性环境中视觉地点识别（VPR）能力的新基准。该基准包含从空间模拟领域收集的十六个数据集，并提出了一种创新的地面真实信息生成方法，该方法基于匹配对下游SLAM任务的实用性，并利用相对位姿估计器集成。对九种最先进VPR方法的评估显示，在这些特定环境中仍有显著的改进空间，为未来的研究提供了方向。
AI.keywords: 视觉地点识别, SLAM, 空间模拟领域, 基准, 地面真实生成
AI.comments: 该论文通过关注外星环境，填补了VPR研究中的一个关键空白，这些环境与典型的城市/自然环境显著不同。其新颖的地面真实信息生成方法，将VPR性能直接与SLAM实用性联系起来，是一项重要创新，因为它超越了简单的位姿阈值，采用了更具实际相关性的指标。这个基准对于开发用于空间探索的鲁棒VPR系统至关重要。

title: Proofs of strong forms of the Bovdi--Geche universality conjecture and a complex analogue
summary: We prove two universality theorems for neural networks consisting of a single neuron. First we prove a strong form of the Bovdi--Geche universality conjecture on neurons over finite fields, where the activation function is a certain modification of the discrete logarithm, using the Weil bound on multiplicative character sums over finite fields. Then we show a generalisation of Aizenberg's universality theorem for complex binary neurons with a weight vector independent of the target function, positively answering another question in the literature. The proof of the latter uses an equidistribution theorem for the dilates of certain maps into tori.

AI.title_translation: Bovdi-Geche泛化猜想强形式的证明及一个复数类似物
AI.tldr: 本文证明了单神经元神经网络中Bovdi-Geche猜想的强形式，并推广了复数二元神经元的泛化定理。
AI.motivation: 为了解决关于单神经元神经网络泛化能力的Bovdi-Geche猜想的强形式，并回答文献中关于复数二元神经元泛化定理的开放性问题。
AI.method: 利用有限域上乘法特征和的韦尔界（Weil bound）证明了有限域上神经元的Bovdi-Geche猜想强形式；利用关于环面映射膨胀的等分布定理证明了复数二元神经元的泛化定理。
AI.result: 证明了有限域上具有特定离散对数修改激活函数的单神经元神经网络的Bovdi-Geche猜想强形式，并推广了Aizenberg关于具有权重向量与目标函数无关的复数二元神经元的泛化定理。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功证明了有限域上Bovdi-Geche猜想的强形式，并推广了Aizenberg关于复数二元神经元的泛化定理，为神经网络的理论研究做出了贡献。
AI.translation: 我们证明了关于由单个神经元组成的神经网络的两个泛化定理。首先，我们利用有限域上乘法特征和的韦尔界（Weil bound），证明了激活函数是离散对数某种修改形式的有限域上神经元的Bovdi-Geche泛化猜想的强形式。然后，我们展示了Aizenberg关于复数二元神经元泛化定理的推广，其权重向量与目标函数无关，从而对文献中的另一个问题给出了肯定的回答。后者的证明利用了关于环面映射膨胀的等分布定理。
AI.summary: 本文针对由单个神经元组成的神经网络，证明了有限域上Bovdi-Geche泛化猜想的强形式，并推广了Aizenberg关于复数二元神经元的泛化定理，解决了文献中的相关问题。
AI.keywords: 神经网络, 泛化猜想, 有限域, 离散对数, 复数神经元
AI.comments: 本文在单神经元神经网络的泛化能力研究中取得了重要进展，不仅证明了Bovdi-Geche猜想的强形式，还解决了复数二元神经元文献中的一个开放性问题，数学工具（如韦尔界和等分布定理）的应用非常精妙。

title: TRON: Transferring Naturally Evolved Network Architectures into Neuroevolution
summary: Neural architecture search (NAS) is challenging because of the vast, non-linear space of artificial neural network (ANN) topologies. Evolutionary methods can generate architectures, but their effectiveness is limited by difficulties in preserving functional organization during mutation and recombination. Naturally evolved biological networks may provide organizational principles that support adaptation and evolvability. Here, we introduce TRON (TRansfer Of Natural networks), a neuroevolution framework that uses experimentally characterized protein-protein interaction (PPI) networks as architectural priors. Instead of starting from random topologies, TRON reuses biological interaction patterns as structural building blocks. It combines classical evolutionary operators with neuroevolution-inspired mechanisms, including speciation, and introduces species quarantine to protect newly generated architectures during early maturation. We evaluated TRON against established evolutionary and neuroevolutionary methods on three classification benchmarks (CORA, CITESEER, and PUBMED) and three regression benchmarks (DIABETES, FRIEDMAN, and CALIFORNIA). TRON achieved the highest predictive performance among the evaluated methods on all classification datasets and most regression tasks. It showed substantially lower variability across independent runs, indicating greater robustness and convergence stability, at increased computational cost. These findings support the use of PPI networks as effective architectural priors and suggest that biologically derived interaction networks provide more favorable substrates for neuroevolution than random topologies. More broadly, TRON demonstrates the feasibility of transferring naturally evolved network architectures into artificial intelligence systems, offering a direction for improving evolvability in NAS through the reuse of biological organizational principles.

AI.title_translation: TRON：将自然进化的网络架构转移到神经进化中
AI.tldr: 利用生物蛋白质相互作用网络作为结构先验的神经进化框架TRON，显著提升了神经网络架构搜索（NAS）的预测性能和稳定性。
AI.motivation: 神经网络架构搜索（NAS）由于人工神经网络拓扑结构的巨大且非线性的空间而面临挑战。虽然进化方法可以生成架构，但其有效性受到在突变和重组过程中保持功能组织困难的限制，而自然进化的生物网络可能提供支持适应性和可进化性的组织原则。
AI.method: 提出TRON（TRansfer Of Natural networks）框架，将实验表征的蛋白质相互作用（PPI）网络用作架构先验，结合经典进化算子与物种隔离机制（保护早期成熟的架构）。在三个分类基准和三个回归基准上与传统进化/神经进化方法进行了对比评估。
AI.result: TRON在所有分类数据集以及大多数回归任务上均取得了最高的预测性能，并且在独立运行中表现出显著较低的可变性（更高的鲁棒性和收敛稳定性），但付出了更高的计算成本。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，利用PPI网络作为架构先验能够显著提高神经进化的预测性能、鲁棒性和收敛稳定性，证实了将自然进化网络拓扑转移到人工智能系统中的可行性。
AI.translation: 神经网络架构搜索（NAS）由于人工神经网络（ANN）拓扑结构的巨大且非线性空间而具有挑战性。进化方法可以生成架构，但其有效性受到在突变和重组过程中难以保持功能组织的限制。自然进化的生物网络可能提供支持适应性和可进化性的组织原则。在这里，我们介绍了TRON（自然网络的转移），这是一个将实验表征的蛋白质相互作用（PPI）网络用作架构先验的神经进化框架。TRON没有从随机拓扑开始，而是重用生物相互作用模式作为结构构建块。它将经典的进化算子与受神经进化启发的机制（包括物种形成）结合起来，并引入了物种隔离来保护新生成的架构在早期成熟阶段的安全。我们在三个分类基准（CORA、CITESEER和PUBMED）和三个回归基准（DIABETES、FRIEDMAN和CALIFORNIA）上评估了TRON与已建立的进化和神经进化方法。在所有分类数据集和大多数回归任务中，TRON在评估的方法中实现了最高的预测性能。它在独立运行中表现出显著更低的变异性，表明在增加计算成本的同时，具有更高的鲁棒性和收敛稳定性。这些发现支持将PPI网络用作有效的架构先验，并表明生物衍生网络比随机拓扑为神经进化提供了更有利的底物。更广泛地说，TRON证明了将自然进化的网络架构转移到人工智能系统中的可行性，为通过重用生物组织原则来提高NAS中的可进化性提供了一个方向。
AI.summary: 论文介绍了TRON框架，该框架利用蛋白质相互作用网络作为结构先验来进行神经进化，并通过物种隔离机制保护新架构。实验证明其在分类和回归任务上具有优越的预测性能和鲁棒性。
AI.keywords: 神经网络架构搜索, 神经进化, 蛋白质相互作用网络, 结构先验, 进化算法
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将自然界中进化的蛋白质相互作用（PPI）网络作为神经架构搜索（NAS）的结构先验，并通过引入物种隔离机制来保护新生成的架构，从而有效提升了神经进化算法的性能和收敛稳定性。尽管计算成本有所增加，但为结合生物学原理改进AI提供了有价值的方向。

title: RLNC vs Reed-Solomon in Satellite Channels: Crossover Analysis and the Bridging Property
summary: Satellite communication systems are increasingly relied upon for connectivity in remote areas and are expected to play a pivotal role in 6G networks, operating under high round-trip times and packet loss where forward error correction is essential. This work evaluates Reed-Solomon (RS) coding, Random Linear Network Coding (RLNC), and a combined RS+RLNC hybrid over a three-hop satellite channel whose loss statistics are derived from orbital geometry and link-budget calculations rather than assumed, comparing RS and RLNC at matched code rates of 0.800. The central finding is the \emph{bridging property} of RLNC: every RS code rate collapses above a crossover threshold $p^*$, while RLNC operates continuously through all failure regions with overhead growing as $1/(1-p)$. At rate~0.800, $p^* \approx 0.21$. Under the derived satcom channel with mean burst duration 166~minutes, RS$(255,204)$ is impractical despite an average loss rate of 1%, while RLNC requires 15.5~Mbit to recover all 1000 packets. An RS+RLNC hybrid reduces overhead by 19% relative to pure RLNC at BER$=10^{-3}$. To the authors' knowledge, this is the first analytical derivation of the rate-normalised crossover $p^*$ between RS and RLNC and the first experimental confirmation of the bridging property under a physically derived satellite channel model.

AI.title_translation: 卫星信道中的RLNC与Reed-Solomon码：交叉分析与桥接属性
AI.tldr: 本文研究了卫星信道下RLNC与Reed-Solomon码的性能表现，首次导出了两者的交叉阈值，并证明了RLNC能够跨越所有丢包区域的“桥接属性”。
AI.motivation: 卫星通信系统在高往返时延和丢包率下运行，前向纠错至关重要。本文旨在评估并对比传统Reed-Solomon码与随机线性网络编码（RLNC）以及它们的混合方案在基于物理导出的卫星信道模型下的性能表现。
AI.method: 评估了Reed-Solomon (RS) 编码、随机线性网络编码 (RLNC) 以及RS+RLNC混合编码在三跳卫星信道（其丢包统计基于轨道几何和链路预算计算得出）上的性能，并在0.800的匹配码率下进行了对比。
AI.result: 发现了RLNC的“桥接属性”：每个RS码率在交叉阈值 $p^*$ 以上均会失效，而RLNC能在所有失败区域连续运行；在速率0.800下，$p^* \approx 0.21$；在平均突发持续时间为166分钟的卫星信道下，RS$(255,204)$不切实际，而RLNC表现出良好的恢复能力，且RS+RLNC混合方案相比纯RLNC可降低19%的开销。
AI.conclusion: RLNC展现出优于RS码的连续适应能力，而结合RS与RLNC的混合方案能有效降低高误码率下的开销，非常适合具有长往返时延与突发丢包特征的6G卫星通信网络。
AI.translation: 卫星通信系统日益被用于偏远地区的连接，预计将在6G网络中发挥关键作用。这些系统在高往返时间和丢包率下运行，前向纠错至关重要。本工作评估了Reed-Solomon（RS）编码、随机线性网络编码（RLNC）以及组合的RS+RLNC混合编码在三跳卫星信道上的性能，该信道的丢包统计由轨道几何和链路预算计算得出而非假设，并在0.800的匹配码率下对比了RS和RLNC。核心发现是RLNC的“桥接属性”：每个RS码率在超过交叉阈值 $p^*$ 后都会崩溃，而RLNC在所有失败区域连续运行，开销随 $1/(1-p)$ 增长。在速率0.800下，$p^* \approx 0.21$。在平均突发持续时间为166分钟的推导卫星信道下，尽管平均丢包率为1%，RS$(255,204)$仍不切实际，而RLNC需要15.5 Mbit来恢复所有1000个数据包。在BER$=10^{-3}$时，RS+RLNC混合方案相比纯RLNC减少了19%的开销。据作者所知，这是首次对RS和RLNC之间速率归一化交叉点 $p^*$ 进行解析推导，也是首次在物理推导的卫星信道模型下对桥接属性进行实验确认。
AI.summary: 本文评估并比较了Reed-Solomon码、随机线性网络编码（RLNC）及混合编码在物理推导出的卫星信道模型下的性能，揭示了RLNC的“桥接属性”及与RS码的交叉阈值，证明了RLNC及其混合方案在应对卫星网络丢包方面的显著优势。
AI.keywords: 卫星通信, 随机线性网络编码 (RLNC), Reed-Solomon码, 前向纠错, 6G网络
AI.comments: 该论文首次针对卫星信道分析并导出了Reed-Solomon码与随机线性网络编码（RLNC）之间的交叉阈值，并展示了RLNC的“桥接属性”，为6G卫星网络的前向纠错设计提供了重要的理论支持与混合编码优化方案。

title: FLOWSTEP: A Framework for Learning to Predict GitHub Actions Workflow STEPs
summary: Continuous Integration and Delivery (CI/CD) are fundamental to modern software development, yet configuring pipelines such as GitHub Actions (GHA) workflows remains complex and error-prone. Recent work has explored Transformer-based models for GHA workflow recommendation, but existing approaches typically model workflow steps as a single homogeneous generation task. This formulation overlooks a key distinction: reusable Actions are structured, ecosystem-level components, whereas project-specific Scripts encode local build, test, and deployment semantics. Consequently, current models struggle to capture the different forms of knowledge required for accurate workflow completion. In this work, we present FLOWSTEP, a framework for GHA workflow step completion that explicitly distinguishes between Action and Script generation. FLOWSTEP combines large language models (LLMs) with contrastive learning to better capture semantic relationships among workflow contexts, Actions, and Scripts. Evaluated on established benchmarks, FLOWSTEP improves end-to-end workflow step prediction accuracy from 38.23% to 51.09%. Beyond prediction accuracy, we further study whether LLM-as-a-judge can provide a more semantic evaluation of generated workflow steps. By comparing LLM-based assessments with human annotations, we find that the best-performing model configuration reaches substantial agreement with human ground truth (Krippendorff's alpha = 0.701), suggesting that LLM-as-a-judge can serve as a scalable complement to manual evaluation.

AI.title_translation: FLOWSTEP：一个学习预测 GitHub Actions 工作流步骤的框架
AI.tldr: FLOWSTEP 框架通过区分 Action 和 Script 生成，结合大型语言模型和对比学习，显著提高了 GitHub Actions 工作流步骤的预测准确性，并提出 LLM-as-a-judge 作为可扩展的评估方法。
AI.motivation: 配置持续集成和交付（CI/CD）管道（如 GitHub Actions 工作流）复杂且容易出错。现有基于 Transformer 的模型将工作流步骤视为同质生成任务，忽略了可重用 Actions 和项目特定 Scripts 之间的关键区别，导致难以准确捕捉所需的不同形式知识。
AI.method: FLOWSTEP 是一个用于 GHA 工作流步骤完成的框架，它明确区分 Action 和 Script 的生成。它将大型语言模型（LLMs）与对比学习相结合，以更好地捕捉工作流上下文、Actions 和 Scripts 之间的语义关系。
AI.result: FLOWSTEP 将端到端工作流步骤预测准确率从 38.23% 提高到 51.09%。此外，通过比较 LLM-based 评估与人工标注，发现性能最佳的模型配置与人类真实情况达到实质性一致（Krippendorff's alpha = 0.701）。
AI.conclusion: FLOWSTEP 框架通过显式区分 Action 和 Script 生成，显著提高了 GitHub Actions 工作流步骤的预测准确性。同时，LLM-as-a-judge 被证明可以作为人工评估的可扩展补充，为生成的步骤提供更语义化的评估。
AI.translation: 持续集成和交付（CI/CD）是现代软件开发的基础，但配置诸如 GitHub Actions (GHA) 工作流之类的管道仍然复杂且容易出错。最近的研究探索了基于 Transformer 的模型用于 GHA 工作流推荐，但现有方法通常将工作流步骤建模为单一的同质生成任务。这种表述忽略了一个关键区别：可重用 Actions 是结构化的、生态系统级别的组件，而项目特定的 Scripts 编码了本地构建、测试和部署的语义。因此，当前模型难以捕捉准确完成工作流所需的各种形式的知识。在这项工作中，我们提出了 FLOWSTEP，一个用于 GHA 工作流步骤完成的框架，它明确区分 Action 和 Script 的生成。FLOWSTEP 将大型语言模型（LLMs）与对比学习相结合，以更好地捕捉工作流上下文、Actions 和 Scripts 之间的语义关系。在既定基准上进行评估，FLOWSTEP 将端到端工作流步骤预测准确率从 38.23% 提高到 51.09%。除了预测准确性之外，我们还进一步研究了 LLM-as-a-judge 是否可以为生成的工流步骤提供更语义化的评估。通过将基于 LLM 的评估与人工标注进行比较，我们发现性能最佳的模型配置与人类真实情况达到实质性一致（Krippendorff's alpha = 0.701），这表明 LLM-as-a-judge 可以作为人工评估的可扩展补充。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了 FLOWSTEP，一个用于 GitHub Actions (GHA) 工作流步骤完成的框架，旨在解决现有模型将工作流步骤视为单一同质生成任务的局限性。FLOWSTEP 明确区分可重用 Actions 和项目特定 Scripts 的生成，并结合大型语言模型（LLMs）与对比学习来捕捉复杂的语义关系。在既定基准测试中，FLOWSTEP 将端到端工作流步骤预测准确率从 38.23% 提升至 51.09%。此外，研究还探索了 LLM-as-a-judge 作为一种语义评估方法，并发现其与人类标注具有高度一致性，表明其可以作为手动评估的有效补充。
AI.keywords: GitHub Actions, 工作流预测, CI/CD, 大型语言模型, 对比学习
AI.comments: FLOWSTEP 的创新之处在于它明确区分了 GitHub Actions 工作流中的 Action 和 Script 类型，这解决了现有模型在处理不同类型知识时的局限性。结合 LLM 和对比学习是一个强有力的方法，能更好地捕捉上下文语义。此外，提出 LLM-as-a-judge 作为评估工具，为自动化和可扩展的评估提供了新的视角，对于降低人工评估成本和提高评估效率具有重要意义。

title: Active Learning of Conditional Generative Models via the Transport Neural Tangent Kernel
summary: Many high-throughput scientific experiments produce distributional outputs, requiring conditional generative models to interpret the data, and to predict outcomes at new inputs. Acquiring experimental data at new conditions (e.g., for a new antigen or a new cell type) is often expensive, motivating the need for automated experimental design methods. However, existing active learning frameworks are limited as they assume scalar or vector-valued outputs. We first show that the Wasserstein test risk of a conditional generative task decomposes into a mean term and a shape term, demonstrating why mean-based active learning is blind to distributional shape. To capture both, we propose the transport Neural Tangent Kernel (tNTK), a tractable kernel that measures how sensitive a generative model's predicted distribution is with respect to its parameters. The tNTK recovers the standard NTK in the deterministic limit and upper-bounds the posterior Fréchet variance of the prediction under small parameter perturbations. It admits a closed-form expression for affine Gaussian transport and tractable Monte Carlo estimators otherwise. Treating the tNTK as the covariance function of a Gaussian process, we greedily select inputs that minimize the total GP posterior variance across the pool, yielding a distribution-aware active learning strategy. We evaluate this strategy across four classes of conditional generative models, including conditional flow matching and conditional Monge gap, on synthetic distributions, intent-labeled sentences, and single-cell perturbation responses. In these experiments, the tNTK outperforms the baseline NTK computed from the conditional mean, demonstrating the value of distribution-aware active learning for generative-modeling tasks.

AI.title_translation: 通过传输神经切线核的主动学习条件生成模型
AI.tldr: 针对高通量实验的分布式输出，现有主动学习方法无法处理分布形状。本文提出传输神经切线核（tNTK），一个可追踪的核函数，用于衡量生成模型预测分布对参数的敏感性，并将其用于主动学习策略，以捕获分布形状。实验证明tNTK优于基于均值的NTK。
AI.motivation: 许多高通量科学实验产生分布式输出，需要条件生成模型来解释数据并预测新输入的结果。获取新条件下的实验数据通常成本高昂，因此需要自动化实验设计方法。然而，现有主动学习框架仅限于标量或向量值输出，无法感知分布形状。
AI.method: 首先，证明了条件生成任务的Wasserstein测试风险可分解为均值项和形状项，解释了为何基于均值的主动学习对分布形状是“盲”的。为了同时捕获均值和形状，本文提出了传输神经切线核（tNTK），这是一个可追踪的核函数，用于衡量生成模型预测分布对其参数的敏感性。tNTK在确定性极限下恢复标准NTK，并能上限估计小参数扰动下预测的后验Fréchet方差。对于仿射高斯传输，它具有闭式表达式，否则则有可追踪的蒙特卡洛估计器。将tNTK视为高斯过程的协方差函数，贪婪地选择使池中总GP后验方差最小的输入，从而形成一种分布感知的主动学习策略。
AI.result: tNTK在四类条件生成模型（包括条件流匹配和条件Monge间隙）上进行了评估，数据集涵盖合成分布、意图标注句子和单细胞扰动响应。实验结果表明，tNTK的性能优于根据条件均值计算的基线NTK，证明了分布感知主动学习对于生成建模任务的价值。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出了一种基于传输神经切线核（tNTK）的分布感知主动学习策略，有效解决了现有主动学习方法在处理高通量实验分布式输出时无法捕获分布形状的问题。实验结果证实了tNTK在条件生成建模任务中的优越性，突显了考虑分布形状进行主动学习的重要性。
AI.translation: 许多高通量科学实验产生分布式输出，需要条件生成模型来解释数据，并预测新输入的结果。在新条件下（例如，对于新的抗原或新的细胞类型）获取实验数据通常成本高昂，这促使人们需要自动化的实验设计方法。然而，现有主动学习框架受到限制，因为它们假设输出是标量或向量值。我们首先表明，条件生成任务的Wasserstein测试风险分解为均值项和形状项，这表明为什么基于均值的主动学习对分布形状是“盲”的。为了同时捕获两者，我们提出了传输神经切线核（tNTK），这是一个可追踪的核函数，用于衡量生成模型的预测分布对其参数的敏感程度。tNTK在确定性极限下恢复标准NTK，并在小参数扰动下上限估计预测的后验Fréchet方差。对于仿射高斯传输，它允许闭式表达式，否则则允许可追踪的蒙特卡洛估计器。将tNTK视为高斯过程的协方差函数，我们贪婪地选择使池中总GP后验方差最小的输入，从而产生一种分布感知的主动学习策略。我们在四类条件生成模型（包括条件流匹配和条件Monge间隙）上评估了这种策略，数据集包括合成分布、意图标注句子和单细胞扰动响应。在这些实验中，tNTK的性能优于根据条件均值计算的基线NTK，证明了分布感知主动学习对于生成建模任务的价值。
AI.summary: 本文针对高通量科学实验中产生的分布式输出，提出了一种新的主动学习框架。现有主动学习方法通常假设标量或向量输出，无法有效处理分布形状。作者首先揭示了条件生成任务的Wasserstein测试风险可分解为均值项和形状项，并提出了一种可追踪的传输神经切线核（tNTK）。tNTK能够衡量生成模型预测分布对其参数的敏感性，并能捕获分布的均值和形状信息。通过将tNTK作为高斯过程的协方差函数，本文开发了一种分布感知的主动学习策略，通过最小化总GP后验方差来选择新输入。在多种条件生成模型和数据集上的实验表明，tNTK显著优于基于条件均值计算的基线NTK，证明了其在生成建模任务中进行分布感知主动学习的有效性。
AI.keywords: 主动学习, 条件生成模型, 传输神经切线核, 分布感知, 高斯过程
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将神经切线核的概念扩展到处理分布式输出，解决了现有主动学习框架在处理高通量科学实验数据时无法感知分布形状的局限性。tNTK的提出为条件生成模型的实验设计提供了一种有效且理论上合理的工具，对需要处理复杂分布数据的主动学习领域具有重要意义。其理论分析和实验验证都展现了该方法的潜力。

title: Improving JEV Entailment Reranking with Span Readouts and Selective Adaptation
summary: JEV decision models pair a language model backbone with a lightweight scoring head to select among natural-language options. Direct selection compares candidate answers within one request, whereas entailment reranking evaluates each candidate in a separate natural language inference (NLI) request over fixed relation options. We examine whether the readout and adaptation choices used for direct selection remain effective for cross-request reranking. We combine a mean-span readout with selective backbone adaptation. Mean-span pooling replaces the option-ending pointer with an average of the contextualized states inside each NLI option, without adding head parameters. Selective adaptation retains low-rank updates in attention and gated DeltaNet projections while removing feed-forward adapters. On MC11, which averages accuracy over eleven reranking configurations from seven sources, selective adaptation improves NeoHorse-1-4B accuracy over the all-module baseline while cutting trainable parameters by more than half, and mean-span pooling yields further consistent gains at the same parameter count.

AI.title_translation: 改进JEV蕴含重排序的跨度读出和选择性适应
AI.tldr: 本文通过结合平均跨度读出和选择性骨干适应，显著提高了JEV蕴含重排序的准确性，同时大幅减少了可训练参数。
AI.motivation: 现有JEV决策模型在直接选择和蕴含重排序中使用的读出和适应策略可能不同。研究旨在探索用于直接选择的读出和适应策略是否对跨请求重排序仍然有效。
AI.method: 结合了平均跨度读出（mean-span pooling）和选择性骨干适应（selective backbone adaptation）。平均跨度读出用NLI选项内上下文状态的平均值替换了选项结束指针，不增加头部参数。选择性适应保留了注意力机制和门控DeltaNet投影中的低秩更新，同时移除了前馈适配器。
AI.result: 在MC11基准上，选择性适应在将可训练参数减少一半以上的同时，提高了NeoHorse-1-4B的准确性，超越了全模块基线。平均跨度池化在相同参数量下带来了进一步的持续增益。
AI.conclusion: 结合平均跨度读出和选择性骨干适应可以有效提升JEV蕴含重排序的性能，同时显著降低模型复杂度。
AI.translation: JEV决策模型将语言模型骨干与轻量级评分头配对，以在自然语言选项中进行选择。直接选择在一个请求中比较候选答案，而蕴含重排序在固定关系选项上，通过单独的自然语言推理（NLI）请求评估每个候选。我们研究用于直接选择的读出和适应选择是否对跨请求重排序仍然有效。我们结合了平均跨度读出和选择性骨干适应。平均跨度池化用每个NLI选项内上下文状态的平均值替换了选项结束指针，而无需增加头部参数。选择性适应在注意力机制和门控DeltaNet投影中保留了低秩更新，同时移除了前馈适配器。在MC11（该基准平均了来自七个来源的十一种重排序配置的准确性）上，选择性适应使NeoHorse-1-4B的准确性超过了全模块基线，同时将可训练参数减少了一半以上，并且平均跨度池化在相同参数量下带来了进一步的持续增益。
AI.summary: 本研究旨在优化JEV决策模型中的蕴含重排序任务。通过引入平均跨度读出（mean-span pooling）和选择性骨干适应（selective backbone adaptation）两种策略，研究者成功提升了模型性能。平均跨度读出通过平均NLI选项内的上下文状态来避免增加参数，而选择性适应则通过精简适配器减少了可训练参数。实验结果表明，这些改进在MC11基准上显著提高了NeoHorse-1-4B模型的准确性，同时大幅减少了模型的参数量。
AI.keywords: JEV决策模型, 蕴含重排序, 平均跨度读出, 选择性适应, 自然语言推理
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于提出了两种协同工作的方法（平均跨度读出和选择性骨干适应），有效地提升了JEV蕴含重排序任务的性能，同时显著降低了模型的计算成本和参数量。这种在保持甚至提升性能的同时，大幅减少模型复杂度的策略，对于实际部署和资源受限的环境具有重要意义。

title: A Hybrid Framework for Explainable Aviation Risk: Causal Chain Extraction from Safety Reports with Physics-Based Failure Quantification and Interventional Analysis
summary: Aviation authorities hold decades of accident reports whose narratives record how investigators reconstructed each accident. Computational work on these archives has mostly sorted reports into fixed taxonomies. In this work, we propose a hybrid framework in which a text-based corpus identifies the leading factors of a failure mode. Physics-based models then quantify how likely that failure is at a stated operating point. Ordered causal chains extracted from 56,202 American accident reports with a local large language model aggregate into a causation knowledge graph. On an evaluation sample of 2,000 reports, the chains recover 90.8% of investigator-flagged causes. Each physical factor whose drivers the record carries receives an occurrence model calibrated to the accident population. A leaky noisy-OR fitted to the corpus combines the factors into a failure mode probability that supports intervention. For engine power loss, the carburetor icing model separates 1,205 icing accidents from other accidents using temperature and dewpoint alone, reaching 0.61 in area under the receiver operating characteristic curve against a density ratio ceiling of 0.64. Routine weather hours give no valid control, because flying concentrates in fair weather. On later years the physics adds 0.03 to that area for occurrence and nothing for severity, so its value lies in interpretability. On four named accidents, abduction gives a probability of necessity of 0.29 to 0.50 for the heat omission, under monotonicity. The Fast Causal Inference algorithm does not license the largest backdoor adjustment on the learned networks.

AI.title_translation: 一个用于可解释航空风险的混合框架：结合物理故障量化与干预分析的安全报告因果链提取
AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个混合框架，通过大语言模型从航空安全报告中提取因果链，并结合物理模型量化故障概率，提升航空风险分析的可解释性。
AI.motivation: 传统的计算工作主要将航空事故报告分类到固定的分类法中，未能充分利用事故叙述中蕴含的因果重建信息，且缺乏将文本分析与物理故障量化及可解释干预分析相结合的有效框架。
AI.method: 利用本地大型语言模型从56,202份美国事故报告中提取有序因果链，并将其汇聚为因果知识图谱；结合物理模型对特定故障模式进行量化，并采用带噪声的或门（noisy-OR）与干预分析方法来计算故障概率并支持干预。
AI.result: 在2000份评估样本上，提取的因果链恢复了90.8%由调查人员标记的原因；针对发动机功率损失的化油器结冰模型在区分结冰事故时达到了0.61的AUC值（密度比上限为0.64），物理模型主要为系统带来了更高的可解释性。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的混合框架能有效提取因果链并结合物理模型量化故障概率，显著提升了航空事故分析的可解释性，尽管物理模型在某些情况下的主要价值在于可解释性而非显著提升预测精度。
AI.translation: 航空部门拥有数十年的事故报告，其叙述记录了调查人员如何重建每起事故。对这些档案的计算工作主要将报告分类到固定的分类法中。在这项工作中，我们提出了一个混合框架，其中基于文本的语料库可识别故障模式的主导因素。然后，基于物理的模型量化该故障在特定运行点发生的可能性。利用本地大型语言模型从56,202份美国事故报告中提取的有序因果链聚合为因果知识图谱。在2,000份报告的评估样本中，这些因果链恢复了90.8%由调查人员标记的原因。记录中包含其驱动因素的每个物理因素都会收到一个针对事故人群校准的发生率模型。拟合到语料库的泄漏噪声OR模型将这些因素组合成支持干预的故障模式概率。对于发动机功率损失，化油器结冰模型仅使用温度和露点就将1,205起结冰事故与其他事故区分开来，在受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUC）达到0.61（密度比上限为0.64）。例行天气时间没有提供有效的对照，因为飞行主要集中在好天气。在随后的几年里，物理学为发生率的面积增加了0.03，对严重程度没有增加，因此其价值在于可解释性。在四起命名的事故中，在单调性假设下，溯因推理给出的热量遗漏的必要性概率为0.29至0.50。快速因果推断算法不允许对所学习的网络进行最大的后门调整。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种混合框架，利用大语言模型从数万份航空事故报告中提取因果链，构建因果知识图谱，并结合物理模型进行故障量化与干预分析，从而实现可解释的航空风险评估。
AI.keywords: 航空风险, 因果链提取, 物理模型, 大语言模型, 可解释AI
AI.comments: 该论文将大语言模型提取的因果链与基于物理的故障量化模型相结合，构建了一个可解释的航空风险混合框架。创新点在于通过文本挖掘、知识图谱与物理模型相结合，增强了航空事故分析的可解释性与干预分析能力。

title: Environment Edits as a Corrective Signal for Reward Learning
comments: Accepted to CoRL 2026 Workshop on Learning from Corrections
summary: Robot corrections allow people to adjust a robot's behavior, but a single correction changes many features. Also, preferences about object attributes and relationships between objects cannot be expressed by moving the robot. We propose environment edits as a complementary form of feedback. The robot's motion is held constant as the human edits the scene, so the only explanation for the edit is the moved object. We introduce Feature Learning from Environmental and Robot-Relational Edit Traces (FERRET), which learns preferences from both robot and environment corrections. We show that environment edits are able to disambiguate features and learn preferences that robot corrections alone cannot.
comment: Accepted to CoRL 2026 Workshop on Learning from Corrections

AI.title_translation: 环境编辑作为奖励学习的纠正信号
AI.tldr: 本文提出通过人类直接编辑环境（而非移动机器人）作为奖励学习的补充反馈信号，并开发了FERRET算法，有效解决了传统机器人纠正无法表达物体属性及关系偏好的问题。
AI.motivation: 传统的机器人纠正存在单次纠正改变特征过多、且无法表达对物体属性及对象间关系偏好的局限性，因此需要一种互补的反馈形式。
AI.method: 提出了FERRET（Feature Learning from Environmental and Robot-Relational Edit Traces）方法，该方法能够同时从机器人和环境的纠正中学习人类的偏好。
AI.result: 实验表明，环境编辑能够成功区分特征，并学习到仅靠机器人纠正无法学习到的偏好。
AI.conclusion: 环境编辑作为一种补充性反馈信号，能够有效解决传统机器人纠正无法处理的属性和关系偏好问题，提高机器人奖励学习的准确性。
AI.translation: 机器人的纠正允许人们调整机器人的行为，但单次纠正会改变许多特征。此外，关于物体属性以及物体之间关系的偏好无法通过移动机器人来表达。我们提出了环境编辑作为一种互补的反馈形式。当人类编辑场景时，机器人的运动保持不变，因此对编辑的唯一解释就是被移动的物体。我们引入了基于环境和机器人关系编辑轨迹的特征学习（FERRET）方法，它能够从机器人和环境的纠正中学习偏好。我们证明了环境编辑能够区分特征并学习到仅靠机器人纠正无法学习的偏好。
AI.summary: 论文提出了一种利用“环境编辑”作为奖励学习纠正信号的方法，并开发了FERRET算法。该方法允许人类通过编辑场景而非移动机器人来提供反馈，从而能够学习到传统机器人纠正无法捕捉的物体属性及关系偏好。
AI.keywords: 环境编辑, 奖励学习, 机器人纠正, 特征学习, 偏好推断
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种新颖的奖励学习反馈形式——环境编辑，与传统的机器人轨迹纠正形成互补，有效解决了仅靠机器人移动无法表达对物体属性及关系偏好的局限性。创新点在于FERRET算法能够同时从机器人和环境纠正中学习偏好，具有很高的实用价值和理论意义。

title: SCAFFOLD under Hessian Similarity: Sharp Convergence Rates
summary: One of the main challenges of federated learning is heterogeneous data split among the clients, leading to biased local updates called client drift. The SCAFFOLD algorithm (Karimireddy et al., 2020) corrects client drift with control variates, but its relation to the similarity of client data is not yet fully understood: the original similarity-based guarantees cover only quadratics with a stronger second-order similarity assumption, and a follow-up weakly convex analysis (Luo et al., 2025) obtains a $\sqrt{Lδ}$ dependence for $L$-smooth losses with averaged Hessian similarity $δ$. We analyze SCAFFOLD with minibatch-based control variates and establish linear dependence on Hessian similarity beyond quadratics, for both convex and nonconvex objectives. In particular, for convex objectives with exact gradients, $R$ SCAFFOLD rounds with $K$ local steps lead to an objective gap of order $(L/K+δ)D_0^2/R$, where $D_0$ is the initial distance to a minimizer. When $K=Θ(L/δ)$, it improves the minibatch SGD rate by a factor $Θ(L/δ)$. For nonconvex objectives, we prove an analogous stationarity guarantee under uniform Hessian similarity for a client-selection variant. In both settings, we extend these guarantees to stochastic gradients and prove matching lower bounds for the analyzed methods with constant local stepsizes. We also show that, under partial participation, even identical clients need not obtain the full communication benefit of additional local steps.

AI.title_translation: Hessian相似性下的SCAFFOLD：尖锐收敛速率
AI.tldr: 本文分析了SCAFFOLD算法在Hessian相似性下的收敛速率，证明了其在凸和非凸目标函数下对Hessian相似性的线性依赖，并在特定条件下实现了比minibatch SGD更快的收敛速度。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习中的数据异质性导致客户端漂移，SCAFFOLD算法通过控制变量纠正了客户端漂移，但其与客户端数据相似性的关系尚不完全清楚。之前的研究要么假设过强，要么收敛速率不够理想，因此需要更深入地理解SCAFFOLD在Hessian相似性下的性能。
AI.method: 本文分析了使用minibatch控制变量的SCAFFOLD算法，并为凸和非凸目标函数建立了超越二次形式的Hessian相似性线性依赖。对于随机梯度和部分参与场景，也进行了扩展和分析。
AI.result: 对于具有精确梯度的凸目标函数，SCAFFOLD算法在R轮和K个局部步骤后，目标差距为$(L/K+δ)D_0^2/R$。当$K=Θ(L/δ)$时，收敛速度比minibatch SGD提高了$Θ(L/δ)$倍。对于非凸目标函数，在均匀Hessian相似性下，为客户端选择变体提供了类似的平稳性保证。这些保证也被扩展到随机梯度，并证明了具有恒定局部步长的分析方法的匹配下界。此外，即使在部分参与下，即使是相同的客户端也可能无法从额外的局部步骤中获得全部通信效益。
AI.conclusion: 本文建立了SCAFFOLD算法在Hessian相似性下的线性依赖收敛速率，显著改进了在异构联邦学习环境中的收敛性能。研究结果表明，在特定条件下，SCAFFOLD可以比minibatch SGD更快收敛，并为随机梯度和部分参与场景提供了理论支持。
AI.translation: 联邦学习的主要挑战之一是客户端之间的数据异质性，这导致了被称为客户端漂移的局部更新偏差。SCAFFOLD算法（Karimireddy et al., 2020）通过控制变量纠正了客户端漂移，但其与客户端数据相似性的关系尚未完全理解：原始的基于相似性的保证仅涵盖具有更强二阶相似性假设的二次函数，而后续的弱凸分析（Luo et al., 2025）对于具有平均Hessian相似性δ的L-光滑损失获得了$\sqrt{Lδ}$的依赖关系。我们分析了使用minibatch控制变量的SCAFFOLD算法，并为凸和非凸目标函数建立了超越二次形式的Hessian相似性线性依赖。特别是，对于具有精确梯度的凸目标函数，R轮SCAFFOLD和K个局部步骤导致目标差距为$(L/K+δ)D_0^2/R$，其中$D_0$是到最小值的初始距离。当$K=Θ(L/δ)$时，它将minibatch SGD速率提高了$Θ(L/δ)$倍。对于非凸目标函数，我们为客户端选择变体在均匀Hessian相似性下证明了类似的平稳性保证。在这两种设置中，我们将这些保证扩展到随机梯度，并证明了具有恒定局部步长的分析方法的匹配下界。我们还表明，在部分参与下，即使是相同的客户端也可能无法获得额外局部步骤的全部通信效益。
AI.summary: 本文深入分析了联邦学习算法SCAFFOLD在Hessian相似性下的收敛特性。研究发现，SCAFFOLD算法对Hessian相似性表现出线性依赖，超越了传统的二次函数假设，并适用于凸和非凸目标函数。在特定条件下，SCAFFOLD能够显著加速收敛，比minibatch SGD快$Θ(L/δ)$倍。此外，研究还扩展了这些发现到随机梯度和部分参与场景，并提供了相应的理论下界。
AI.keywords: 联邦学习, SCAFFOLD, Hessian相似性, 收敛速率, 客户端漂移
AI.comments: 本文对SCAFFOLD算法在异构联邦学习环境中的理论理解做出了重要贡献。通过引入Hessian相似性作为关键参数，并证明其线性依赖，研究为SCAFFOLD的收敛性提供了更精确和普适的保证。其创新之处在于将分析扩展到非二次函数和非凸目标，并量化了在特定条件下的加速效果，这对于指导实际联邦学习系统的设计具有重要意义。同时，对随机梯度和部分参与的考虑增加了其普适性。

title: Singularity Analysis of Laplace Boundary Integral Equations on Three-Dimensional Domains with Corners
summary: Solutions to elliptic boundary value problems on three-dimensional nonsmooth domains exhibit singular behavior near edges and vertices. Using layer potential theory, we investigate boundary integral equations for the Laplace equation and characterize the leading singular exponents of the surface density on conical domains. For two canonical geometries, we derive explicit formulas for the two families of edge singular exponents on a dihedral wedge, and characterize the modewise vertex singular exponents on an axisymmetric circular cone through the zeros of associated Legendre functions and their derivatives. Building on these two prototypes and the dilation-invariance property, we formulate the associated operator pencil for general conical domains and develop a nonlinear eigenvalue solver. This solver employs the Nyström method with graded meshes, logarithmically corrected trapezoidal rules, and Brent's method to compute these singular exponents accurately and efficiently. Numerical examples for trihedral cones, regular m-hedral cones, and droplet-type cones verify the effectiveness of our approach and illustrate the interactions between edge and vertex singularities.

AI.title_translation: 三维带角域上拉普拉斯边界积分方程的奇异性分析
AI.tldr: 论文研究了三维非光滑域上拉普拉斯边界积分方程的奇异性，推导了典型几何体的解析公式，并开发了高效的数值求解器计算奇异指数。
AI.motivation: 三维非光滑域（含边和顶点）上的椭圆边值问题解在奇点附近表现出奇异行为，为了精确刻画和计算表面密度的前导奇异指数，需要进行深入的奇异性分析。
AI.method: 利用层位势理论推导二面角楔形和轴对称圆锥的显式奇异指数公式；基于膨胀不变性构建一般锥形域的算子束；开发结合Nyström方法、分级网格、对数修正梯形规则和Brent方法的非线性特征值求解器。
AI.result: 推导出了二面角楔形上两类边缘奇异指数的显式公式，通过关联勒让德函数的零点表征了轴对称圆锥的模态顶点奇异指数，并通过数值算例验证了求解三阶、常规m面及液滴型锥形域奇异指数的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 论文成功表征了锥形域上拉普拉斯边界积分方程的奇异指数，并开发了高精度的数值求解框架，验证了其处理一般锥形域的能力。
AI.translation: 三维非光滑域上的椭圆边值问题解在边和顶点附近表现出奇异行为。利用层位势理论，我们研究了拉普拉斯方程的边界积分方程，并刻画了锥形域上表面密度的前导奇异指数。对于两个典型几何体，我们推导了二面角楔形上两类边缘奇异指数的显式公式，并通过关联勒让德函数及其导数的零点，刻画了轴对称圆锥上的模态顶点奇异指数。基于这两个原型和膨胀不变性，我们为一般锥形域构建了相关的算子束，并开发了一个非线性特征值求解器。该求解器采用带有分级网格的Nyström方法、对数修正梯形规则和Brent方法，能够准确高效地计算这些奇异指数。三面锥、正m面锥和液滴型锥的数值算例验证了我们方法的有效性，并说明了边奇异性与顶点奇异性之间的相互作用。
AI.summary: 该论文研究了三维非光滑域上拉普拉斯边界积分方程的奇异性，推导了典型几何体的奇异指数显式公式，并开发了一种高效的非线性特征值数值求解器来计算一般锥形域的奇异指数。
AI.keywords: 奇异性分析, 边界积分方程, 拉普拉斯方程, 锥形域, 算子束
AI.comments: 该论文通过层位势理论和算子束方法，深入研究了三维非光滑区域上拉普拉斯边壁积分方程的奇异性，并开发了高效的数值求解器，对理解复杂几何图形中的椭圆边值问题具有重要价值。

title: Continuous-Time Safe Planning and Control for Agile Quadrupeds
summary: Agile quadruped navigation in dynamic environments demands trajectories that are both dynamically feasible and provably collision-free. Most real-time planners achieve tractability through a convex reduction that requires simplified kinematic models, discarding motion that the robot can readily execute, and certify safety only at discretization points, leaving open possible inter-sample collisions with moving obstacles. We present a real-time motion planning framework that retains the fully-actuated $SE(2)$ model of a quadruped, with its anisotropic, heading-coupled velocity bounds, and accepts the resulting nonconvexity. By parameterizing trajectories as composite Bernstein polynomials, we exploit the convex hull property to certify collision avoidance and the input bounds over the entirety of each planning horizon. Solved at online replanning rates, the optimization runs in closed loop, commanding body velocities to the locomotion controller. We validate the approach in simulation against ablations and external baselines, and in hardware experiments on a quadruped navigating among unknown moving obstacles, recovering both lateral and heading-coupled motion that simplified models exclude.

AI.title_translation: 面向敏捷四足机器人的连续时间安全规划与控制
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于伯恩斯坦多项式的四足机器人实时连续时间安全规划框架，能够在动态环境中实现兼顾完全动力学模型与全时段无碰撞保证的敏捷导航。
AI.motivation: 现有的实时规划器多通过简化运动学模型来实现易处理性，丢弃了机器人可执行的动作，且仅在离散点处证明安全性，无法防范与移动障碍物之间的采样间隙碰撞。因此需要开发一种既能保持动态可行性又能保证全时段无碰撞的实时规划框架。
AI.method: 提出了一种实时运动规划框架，保留了四足机器人的完全驱动SE(2)模型及其各向异性、航向耦合的速度边界，并将轨迹参数化为复合伯恩斯坦多项式，利用凸包性质在整个规划时域内认证碰撞避免和输入边界。
AI.result: 通过仿真消融实验、外部基准对比以及硬件实验验证，该方法能够成功在未知移动障碍物环境中导航，恢复了简化模型所排除的侧向和航向耦合运动。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的连续时间安全规划与控制框架，成功实现了四足机器人在动态复杂环境中的敏捷导航，并在仿真与真实硬件中得到了验证。
AI.translation: 动态环境中的敏捷四足机器人导航需要既具动态可行性又可证明无碰撞的轨迹。大多数实时规划器通过简化运动学模型的凸约简来实现可处理性，丢弃了机器人可以轻松执行的运动，并且仅在离散化点处证明安全性，这使得与移动障碍物之间可能存在采样间隙碰撞。我们提出了一种实时运动规划框架，保留了四足机器人的完全驱动$SE(2)$模型（及其各向异性、航向耦合的速度边界），并接受了由此产生的非凸性。通过将轨迹参数化为复合伯恩斯坦多项式，我们利用凸包性质来证明整个规划时域内的避障和输入边界。该优化以在线重规划速率求解，在闭环中运行，向运动控制控制器发出身体速度指令。我们在仿真中针对消融实验和外部基准进行了方法验证，并在四足机器人穿梭于未知移动障碍物的硬件实验中进行了验证，恢复了简化模型所排除的侧向和航向耦合运动。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了一种针对敏捷四足机器人在动态环境中进行连续时间安全规划与控制的实时框架。通过采用全驱动SE(2)模型并利用复合伯恩斯坦多项式参数化轨迹，该方法在整个规划时域内实现了无碰撞和输入约束的严格保证，并在仿真和硬件实验中展现了优越性能。
AI.keywords: 四足机器人, 运动规划, 连续时间安全, 伯恩斯坦多项式, 动态环境避障
AI.comments: 该论文通过将轨迹参数化为复合伯恩斯坦多项式，解决了四足机器人动态环境中实时避障与动力学可行性的矛盾，不仅保留了完全驱动的SE(2)模型，还能在整个规划时域内保证无碰撞，是一项兼具理论严谨性与硬件实操性的创新工作。

title: Evaluating DeepSeek V4.1 Flash-1017 for loss of control and harmful manipulation risks
summary: As frontier language models grow increasingly capable and autonomous, independent third-party evaluations are critical for characterizing their systemic safety risks. While closed-source releases are routinely accompanied by comprehensive system cards, open-weight models receive less scrutiny regarding frontier risks. To address this gap, we present an independent safety evaluation of DeepSeek V4.1 Flash-1017, the latest version of V4.1 Flash that departs from V4 with a new architecture, scaled-up training, and strong agentic capabilities. Drawing on the EU General-Purpose AI Code of Practice, we evaluate the model across 34 benchmarks, including 5 in-house suites, spanning evaluation integrity, loss of control, and harmful manipulation. Conforming to the AEF-1 standard, we compare V4.1 Flash-1017 against V4.1 Flash, earlier DeepSeek V4 models, and leading closed-source systems (GPT-6 Astra, GPT-5.6 Sol, and Gemini 3.8 Flash). Overall, V4.1 Flash-1017 shows substantial safety improvements over the V4 generation and approaches or matches leading closed-source baselines on several dimensions, while still exhibiting notable behaviors that warrant continued attention. Building on our findings, we highlight three key observations and recommendations. First, because safety can shift and even regress across minor updates, developers should integrate safety evaluation into incremental releases. Second, as final-turn outputs and end-state checks alone cannot reliably detect loss-of-control behaviors, deployments require process-level observability across both reasoning traces and action logs. Third, because public benchmarks elicit strong evaluation awareness and face data contamination risks, developing private benchmarks is essential for trustworthy frontier evaluation.

AI.title_translation: 评估DeepSeek V4.1 Flash-1017在失控和有害操纵风险方面的表现
AI.tldr: 该研究独立评估了DeepSeek V4.1 Flash-1017模型的安全风险，发现其在失控和有害操纵方面相比前代有所改进，但仍需持续关注，并提出了三项关键建议。
AI.motivation: 随着大型语言模型的自主性增强，对其系统性安全风险进行独立评估至关重要，特别是对于开放权重模型而言，它们受到的安全审查不如闭源模型。
AI.method: 本研究遵循欧盟通用人工智能行为准则，使用34个基准测试（包括5个内部测试套件）对DeepSeek V4.1 Flash-1017模型进行了评估，涵盖了评估完整性、失控和有害操纵等领域，并遵循AEF-1标准，将其与V4.1 Flash、早期DeepSeek V4模型以及GPT-6 Astra、GPT-5.6 Sol和Gemini 3.8 Flash等领先闭源系统进行了比较。
AI.result: 与V4代相比，V4.1 Flash-1017在安全方面有了显著改进，在多个维度上接近或达到了领先闭源基线的水平，但仍表现出值得持续关注的显著行为。
AI.conclusion: 安全评估应纳入增量发布，部署需要对推理过程和操作日志进行过程级可观测性，并且需要开发私有基准测试以进行可信的在前沿评估。
AI.translation: 随着前沿语言模型的能力和自主性越来越强，独立的第三方评估对于表征其系统性安全风险至关重要。虽然闭源版本通常附带全面的系统卡，但开放权重模型在面临前沿风险时受到的审查较少。为了解决这一差距，我们对DeepSeek V4.1 Flash-1017进行了独立的安全性评估，这是V4.1 Flash的最新版本，它在架构、训练规模和强大的代理能力方面与V4有所不同。借鉴欧盟通用人工智能行为准则，我们在34个基准测试中评估了该模型，包括5个内部套件，涵盖了评估完整性、失控和有害操纵。根据AEF-1标准，我们将V4.1 Flash-1017与V4.1 Flash、早期的DeepSeek V4模型以及领先的闭源系统（GPT-6 Astra、GPT-5.6 Sol和Gemini 3.8 Flash）进行了比较。总体而言，V4.1 Flash-1017在安全性方面相比V4代有了显著改进，并在多个维度上接近或达到了领先闭源基线的水平，但仍表现出值得持续关注的显著行为。基于我们的发现，我们强调了三个关键观察和建议。首先，由于安全性可能在微小的更新中发生变化甚至倒退，开发人员应将安全性评估纳入增量发布。其次，由于仅靠最终输出和最终状态检查无法可靠地检测失控行为，部署需要对推理过程和操作日志进行过程级可观测性。第三，由于公开基准测试会引起强烈的评估意识并面临数据污染风险，开发私有基准测试对于可信的前沿评估至关重要。
AI.summary: 本研究对DeepSeek V4.1 Flash-1017模型进行了独立的安全评估，重点关注其失控和有害操纵风险。研究采用欧盟通用人工智能行为准则和AEF-1标准，通过34个基准测试将其与早期模型和领先的闭源模型进行比较。结果显示，V4.1 Flash-1017在安全性能上较前代有显著提升，并能与闭源模型媲美，但仍存在需要改进之处。研究提出了三项建议：将安全评估纳入增量发布、对部署过程进行细粒度监控以及开发私有基准测试。
AI.keywords: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash-1017, 安全评估, 失控风险, 有害操纵, 开放权重模型
AI.comments: 该研究对开放权重模型进行了重要的独立安全评估，填补了现有研究的空白。研究方法严谨，将评估结果与闭源模型进行比较，具有很高的参考价值。然而，报告中关于“显著行为”的具体细节不足，限制了对其风险的全面理解。此外，虽然提出了三项建议，但缺乏关于如何有效实施这些建议的详细指导。

title: CounterFlow: Target-Conditioned Flow Matching for Visual Counterfactuals
summary: In eXplainable AI, counterfactual explanations have gained significant traction by offering users direct, intuitive, and actionable insights into model decisions. We introduce CounterFlow, a novel framework based on Conditional Flow Matching that generates visual counterfactual explanations by directly steering a source image toward a user-specified target class. By leveraging target-conditioned vector fields, CounterFlow identifies highly realistic semantic modifications while requiring substantially lower computational overhead than traditional GAN- or diffusion-based architectures. Empirical evaluations on standard benchmarks demonstrate that CounterFlow achieves state-of-the-art performance in both visual realism and target class switching. By working directly in the raw pixel space, CounterFlow offers a more practical solution for real-world deployment.

AI.title_translation: CounterFlow：用于视觉反事实的目标条件流匹配
AI.tldr: CounterFlow是一个基于条件流匹配的新框架，通过直接将源图像引导至用户指定的目标类别，生成视觉反事实解释，具有更低的计算开销和最先进的性能。
AI.motivation: 在可解释人工智能中，反事实解释因能为用户提供关于模型决策的直接、直观和可操作的见解而受到广泛关注。本研究旨在提供一种更高效、更实际的视觉反事实生成方案。
AI.method: 本文引入了CounterFlow，一个基于条件流匹配（Conditional Flow Matching）的新颖框架。它通过利用目标条件向量场（target-conditioned vector fields），直接将源图像引导至用户指定的目标类别，从而生成视觉反事实解释。
AI.result: CounterFlow在标准基准测试中，在视觉真实性和目标类别切换方面均达到了最先进的性能。与传统的GAN或基于扩散的架构相比，它需要显著更低的计算开销。通过直接在原始像素空间工作，它提供了一个更实用的真实世界部署解决方案。
AI.conclusion: CounterFlow提供了一个更实用的视觉反事实解释解决方案，适用于真实世界部署，因为它在保持最先进性能的同时，显著降低了计算开销。
AI.translation: 在可解释人工智能（eXplainable AI）中，反事实解释通过为用户提供关于模型决策的直接、直观和可操作的见解而获得了显著关注。我们引入了CounterFlow，一个基于条件流匹配（Conditional Flow Matching）的新颖框架，它通过直接将源图像引导至用户指定的目标类别来生成视觉反事实解释。通过利用目标条件向量场，CounterFlow在识别高度逼真的语义修改方面，比传统的基于GAN或扩散的架构需要显著更低的计算开销。对标准基准的实证评估表明，CounterFlow在视觉真实性和目标类别切换方面均达到了最先进的性能。通过直接在原始像素空间工作，CounterFlow为真实世界部署提供了一个更实用的解决方案。
AI.summary: CounterFlow是一个基于条件流匹配的新框架，旨在生成视觉反事实解释。它通过利用目标条件向量场，直接将源图像引导至用户指定的目标类别。该方法在视觉真实性和目标类别切换方面实现了最先进的性能，同时显著降低了计算开销，比传统的GAN或扩散模型更高效，为实际部署提供了更实用的解决方案。
AI.keywords: CounterFlow, 条件流匹配, 视觉反事实, 可解释AI, 目标条件向量场
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了CounterFlow框架，利用条件流匹配和目标条件向量场直接在像素空间生成视觉反事实，避免了传统GAN或扩散模型的高计算成本。其重要性在于提供了一种更高效、更实用的XAI工具，有助于模型决策的理解和部署。在实际应用中，其低计算开销和高真实性将是一个显著优势。

title: Verse: Semantics and Verification of Hybrid Multi-Agent Scenarios
summary: Verifying cyber-physical systems with many interacting agents remains difficult because interactions are mediated by sensors, individual decisions are constrained by environment (map) structure, and the resulting mode space scales combinatorially. We present Verse, a framework for writing agents, maps, and sensors in a familiar programming language syntax, with a formal semantics for the resulting scenarios. A compiler translates each scenario to a hybrid automaton whose executions correspond exactly to the runs of the scenario. Reachability analysis on this automaton builds an execution tree from two post operators, one for continuous flow over a time step and one for a single agent's mode change, and checks safety assertions at every vertex. The tree expands only the modes that are reached, without enumerating the global mode space. Experiments highlight expressive modeling across cars and drones, 2D/3D maps (including OpenDRIVE imports), noisy sensors, and multiple simultaneous safety assertions. Verse verifies a scenario with 7 agents and 37 modes in 90 seconds on a standard laptop; it is competitive with CORA and JuliaReach on ARCH benchmarks, and on multi-agent scenarios is an order of magnitude faster than JuliaReach at the cost of looser reachable sets.

AI.title_translation: Verse：混合多智能体场景的语义与验证
AI.tldr: Verse 是一个高效的混合多智能体系统验证框架，通过将场景编译为混合自动机并采用按需扩展的可达性分析，解决了状态空间爆炸问题，多智能体场景验证速度比现有工具快一个数量级。
AI.motivation: 验证具有大量交互智能体的网络物理系统非常困难，因为交互由传感器介导，个体决策受环境结构约束，且由此产生的模式空间呈组合级数增长。
AI.method: 提出 Verse 框架，支持用类编程语言语法编写智能体、地图和传感器；通过编译器将其转换为混合自动机；利用包含连续流算子和单智能体模式切换算子的两个 post 算子进行可达性分析，构建执行树并检查安全性。
AI.result: Verse 能够在标准笔记本电脑上于 90 秒内验证包含 7 个智能体和 37 种模式的场景；在 ARCH 基准测试中表现与 CORA 和 JuliaReach 具有竞争力，在多智能体场景中比 JuliaReach 快一个数量级（代价是可达集较宽松）。
AI.conclusion: Verse 是一个用于混合多智能体场景的形式化验证框架，通过创新的语义和可达性分析方法，在保持高可扩展性的同时实现了对复杂网络物理系统的有效安全验证。
AI.translation: 验证具有许多交互智能体的网络物理系统仍然很困难，因为交互是由传感器介导的，单个决策受到环境（地图）结构的约束，并且由此产生的模式空间呈组合级数增长。我们提出了 Verse，这是一个用于用熟悉的编程语言语法编写智能体、地图和传感器的框架，并为生成的场景提供了形式化语义。编译器将每个场景转换为一个混合自动机，其执行过程与场景的运行完全对应。对此自动机的可达性分析通过两个后置算子（一个用于时间步长内的连续流，另一个用于单个智能体的模式更改）构建执行树，并在每个顶点检查安全断言。该树仅扩展到达的模式，而无需枚举全局模式空间。实验突出了跨汽车和无人机、2D/3D 地图（包括 OpenDRIVE 导入）、噪声传感器以及多个同时安全断言的表现力建模。Verse 在标准笔记本电脑上用 90 秒验证了包含 7 个智能体和 37 个模式的场景；它在 ARCH 基准测试中与 CORA 和 JuliaReach 具有竞争力，并且在多智能体场景中，以更宽松的可达集为代价，速度比 JuliaReach 快一个数量级。
AI.summary: Verse 是一个用于混合多智能体场景的形式化语义和验证框架。它通过将场景编译为混合自动机，并利用按需扩展模式的树状可达性分析方法，克服了传统方法面临的组合爆炸难题，在多智能体验证中展现出高效性和良好的表达能力。
AI.keywords: 混合多智能体系统, 形式化验证, 混合自动机, 可达性分析, 网络物理系统
AI.comments: Verse 框架通过将场景编译为混合自动机并结合巧妙的可达性分析算法，有效缓解了多智能体网络物理系统中的状态空间组合爆炸问题。它在多智能体场景中表现出极高的效率，比现有工具快一个数量级，但代价是可达集相对保守（宽松）。

title: Printed and Scanned: Exposing the Fragility of Single-Image Morphing Attack Detectors under Print-Scan Degradation
summary: Face morphing attacks, in which the biometric traits of two or more identities are blended into a single face image, pose a severe threat to identity document issuance and automated border control. Consequently, a large body of work has proposed Single-image Morphing Attack Detection (S-MAD) algorithms and benchmarked them on datasets such as SYN-MAD22. However, the majority of these benchmarks operate exclusively in the digital domain, which contrasts with the real-world passport issuance pipeline in some countries, which still requires an applicant-supplied photograph to be printed and subsequently re-scanned before it is embedded in the identity document or fed into an automated verification system. This print-scan step introduces halftoning, resampling, color-space, and sensor noise that are absent from digital pipelines, and may mask the high-frequency artifacts that S-MAD models rely on. In this work, we introduce a print-scan version of the SYN-MAD22 dataset, obtained by printing and re-scanning all bona fide and morphed images at 300 and 600 DPI, and we use it to evaluate eight state-of-the-art S-MAD models trained exclusively on digital data. We additionally repeat the acquisition with a second scanner to assess cross-device robustness. Our results show that detectors that achieve near state-of-the-art performance in the digital domain suffer a more than threefold increase in average equal error rate, with the same qualitative degradation observed across both scanning devices, exposing a critical, previously under-reported gap between digital-benchmark performance and robustness to print-scan degradation.

AI.title_translation: 打印与扫描：揭示单图像变形攻击检测器在打印-扫描降级下的脆弱性
AI.tldr: 单图像变形攻击检测器在数字领域表现良好，但在经过打印和扫描处理后性能急剧下降，表明其在现实世界中的鲁棒性不足。
AI.motivation: 现实世界的身份文件发放流程涉及打印和重新扫描，这会引入数字领域不存在的降级，可能掩盖现有变形攻击检测算法依赖的高频伪影。因此，需要评估现有单图像变形攻击检测（S-MAD）算法在打印-扫描降级下的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 创建了一个打印-扫描版本的SYN-MAD22数据集，通过打印和重新扫描（300和600 DPI）所有真实和变形图像获得。使用该数据集评估了八种仅在数字数据上训练的S-MAD模型，并使用第二个扫描仪重复了采集过程以评估跨设备鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在数字领域表现接近最先进水平的S-MAD模型，在经过打印-扫描降级后，平均等错误率（EER）增加了三倍以上。这种性能下降在两种扫描设备上都观察到，表明S-MAD模型对打印-扫描降级非常敏感，并且跨设备鲁棒性也存在问题。
AI.conclusion: 现有的单图像变形攻击检测模型在数字域中的高性能并不能转化为在打印-扫描降级下的鲁棒性。打印-扫描过程引入的降级严重削弱了这些模型的性能，暴露了数字基准测试与实际应用之间存在关键差距。
AI.translation: 面部变形攻击，即将两个或多个身份的生物特征混合成单一的面部图像，对身份文件发放和自动边境管制构成了严重威胁。因此，大量研究提出了单图像变形攻击检测（S-MAD）算法，并在SYN-MAD22等数据集上进行了基准测试。然而，这些基准测试大多仅在数字域中运行，这与一些国家/地区仍要求将申请人提供的照片打印出来，然后重新扫描后嵌入身份文件或输入自动验证系统的现实护照发放流程形成对比。此打印-扫描步骤会引入数字流水线中不存在的半色调、重采样、色彩空间和传感器噪声，并可能掩盖S-MAD模型所依赖的高频伪影。在本工作中，我们引入了一个打印-扫描版本的SYN-MAD22数据集，通过以300和600 DPI打印和重新扫描所有真实和变形图像获得，并使用它来评估八种仅在数字数据上训练的最先进的S-MAD模型。我们还使用第二个扫描仪重复了采集过程，以评估跨设备鲁棒性。我们的结果表明，在数字域中实现接近最先进性能的检测器，其平均等错误率增加了两倍以上，并且在两种扫描设备上都观察到了相同的定性退化，暴露了数字基准性能与对打印-扫描退化的鲁棒性之间一个关键的、先前未充分报告的差距。
AI.summary: 本研究评估了单图像变形攻击检测（S-MAD）模型在打印-扫描降级下的鲁棒性。研究人员创建了一个打印-扫描版本的SYN-MAD22数据集，并通过实验发现，在数字域表现优异的模型在打印-扫描后性能急剧下降，平均等错误率增加了三倍以上。这一结果揭示了当前S-MAD模型在应对现实世界中可能遇到的打印-扫描退化方面的严重不足，强调了开发更鲁棒模型的必要性。
AI.keywords: 变形攻击检测, 单图像, 打印-扫描降级, 鲁棒性, 数字基准
AI.comments: 这项研究揭示了当前单图像变形攻击检测（S-MAD）技术在实际应用中的一个关键瓶颈。虽然S-MAD模型在纯数字环境中表现出色，但打印-扫描过程引入的降级（如半色调、重采样、色彩空间变化和传感器噪声）对其性能造成了毁灭性的影响。研究结果表明，现有模型严重依赖高频伪影，而这些伪影在打印-扫描过程中极易丢失或被掩盖。这项工作的重要性在于，它直接指出了一个被现有研究忽视但对现实世界至关重要的安全漏洞，并为未来开发更具鲁棒性的变形攻击检测技术提供了明确的研究方向。未来的研究应着重于开发能够适应或补偿打印-扫描降级的模型，或者探索在打印-扫描过程中引入可检测标记的方法。

title: OmniShowcase: Omnidirectional Subject-Consistent Video Generation from Multi-View Images
summary: Generating videos of a specific subject from a few reference images remains challenging when the camera reveals surfaces that are not visible in the input. Early subject-to-video (S2V) methods condition on a single reference image and must therefore infer the subject's unseen appearance and geometry as the viewpoint changes. To address this limitation, recent methods extend S2V to multiple reference views, providing more information about the subject from different viewpoints. However, they do not explicitly specify the 3D structure that connects these observations. In addition, existing training data do not guarantee that viewpoint changes preserve the same underlying 3D subject. We present OmniShowcase, built on two components: (i) a fully automated data synthesis pipeline that produces training videos along diverse camera trajectories, with viewpoint variation driven by underlying subject geometry, even spanning full 360-degree orbits; and (ii) a geometry-conditioning method that provides the video model with a turntable of surface-normal maps reconstructed from the reference views without requiring temporal alignment with the generated frames. We construct Showcase-4K, a corpus of 3D-asset-based videos covering twelve camera motions across 88 trajectory configurations with reconstruction-derived surface-normal conditioning, and ShowcaseBench, a held-out evaluation set with the source meshes and camera parameters used to render each video. Experiments show state-of-the-art subject identity and 3D consistency while maintaining competitive video quality and motion. Project page: justin4ai.github.io/OmniShowcase

AI.title_translation: OmniShowcase：基于多视角图像的全方位主体一致视频生成
AI.tldr: 提出OmniShowcase，通过自动化3D数据合成与几何条件控制，实现了高质量的多视角全方位主题一致视频生成。
AI.motivation: 现有的主体到视频(S2V)方法虽然扩展到了多参考视角，但未能明确指定连接这些观测结果的3D结构，且现有训练数据无法保证视角变化时保持相同的底层3D主体。
AI.method: 提出OmniShowcase，包含两个核心组件：(i) 全自动数据合成管线，生成沿多样化摄像机轨迹的训练视频，支持全360度视角变化；(ii) 几何条件方法，为视频模型提供从参考视角重建的表面法线图转盘，而无需与生成的帧进行时间对齐。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法在主体身份保持和3D一致性方面达到了最先进的(state-of-the-art)水平，同时保持了有竞争力的视频质量和运动表现。
AI.conclusion: OmniShowcase通过引入全自动数据合成管线和几何条件方法，成功实现了全方位的、主题一致的视频生成，并在质量和一致性上取得了SOTA的效果。
AI.translation: 从少量参考图像生成特定主体的视频仍然具有挑战性，特别是当摄像机暴露了输入中不可见的表面时。早期的主体到视频（S2V）方法以单个参考图像为条件，因此必须在视点变化时推断主体未见的外观和几何形状。为了解决这一局限性，最近的方法将S2V扩展到多个参考视角，从不同视点提供了关于主体的更多信息。然而，它们并没有明确指定连接这些观测结果的3D结构。此外，现有的训练数据不能保证视点变化时保持相同的底层3D主体。我们提出了OmniShowcase，它建立在两个组件之上：(i) 一个完全自动化的数据合成管线，生成沿多样化摄像机轨迹的训练视频，视点变化由底层主体几何形状驱动，甚至跨越完整的360度轨道；(ii) 一种几何条件方法，为视频模型提供从参考视角重建的表面法线图转盘，而无需与生成的帧进行时间对齐。我们构建了Showcase-4K（一个包含基于3D资产的视频语料库，涵盖12种摄像机运动和88种轨迹配置，并带有重建导出的表面法线条件）和ShowcaseBench（一个保留的评估集，包含用于渲染每个视频的源网格和摄像机参数）。实验表明，该方法在保持最先进的主体身份和3D一致性的同时，维持了有竞争力的视频质量和运动。
AI.summary: OmniShowcase是一种从多视角图像生成全方位、主题一致视频的新方法。它利用全自动数据合成管线和表面法线图几何条件，解决了传统方法中缺乏明确3D结构和主体一致性的问题，并在实验中展现出SOTA的性能。
AI.keywords: 全方位视频生成, 主题一致性, 多视角图像, 3D几何条件, 数据合成
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地提出了OmniShowcase，通过全自动数据合成管线和基于几何条件的方法，有效解决了多视角图像生成全方位、主题一致的视频时的3D结构缺失问题。该方法在主题一致性和3D一致性上达到了最先进的水平。

title: Adapting LLM-SC to Living Sacred Heritage: Domain-Specific Extraction, Semantic Networks and Human Evaluation on Pashupatinath Temple Reviews
summary: Large language model (LLM) pipelines can turn visitor reviews into structured data, but generic schemes may miss rituals, sacred spaces, cultural restrictions and emotionally mixed experiences at living sacred heritage sites. We adapted the LLM-Social Computing (LLM-SC) framework to Pashupatinath Temple, Nepal, by specifying a 12-type entity taxonomy (four original LLM-SC types plus eight sacred-heritage types), four relation types and nine aspect-sentiment dimensions in a GPT-4o extraction prompt, which was applied to a fixed random sample of 2,500 English-language Tripadvisor reviews from a processed corpus of 3,939. The exports contain 11,286 entity, 6,232 aspect-sentiment and 5,590 relation records, covering 2,485, 2,487 and 2,433 reviews, respectively; the eight added sacred-heritage types account for 64.8% of entity records. Against an adjudicated two-annotator reference for 200 reviews, exact normalized surface-and-type matching gave provisional entity scores of 41.0% precision, 21.8% recall and 28.4% micro-F1. Aspect-presence F1 was 53.6% and end-to-end aspect-plus-polarity F1 was 42.6%. Human adjudication supported 153 of 194 first-listed relation candidates (one per review; 78.9%), a candidate-level rate that does not estimate relation recall or whole-graph precision. The contribution is a culturally grounded, domain-specific adaptation with component-wise human evaluation and explicit reproducibility and generalization limitations.

title: FISRF: Flexible Instructional Scaffolding Reflection Framework for Robotics Task Planning with Large Language Model
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are widely adopted for reflective error correction in task planning; however, existing approaches primarily rely on autonomous exploration, rendering them prone to accumulating erroneous experiences during early interactions with new environments. To address this limitation, we propose the Flexible Instructional Scaffolding Reflection Framework (FISRF), an agent--mentor architecture that estimates the robot's Zone of Proximal Development (ZPD) in task planning and adaptively selects reflection strategies and mentor guidance, thereby facilitating the accumulation of effective error-correction experience. Experiments in ALFWorld and on real-world robotic platforms demonstrate that FISRF reduces the average number of error-correction rounds by 37% and redundant reasoning by 25.1%, while improving the overall task success rate by 8%. Project webpage : https://fisrfplanning.github.io/

title: TrySee: Modular Perception-Enhanced VLM Grounding for Closed-Loop Robot Task Planning in Specialized Domains
comments: To be published in the proceedings of the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Biomimetics (ROBIO)
summary: Vision Language Models (VLMs) have shown impressive capabilities in high-level reasoning and task planning for robots. However, specialized domains remain a challenge for VLMs' image interpretation and grounding abilities. We introduce TrySee, a modular closed-loop robot task planning pipeline integrating general-purpose VLM reasoning with domain-specific perception and established robotics components. The system consists of an inherently reactive cyclic planning pipeline, augmented with domain-specific modular vision preprocessing, to provide online grounding. Finally, a dynamic preprocessing selection mechanism contributes to the scalability of the pipeline. The system requires neither VLM fine-tuning nor end-to-end demonstrations and adapts through replaceable perception modules and motion planning. The approach is evaluated on planning tasks across 5 widely different domains, including a real-world robot disassembly task. The field tests in a brownfield environment demonstrate the approach's practicality in integrating VLM planning into specialized robotic systems with limited domain-specific training data.
comment: To be published in the proceedings of the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Biomimetics (ROBIO)

title: EvoRouter: Cost-Efficient Multi-Agent Routing via Insight-Guided On-Policy Distillation
summary: Serving web queries at scale with multi-agent systems requires jointly configuring large language models, collaboration modes, agent counts, interaction rounds, and skills. However, the resulting configuration space grows combinatorially, while sparse execution rewards provide limited fine-grained supervision for interdependent planning decisions. We propose EvoRouter, a self-evolving multi-agent routing framework driven by insight-guided on-policy distillation. A dedicated expert periodically synthesizes performance-cost feedback from configuration trajectories across tasks into reusable conditional routing insights about capability requirements, returns from resource scaling, and interactions among configuration choices. A privileged teacher combines these evolving insights with current execution feedback to provide dense token-level supervision for the router's own planning trajectories through on-policy distillation. Cost-aware reinforcement learning jointly optimizes task performance and computational cost. Together, these training signals internalize execution insights into the routing policy. The updated policy generates new trajectories that support subsequent insight extraction, forming an execution-driven self-improvement loop. We evaluate EvoRouter on 19 in-domain datasets spanning five domains and two out-of-domain benchmarks. EvoRouter achieves an average in-domain accuracy of 68.69%, outperforming the strongest routing baseline by 7.23 percentage points while reducing inference compute cost by 50.95%. Our code is open-sourced at https://github.com/CenYangtze/EvoRouter.

title: Computing Data-Aware Diagonal Frame Decompositions
summary: We present a method for computing a specific type of matrix decomposition that combines a structured framework with data-driven adaptation. This framework allows for an efficient and stable representation of signals or images using frames by identifying sets of vectors that naturally capture the essential features of the given data. The resulting decomposition enables the development of regularization techniques that enhance the quality of reconstruction by preserving important signal characteristics while suppressing noise. We develop an optimization-based algorithm to compute the decomposition and establish convergence properties of the resulting iterates. Numerical experiments on synthetic data and tomographic image reconstruction illustrate the behavior of the proposed method and its performance compared to conventional spectral regularization methods.

title: GNN-VIEW: Visual Inspection and Explanation of Graph-based Earth-System Models
comments: Accepted to The 2nd Workshop on Advances in Representation Learning for Earth Observation at NeurIPS 2026
summary: Machine learning Earth-system models are becoming increasingly important, and so is their development. Graph-based models, one of the most prominent approaches, allow developers to constrain the learning process before training via graph connectivity. Yet, developing these models remains challenging: the graph is built algorithmically with little intuition about the final result beyond static plotting, which requires extra work and is often not detailed enough. Even after successful training, how the model arrives at forecasts remains obscure. We present GNN-VIEW, an interactive browser-based tool that supports the development of such systems. GNN-VIEW exposes the graph's information pathways, allowing model developers to debug the graph structure before training. After training, GNN-VIEW uses attribution-based explainability to reveal which input features are used by the trained model for a given forecast. This helps developers understand why a model fails. We showcase the usefulness of GNN-VIEW in the construction stage of a graph for an ocean forecasting model, and in explaining poorly predicted precipitation of a trained weather forecasting model during Hurricane Laura.
comment: Accepted to The 2nd Workshop on Advances in Representation Learning for Earth Observation at NeurIPS 2026

title: Not One Belief: Answer Payloads, Persistence, and Dissociated Confidence Signals in Conversational Question Answering
summary: Conversational QA systems should fix errors when users push back and signal which answers to trust. We split each follow-up into its speech act (re-ask, agree, or challenge) and its payload (an answer string, correct or not), and measure four confidence signals on the same transcripts: verbalized confidence, length-normalized likelihood, a frozen hidden-state probe, and P(True). Answers change when the user supplies an answer string and almost never under the speech act alone: in every retained full-size cell, the correct answer converts at least four times as many wrong answers as re-asking or agreement. The four signals disagree. On Qwen2.5-7B the frozen probe rises with answer persistence rather than truth; this holds on held-out questions, with Llama-3-8B (cleaned answers) as support, but not on four other models. Among 81 Qwen2.5-7B errors that survive one re-ask, re-asking, a fresh chat, or abstain repair almost none, while a gold answer repairs 75-95%. In two preregistered replications, every repair rate without an answer string stays below 0.15; a larger post-hoc rerun excludes 0.15 except for the empty elicit. With BM25 TriviaQA evidence, sentences that contain the answer repair 67-76% of persistent errors versus at most 12% when they do not. An end-to-end contain-gate cuts harm on TriviaQA, but a deployable gate that does not know the gold answer repairs few errors.

title: Towards a Unified Framework of Optimal Input-Side Dimensional Configuration for Deep CTR Prediction
summary: Deep click-through rate (CTR) prediction has achieved substantial success through increasingly expressive feature interaction architectures. However, predictive performance also depends on how input-side information is configured before interaction modeling. Existing studies have shown that selecting informative samples, features, or embedding units can improve prediction accuracy. Nevertheless, they primarily optimize these selection mechanisms independently along a single input-side dimension, overlooking their shared basic form and the inherent dependencies across input levels, thereby limiting the effectiveness of input-side dimensional configuration. To address this issue, we propose OptIDC, a unified framework for Optimal Input-side Dimensional Configuration in deep CTR prediction. OptIDC jointly learns sample, feature, and embedding-unit level configurations within a unified framework by integrating their corresponding selection mechanisms. To explicitly coordinate selection decisions across different levels, OptIDC further introduces a selection-weighted Optimal Transport mechanism that aligns coarse- and fine-grained selections via transport over finite measures, thereby alleviating cross-level selection conflicts while preserving the semantics of each input level. Moreover, OptIDC is model-agnostic and can be seamlessly integrated into existing CTR models. Extensive experiments on four real-world benchmark datasets demonstrate that OptIDC consistently achieves higher AUC than existing input-side selection methods, validating the effectiveness of unified input-side dimensional configuration.

title: Reflective Computing
summary: Interactive technology is increasingly built for speed, and generative AI now answers before a question is fully formed. Yet the capacity to pause, interpret and decide for oneself is central to wellbeing, learning and meaningful use. HCI has named paradigms for sensing emotion, changing behavior, calming attention and tracking the self. However, none of them takes human reflection, and the slowing down it requires, as its organizing aim. This article defines that paradigm, reflective computing, and derives it from what thirty years of designs lack. We analyzed 134 interactive systems from 17 ACM venues (1996-2026) in two phases. First, an abductive gap analysis read every system against reflection theory, and seven recurring gaps defined seven dimensions, namely tempo agency, invitational form, interpretive openness, reflective depth, temporal span, protected idleness and ethical non-extraction. Second, two independent coders scored every system with a codebook (Krippendorff's alpha 0.67 to 0.84 for five dimensions; ICC 0.82 for the overall score). The system sets the pace in 51 designs, 74 support only momentary use, only 12 scaffold reflection beyond description, and 56 papers are silent on the inner states they collect. No system expresses all seven dimensions strongly, and only 20 meet the definition. Slow and experience centered design comes closest, whereas persuasive technology and human-AI interaction score lowest. Factor and latent class analyses reveal two cultures of reflection, one working through form and the other through scaffolded thought, which only one system combines. Systems that let people set the pace score markedly higher, even with paradigm and form controlled (odds ratio 13.5). Hence, reflective computing is proposed as a paradigm whose aim is a human capacity rather than a system function, and which treats slowness as valuable only when people choose it.

title: MiRL: Error-Targeted Reinforcement Learning for Correcting Terminal Agent Misbehaviors
comments: 20 pages, 14 figures, 5 tables. Project page: https://github.com/runchu-tian/MiRL
summary: Error-targeted learning gives a legible way to improve a model: identify specific weaknesses of the model, train the model to fix these weaknesses, and check whether the weaknesses are fixed. We study how to apply error-targeted learning to terminal agents, which solve long-horizon tasks specified in natural language by interacting with a command shell. Existing error-targeted methods are designed for single-turn tasks, and existing analyses of agent failures are used to evaluate and debug agents rather than to train them. We propose Misbehavior-driven RL (MiRL), which first profiles the errors of a policy to find generalizable misbehaviors: kinds of wrong steps that recur across many environments. MiRL then trains the policy with RL, starting rollouts at the steps where these misbehaviors occur and rewarding a rollout only if it passes the tests and avoids the misbehavior. On Qwen3.5-4B, eight misbehaviors account for 52.1% of wrong steps. After training with MiRL, the policy repeats the measured misbehaviors 43% to 57% less often on average on unseen prefixes. MiRL outperforms TMax-4B on Terminal-Bench Lite (51.8% vs. 47.4%) and matches it on Terminal-Bench 2.1 (21.3% vs. 20.6%), while using 35% of its rollouts. These results show that error-targeted learning can be applied to realistic, long-horizon terminal tasks.
comment: 20 pages, 14 figures, 5 tables. Project page: https://github.com/runchu-tian/MiRL

title: From Self-Confidence to Statistical Accuracy: Scaling Human-in-the-Loop Evaluation with Direct and LLM-Assisted Auditing
comments: 21 pages, 8 figures. Reproduction artifacts available at https://github.com/harinechoi/confidence-auditing-reproduction
summary:
For large language models (LLMs) and multimodal large language models (MLLMs), model-reported self-confidence is often miscalibrated, yet it may still be useful for efficient evaluation. At the same time, LLM-as-a-judge offers a scalable alternative to direct human auditing, but its practical benefit depends on calibration quality and inference cost.
  This paper develops a unified statistical framework for both evaluation routes under alternative sampling strategies. For direct auditing, confidence-stratified sampling is used to recover population accuracy from partially verified outputs without requiring calibrated confidence. Finite-sample uncertainty is characterized, and the analysis shows how highly uneven confidence strata affect audit efficiency and label allocation. For judge-assisted evaluation, the judge is modeled through sensitivity and false-positive rate, yielding an error-corrected estimator with calibration uncertainty. The two routes are then compared through human-label and total-cost efficiency boundaries.
  Experiments on MMLU-Pro and MMMU-Pro show that miscalibrated self-confidence can still support statistically valid stratified auditing. Under highly imbalanced confidence distributions, proportional allocation substantially reduces estimation error relative to equal-per-stratum allocation. For judge-assisted evaluation, only a small subset of target--verifier pairs satisfies the idealized human-label efficiency condition, and automated inference costs can further limit potential savings. These findings clarify the statistical and economic conditions under which confidence-guided auditing and automated verification are useful.
comment: 21 pages, 8 figures. Reproduction artifacts available at https://github.com/harinechoi/confidence-auditing-reproduction

title: Explainable Multimodal AI Approach to Reduce Unnecessary Breast Biopsies
summary: Recently, there has been rise in multimodal vision-language models for computer-aided diagnosis (CAD), yet their application in breast diagnosis, particularly for predicting biopsy outcomes remains limited. This study presents a multimodal vision-language approach, incorporating Grad-CAM as an Explainable AI (XAI) technique, to predict benign tumors in patients recommended for biopsy, especially those classified as BI-RADS 4 and 5. A novel multimodal framework was devel- oped using Vision Transformer (ViT) for imaging feature extraction and DeBERTa-V3-Large for textual embeddings. The model was trained and evaluated on a comprehensive in-house dataset comprising 1,632 patients, each with four mammography views and a corresponding radiology report. The features of both modalities were extracted independently and fused by late fusion before classification. Grad-CAM was used to generate visual explanations highlighting key regions influencing model predictions. The proposed model demonstrated high sensitivity 90%, 95%, 99%, and 100% with corresponding specificities of 40%, 36%, 18%, and 11%, respectively. The best AUC achieved was 0.72 by multimodal approach on the test set, outperforming the image only (0.66) and text-only (0.68) baselines. The proposed multimodal architecture, enhanced with Grad-CAM, demonstrates a strong potential to identify benign tumors among high-risk patients, offering interpretable insights and thereby helping reduce unnecessary biopsies, patient anxiety, and healthcare costs.

title: Triage: Skip, Skim, or Refine Attention Tiles in Video Diffusion Transformers
summary: Attention over tens of thousands of visual tokens dominates the inference of video diffusion transformers (DiTs). Existing methods reduce this cost through sparsity, low precision, or both, but use a single precision for all kept tiles. We observe that the output error introduced by approximation varies widely across tiles. Many tiles can be skipped with little error, others must be computed but gain little beyond low precision, and a few retain substantial error even at low precision. We present Triage, a training-free attention method that assigns each tile one of three approximation tiers: skipping it by replacing it with its block means, skimming it in NVFP4, or refining it with NVFP4 residual correction. A lightweight router predicts each tile's error under each tier from block statistics and moves a tile to a more accurate tier only when the predicted error reduction justifies the extra compute, with a single price setting this trade-off. A fused kernel executes all three tiers in a single pass on the FP4 tensor cores of RTX Blackwell GPUs. Across Wan2.2, HunyuanVideo, and LTX-2.5, Triage accelerates end-to-end generation by up to 2.32x over dense FlashAttention, and in each of five settings it runs faster than every baseline while reaching 0.3-3.0 dB higher PSNR than the highest-PSNR baseline.

title: Grid-Forming AC/DC Converters for Meshed DC Networks via Dual-Measurement Frequency Droop
summary: This paper proposes and analyzes a dual-measurement frequency-droop (DMFD) controller for meshed MVDC networks. Using only two local DC measurements, bus-voltage deviation and a filtered DC-port current or power deviation, the controller enables grid-forming operation at both AC and DC ports across the mesh. Although the DMFD regulates neither the DC voltage nor the DC current directly and acts only on the terminal frequency, it is shown that AC-side synchronization closes an effective DC droop at every synchronized terminal, so that the steady operating point of the mesh exists and is unique. Constant frequency deviations at a terminal and single-terminal islanding enter the same DC equations as equivalent current offsets, with the island frequency fixed by the island power balance, allowing node voltages and branch currents to be obtained from one linear system. The steady-state model yields design-use envelopes to map the droop ratios and the net DC-injection levels into bounds on DC-voltage deviation and terminal currents. A small-signal dynamic model is developed and used to generate eigenvalue loci and damping-ratio charts that guide controller-gain selection. Averaged EMT simulations on a four-terminal ring corroborate the analysis: in regimes where PLL-based grid-following control is known to lose damping, the DMFD controller maintains stable operation and follows the predicted steady-state characteristics.

title: Detecting bus delays and service anomalies in Niterói with autoencoder latent feature representations
comments: 14 pages, 9 figures, 11 tables. Full report for the NetMob 2026 Data Challenge (Niterói, Brazil). Winner of the Best Poster award
summary: Bus riders judge service by two failures: single trips that run late, and days on which the whole system misbehaves. We ask whether one unsupervised representation of raw GPS telemetry can serve both diagnoses on the NetMob 2026 Niterói bus dataset. An autoencoder compresses each trip into a 64-dimensional latent vector; the frozen encoder feeds supervised delay classifiers, and the reconstruction error serves as an anomaly score. Two findings are negative. First, the latent representation does not improve delay detection: gradient boosting on per-trip summary features reaches $0.846 \pm 0.013$ ROC-AUC against $0.838 \pm 0.016$ for the best latent setup, and the gap becomes significant once the preprocessing filters are relaxed. Second, two of the three external checks of the anomaly score were circular. Retraining without rainfall removes the rain association ($5.4\%$ against $5.0\%$ flagged, $p = 0.84$) and an apparent citywide disruption on 23 March. What survives is a day-level signal stable across three autoencoders (Spearman $ρ\geq 0.96$), driven mostly by day type, with degraded-telemetry days still separable within weekday and weekend strata.
