title: High-order kernel regularization of singular and hypersingular Helmholtz boundary integral operators
summary: This paper extends and analyzes the high-order kernel regularization framework of Beale & Tlupova (arXiv:2510.13639) to all four on-surface boundary integral operators of the Helmholtz Calderon calculus in three dimensions: the single-layer, double-layer, adjoint double-layer, and hypersingular operators. To the best of our knowledge, this work provides the first high-order kernel regularization of the hypersingular operator for both the Helmholtz and Laplace equations in three dimensions. The regularization replaces each singular kernel with a smooth modification constructed from error functions together with a polynomial correction whose coefficients are determined through moment conditions. Alongside the derivation of the regularizing functions, the paper provides a unified error analysis of the combined regularization and quadrature discretization procedure. By coupling the regularization parameter to the mesh size, the two error contributions can be balanced, leading to explicit overall convergence rates that depend jointly on the order of the regularization and the degree of exactness of the surface quadrature rule. A key practical feature of the method is its implementation simplicity. Once the regularizing functions are determined, the numerical task reduces entirely to the evaluation of smooth surface integrals using standard quadrature, without the need for element-local solves, singularity-specific precomputations, or specialized quadrature rules. Although the modified kernel is generally incompatible with kernel-specific fast methods, this limitation is addressed through H-matrix acceleration, applicable in a black-box manner. Numerical examples -- including verification of the predicted convergence rates and solution of sound-soft and sound-hard scattering problems by smooth obstacles -- demonstrate the accuracy and practicality of the proposed methodology.

title: A Survey on Long-Term Memory Security in LLM Agents: Attacks, Defenses, and Governance Across the Memory Lifecycle
comments: 16 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables. Accepted to EMNLP 2026. Updated references and revised VMG definitions and relationships; revision notes in Appendix F
summary: The emergence of writable, cross-session persistent memory in LLM agents introduces a qualitatively different threat landscape from conventional input-centric security concerns, characterized by three properties: persistence, statefulness, and propagation. To systematically characterize this landscape, we propose a Memory Lifecycle Framework that organizes attacks, defenses, and their cross-phase dependencies along two axes: six lifecycle phases (Write, Store, Retrieve, Execute, Share & Propagate, Forget & Rollback) and four security objectives (Integrity, Confidentiality, Availability, Governance). This analysis in turn exposes the need for explicit security requirements at the system level, motivating Verifiable Memory Governance (VMG), a framework of five architectural primitives for specifying and evaluating auditable, recoverable control over memory state within declared system and threat-model boundaries. Our analysis motivates integrating provenance, versioning, and policy-aware retention with retrieval and execution defenses to support auditable prevention, containment, and recovery across the lifecycle.
comment: 16 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables. Accepted to EMNLP 2026. Updated references and revised VMG definitions and relationships; revision notes in Appendix F

title: Beyond Feature Fusion: Contextual Bayesian PEFT for Multimodal Uncertainty Estimation
summary: We introduce CoCo-LoRA, a multimodal, uncertainty-aware parameter-efficient fine-tuning method for text prediction tasks accompanied by audio context. Existing PEFT approaches such as LoRA are efficient but typically deterministic, while recent Bayesian low-rank adapters model uncertainty in a lightweight way yet remain largely unimodal and condition uncertainty primarily on internal text features. This leaves them poorly equipped to reflect uncertainty driven by external acoustic factors such as background noise, channel variability, or speaking style, which can materially affect reliability in speech-centered applications. CoCo-LoRA addresses this gap by conditioning a contextual variational posterior in the low-rank space on both local text-derived adapter features and an audio-derived context signal. A pooled audio embedding is projected once into a shared context space and then adapted through lightweight layer-wise heads, enabling global-to-local, depth-specific modulation of the adapter uncertainty and update without high-dimensional multimodal fusion. Stochasticity is confined to a compact latent component in the rank space, preserving PEFT scalability while producing audio-sensitive, heteroscedastic uncertainty. Based on our evaluations across diverse tasks and backbone combinations, CoCo-LoRA consistently matches or outperforms text-only PEFT and conventional feature-fusion transfer baselines, particularly on high-coverage labels where reliable adaptation is critical. The results indicate that using audio as a contextual uncertainty signal, rather than as a fused feature stream, provides a robust and parameter-efficient alternative for multimodal low-resource prediction.

title: FRIGID: Scaling Diffusion-Based Molecular Generation from Mass Spectra at Training and Inference Time
summary: Tandem mass spectrometry is prominent in scientific discovery workflows for identifying unknown small molecules, yet high-throughput structural elucidation remains challenging. While recent autoregressive and graph diffusion models have shown promise in de novo elucidation, performance remains limited by poor scalability during both training and inference time. In this work, we present FRIGID, a framework with a novel diffusion language model that generates molecular structures conditioned on mass spectra via intermediate fingerprint representations and determined chemical formulae, training at the scale of hundreds of millions of unlabeled structures. We then demonstrate how forward fragmentation models enable inference-time scaling by identifying spectrum-inconsistent fragments and refining them through targeted remasking and denoising. While FRIGID already achieves strong performance with its diffusion base, inference-time scaling significantly improves its accuracy, surpassing 18% Top-1 accuracy on the challenging MassSpecGym benchmark and tripling the Top-1 accuracy of the leading methods on NPLIB1. Further empirical analyses show that FRIGID exhibits log-linear performance scaling with increasing inference-time compute, opening a promising new direction for continued improvements in de novo structural elucidation. FRIGID code is publicly available at https://github.com/coleygroup/FRIGID.

title: Cross-Attentive Bayesian Low-Rank Adaptation for Multimodal Uncertainty Estimation
comments: 43 pages, 15 figures, The Fortieth Annual Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)
summary: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) enables efficient adaptation of frozen language models, but most PEFT methods remain deterministic or unimodal, limiting their reliability in low-resource audio-text settings where uncertainty depends on both linguistic evidence and acoustic conditions. We introduce SPECTRA (Stochastic Posterior Estimation with Cross-modal Token-level Rank Adaptation), a multimodal Bayesian low-rank adaptation framework for uncertainty-aware audio-text learning. SPECTRA keeps the text and audio backbones frozen and confines stochasticity to a compact rank-$r$ latent matrix inside each LoRA adapter. At each transformer layer, text-derived low-rank token features query frame-level audio embeddings through lightweight cross-attention; the resulting token-specific acoustic context parameterizes the mean and variance of an amortized variational posterior over the adapter latent. Audio thus acts not merely as an additional feature stream, but as a localized reliability signal that modulates both adaptation and confidence. Posterior prediction uses Monte Carlo adapter samples, enabling a decomposition of predictive uncertainty into total, aleatoric, and adapter-space epistemic components. Across IEMOCAP and clinical interview prediction tasks, SPECTRA is consistently competitive with or improves upon text-only Bayesian PEFT and conventional multimodal transfer-learning baselines, with token-level cross-attention yielding the most reliable gains. Modality-disagreement stress tests show that mismatched audio causes substantially larger degradation in AUC, likelihood, calibration, and Brier score than noisy but matched audio, highlighting the importance of modeling cross-modal reliability. These results suggest that Bayesian cross-modal conditioning in low-rank adapter space provides an efficient and principled mechanism for calibrated multimodal adaptation.

title: SentryVLA: Uncertainty-Guided Action Selection and State Monitoring for Vision-Language-Action Robotic Control
comments: To be published in the 2026 Conference on Robot Learning (CoRL)
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have emerged as generalist robotic controllers that map visual observations and language instructions to continuous actions. However, pretrained VLAs typically provide limited information about the reliability of their generated actions, making deployment challenging when execution failures must be anticipated. We address this problem by introducing SentryVLA, a lightweight runtime wrapper for frozen VLA policies. At the action level, SentryVLA uses conformalized quantile regression to estimate a calibrated upper bound on the deviation between sampled VLA actions and expert-like behavior under the calibration distribution. The predicted deviation is then used to rank multiple stochastic candidates for action selection. At the execution-monitoring level, SentryVLA applies a Mahalanobis-distance-based anomaly score to the contextualized latent execution state extracted before final action prediction, providing a complementary signal for detecting abnormal execution states during closed-loop control. The framework does not require retraining or architectural modification of the underlying VLA policy. Experiments in simulation and on a physical robot show that SentryVLA improves action selection and provides useful runtime warning signals for abnormal execution states. These findings demonstrate the practical value of post-hoc reliability scoring for improving the runtime behavior of pretrained VLA policies. Project webpage: https://robotic-vision-lab.github.io/sentryvla/.
comment: To be published in the 2026 Conference on Robot Learning (CoRL)

title: Distributed Optimization with Nesterov Momentum and Finite-Time Quantized Averaging over Directed Networks: Extended Version
summary: In modern large-scale networked systems, rapidly solving optimization problems while utilizing communication resources efficiently is critical for addressing complex tasks. However, distributed optimization over bandwidth-limited networks must cope with two obstacles: limited-bandwidth communication, and slow convergence when the objective is ill-conditioned. In this paper, we consider unconstrained distributed optimization over strongly connected directed networks, where nodes exchange quantized (i.e., compressed) messages. We propose QANM (Quantized Averaged Nesterov Momentum), an algorithm that combines Nesterov momentum with a finite-time quantized averaging protocol. At every iteration, QANM enables all nodes to reach exact agreement, without requiring doubly stochastic weight matrices or undirected communication. For strongly convex and smooth objectives, we show that the objective gap of QANM decays at the accelerated rate $1-κ^{-1/2}$ (where $κ$ is the condition number), up to a residual of order $Δ^2$ determined by the quantization level $Δ$. This improves the condition-number dependence of the transient iteration complexity from $κ$ to $\sqrtκ$ compared with gradient descent that utilizes the same quantized averaging mechanism. Finally, we evaluate QANM on a distributed sensor fusion problem, showing that our algorithm exhibits the fastest initial error reduction compared with other methods from current literature.

title: Does "Do Differentiable Simulators Give Better Policy Gradients?" Give Better Policy Gradients?
summary: In policy gradient reinforcement learning, access to a differentiable model enables 1st-order gradient estimation that accelerates learning compared to relying solely on derivative-free 0th-order estimators. However, discontinuous dynamics cause bias and undermine the effectiveness of 1st-order estimators. Prior work addressed this bias by constructing a confidence interval around the REINFORCE 0th-order gradient estimator and using these bounds to detect discontinuities. However, the REINFORCE estimator is notoriously noisy, and we find that this method requires task-specific hyperparameter tuning and has low sample efficiency. This paper asks whether such bias is the primary obstacle and what minimal fixes suffice. First, we re-examine standard discontinuous settings from prior work and introduce DDCG, a lightweight test that switches estimators in nonsmooth regions; with a single hyperparameter, DDCG achieves robust performance and remains reliable with small samples. Second, on differentiable robotics control tasks, we present IVW-H, a per-step inverse-variance implementation that stabilizes variance without explicit discontinuity detection and yields strong results. Together, these findings indicate that while estimator switching improves robustness in controlled studies, careful variance control often dominates in practical deployments.

title: Forecasting Ionospheric Irregularities on GNSS Lines of Sight Using Dynamic Graphs with Ephemeris Conditioning
comments: Accepted for publication in IEEE Transactions on Geoscience and Remote Sensing. 13 pages, 8 figures, 3 tables
summary: Most data-driven ionospheric models operate on gridded products, which do not preserve the time-varying sampling structure of satellite-based sensing. We instead model the ionosphere as a dynamic graph over ionospheric pierce points, with connectivity that evolves as satellite positions change. Because satellite trajectories are predictable, the graph topology over the forecast horizon can be constructed in advance. We exploit this property to condition forecasts on the future graph structure, which we term ephemeris conditioning. This enables prediction on lines of sight (LoS) that appear only in the forecast horizon. We evaluate our framework on Global Navigation Satellite System data from a co-located receiver pair in Singapore spanning 2023 to 2025. The task is forecasting irregularities defined by the Rate of TEC Index (ROTI) up to 2 hours ahead as per-node binary classification. The resulting model, IonoDGNN, achieves a Brier Skill Score (BSS) of 0.55 and an area under the precision-recall curve (PR-AUC) of 0.77. These correspond to improvements over persistence of 53% in BSS and 58% in PR-AUC, with larger gains at longer lead times. Ablations confirm that graph structure and ephemeris conditioning each contribute meaningfully. Under simulated coverage dropout, the model retains predictive skill on affected nodes through spatial message passing from observed neighbors. Compared to interpolation baselines, the proposed model achieves better recovery, especially at higher dropout levels. These results suggest that dynamic graph forecasting on evolving LoS is a viable alternative for ionospheric modeling. The project and the dataset are available at https://github.com/Mert-chan/IonoDGNN.
comment: Accepted for publication in IEEE Transactions on Geoscience and Remote Sensing. 13 pages, 8 figures, 3 tables

title: Semantic Needles in Document Haystacks: Sensitivity Testing of LLM-as-a-Judge Similarity Scoring
summary: We propose a scalable, multifactorial experimental framework that systematically probes LLM sensitivity to subtle semantic changes in pairwise document comparison. We analogize this as a needle-in-a-haystack problem: a single semantically altered sentence (the needle) is embedded within surrounding context (the hay), and we vary the perturbation type (negation, conjunction swap, named entity replacement), context type (original vs. topically unrelated), needle position, and document length across all combinations, testing seven LLMs on tens of thousands of document pairs. Our analysis reveals several striking findings. First, LLMs can exhibit a within-document positional bias distinct from previously studied candidate-order effects: some models penalize semantic differences more harshly when they occur earlier in a document. Second, when the altered sentence is surrounded by topically unrelated context, it raises similarity scores in almost all settings. This is consistent with a contradiction account, in which topically related context allows the alteration to conflict with the surrounding sentences. Third, all models exhibit the same hierarchy in how harshly they score different perturbation types, with negation penalized the most, but express this hierarchy on significantly different scales. Finally, varying the prompt's conception of semantic similarity across several alternatives changes the magnitude but not the direction of these effects. Together, these results demonstrate how LLM semantic similarity scores are sensitive to the aforementioned parameters in ways that go beyond the semantic change itself; our framework offers a practical toolkit for auditing and comparing scoring behavior across current and future models.

title: Hierarchical Joint Source-Channel Coding with Constrained Information Leakage
comments: gap in proof of bounding the information leakage
summary: This paper studies the hierarchical joint source-channel coding with information leakage constraint in the first-phase reconstruction and distortion constraints. The receiver's access to the data varies and is evaluated by the quality of the side information. Due to the consideration of channel capacity limitation or the efficiency of the system performance, the encoder may send some additional information in Phase 1 that can only be decoded in Phase 2 with higher-quality side information. While this can optimize the overall performance, the additional information causes excessive information leakage. We provide general inner and outer bounds for the conditions such that a given distortion-leakage pair $(D_1,D_2,L)$ is achievable, together with a capacity-achieving condition.

title: Ownership Refinement Types for Pointer Arithmetic and Nested Arrays
comments: Expanded version of our ECOOP 2026 paper, submitted for journal publication. Adds a Rocq formalization and machine-checked type soundness proof, revises the formal system and proofs, and expands the implementation and related-work discussions
summary: Tanaka et al. proposed a type system for verifying functional correctness properties of programs that use arrays and pointer arithmetic. Their system extends ConSORT--a type system combining fractional ownership and refinement types for imperative program verification--with support for pointer arithmetic. Their idea was to extend fractional ownership so that it can depend on an array index. Their formulation, however, does not handle nested arrays, which are essential for representing practical data structures such as matrices. We extend Tanaka et al.'s type system to support nested arrays by allowing ownership to depend on the indices of enclosing arrays. We formalize the extended calculus in Rocq using a mixed embedding and provide a machine-checked proof of type soundness. We have implemented a verifier based on the proposed type system and demonstrated that it can verify the correctness of programs that manipulate nested arrays, which were beyond the reach of Tanaka et al.

title: Dynamic Planar Graph Isomorphism is in DynFO
comments: Full version of a LICS 2026 paper
summary: Consider two planar graphs which are subject to edge insertions and deletions. We show that whether the two graphs are isomorphic can be maintained with first-order logic formulas and auxiliary data of polynomial size. This places the dynamic planar graph isomorphism problem into the dynamic descriptive complexity class DynFO. As a consequence, there is a dynamic constant-time parallel algorithm with polynomial-size auxiliary data which maintains whether two dynamic planar graphs are isomorphic.
comment: Full version of a LICS 2026 paper

title: ICPR 2026 Competition on Low-Resolution License Plate Recognition
comments: Accepted for presentation at the International Conference on Pattern Recognition (ICPR) 2026
summary: Low-Resolution License Plate Recognition (LRLPR) remains a challenging problem in real-world surveillance scenarios, where long capture distances, compression artifacts, and adverse imaging conditions can severely degrade license plate legibility. To promote progress in this area, we organized the ICPR 2026 Competition on Low-Resolution License Plate Recognition, the first competition specifically dedicated to LRLPR using real low-quality data collected under operationally relevant conditions. The competition was based on the LRLPR-26 dataset, which comprises 20,000 training tracks and 3,000 test tracks; each training track contains five low-resolution and five high-resolution images of the same license plate. Notably, a total of 269 teams from 41 countries registered for the competition, and 99 teams submitted valid entries in the Blind Test Phase. The winning team achieved a Recognition Rate of 82.13%, and four teams surpassed the 80% mark, highlighting both the high level of competition at the top of the leaderboard and the continued difficulty of the task. In addition to presenting the competition design, evaluation protocol, and main results, this paper summarizes the methods adopted by the top-5 teams and discusses current trends and promising directions for future research on LRLPR. The competition webpage is available at https://icpr26lrlpr.github.io/
comment: Accepted for presentation at the International Conference on Pattern Recognition (ICPR) 2026

title: BERAG: Bayesian Ensemble Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-based Visual Question Answering
summary: A common approach to question answering with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is to concatenate documents into a single context and pass it to a language model to generate an answer. While simple, this strategy can obscure the contribution of individual documents, making attribution difficult and contributing to the ``lost-in-the-middle'' effect, where relevant information in long contexts is overlooked. Concatenation also scales poorly: computational cost grows quadratically with context length, a problem that becomes especially severe when the context includes visual data, as in visual question answering. Attempts to mitigate these issues by limiting context length can further restrict performance by preventing models from benefiting from the improved recall offered by deeper retrieval. We propose Bayesian Ensemble Retrieval-Augmented Generation (BERAG), along with Bayesian Ensemble Fine-Tuning (BEFT), as a RAG framework in which language models are conditioned on individual retrieved documents rather than a single combined context. BERAG treats document posterior probabilities as ensemble weights and updates them token by token using Bayes' rule during generation. This approach enables probabilistic re-ranking, parallel memory usage, and clear attribution of document contribution, making it well-suited for large document collections. We evaluate BERAG and BEFT primarily on knowledge-based visual question answering tasks, where models must reason over long, imperfect retrieval lists. The results show substantial improvements over standard RAG, including strong gains on Document Visual Question Answering and multimodal needle-in-a-haystack benchmarks. We also demonstrate that BERAG mitigates the ``lost-in-the-middle'' effect. The document posterior can be used to detect insufficient grounding and trigger deflection, while document pruning enables faster decoding than standard RAG.

AI.title_translation: BERAG：面向基于知识的视觉问答的贝叶斯集成检索增强生成
AI.tldr: BERAG通过逐token的贝叶斯后验概率集成替代传统RAG的文档拼接输入，解决了VQA长上下文计算开销大、“迷失在中间”以及归因困难等问题。
AI.motivation: 现有RAG普遍将检索文档拼接为单一上下文输入语言模型，这会导致文档贡献难以归因，引发长上下文“迷失在中间”效应，且带来计算复杂度随上下文长度呈二次方增长（在涉及视觉数据的视觉问答中尤为严重）。若通过限制上下文长度来缓解上述问题，又会牺牲深层检索带来的高召回率。
AI.method: 提出贝叶斯集成检索增强生成（BERAG）框架及对应的微调方法（BEFT）。该框架让语言模型分别以单篇检索文档为条件进行生成，而不是拼接长上下文；在生成过程中将文档后验概率作为集成权重，并利用贝叶斯法则逐token更新权重，从而实现概率重排序、并行内存使用、明确的文档贡献归因以及基于文档剪枝的快速解码。
AI.result: 在基于知识的视觉问答（VQA）任务、文档视觉问答（DocVQA）以及多模态“大海捞针”基准测试中均显著优于标准RAG；有效缓解了“迷失在中间”效应；利用文档后验概率可检测支撑依据不足并触发拒答/偏转，同时通过文档剪枝实现了比标准RAG更快的解码速度。
AI.conclusion: BERAG与BEFT成功克服了标准拼接式RAG在计算扩展性、文档归因和长上下文利用率方面的缺陷，在基于知识的视觉问答及多模态长上下文场景中展现出优越的性能与效率。
AI.translation: 在检索增强生成（RAG）问答中，一种常用方法是将多篇文档拼接成单一上下文并输入语言模型以生成答案。这种策略虽然简单，但容易模糊各个文档的独立贡献，导致归因困难，并加剧“迷失在中间”（lost-in-the-middle）效应，即长上下文中的相关信息易被忽略。拼接策略的可扩展性也很差：计算成本随上下文长度呈二次方增长，这一问题在上下文包含视觉数据（如视觉问答）时尤为严峻。若试图通过限制上下文长度来缓解这些问题，又会因无法利用深度检索带来的高召回率而进一步制约模型性能。为此，我们提出了贝叶斯集成检索增强生成（BERAG）以及贝叶斯集成微调（BEFT）框架。在该框架中，语言模型以单篇检索到的文档为条件，而非依赖单一的合并上下文。BERAG将文档后验概率视为集成权重，并在生成过程中使用贝叶斯法则逐token对其进行更新。该方法支持概率重排序、并行内存使用以及清晰的文档贡献归因，非常适用于大规模文档集。我们主要在基于知识的视觉问答任务中对BERAG和BEFT进行了评估，在这些任务中模型必须对长且不完美的检索列表进行推理。结果表明，相比标准RAG，该方法取得了显著提升，包括在文档视觉问答和多模态“大海捞针”基准测试中的大幅收益。我们还证明了BERAG能够减轻“迷失在中间”效应。此外，文档后验概率可用于检测依据不足并触发偏转，而文档剪枝技术则实现了比标准RAG更快的解码速度。
AI.summary: 本文提出了BERAG框架与BEFT微调方法，颠覆了传统RAG将多文档拼接输入的模式，转而让模型分别以单个文档为条件生成，并借助贝叶斯法则逐token动态更新文档后验概率进行集成。该方法在知识型视觉问答中显著提高了生成准确度、缓解了长上下文信息遗忘，并实现了更清晰的文档归因与更高效的剪枝解码。
AI.keywords: 检索增强生成, 视觉问答, 贝叶斯集成, 迷失在中间, 概率重排
AI.comments: 该论文针对多模态RAG中文档拼接带来的二次方计算开销、“迷失在中间”效应及归因模糊等痛点，创新性地提出基于贝叶斯定理的逐token后验概率集成更新机制。这种解耦处理单个文档的方式不仅保留了深层检索的高召回优势，还支持并行计算与文档剪枝加速，在理论严谨性与工程实用性上均具有显著意义。局限性在于未在摘要中明确其训练开销及更大规模多模态大模型上的泛化成本。

title: Probing Visual Planning in Image Editing Models
comments: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026. Our code is available at https://github.com/spatigen/amaze
summary: Visual planning represents a crucial facet of human intelligence, especially in tasks that require complex spatial reasoning and navigation. Yet, in machine learning, this inherently visual problem is often tackled through a verbal-centric lens. While recent research demonstrates the promise of fully visual approaches, they suffer from significant computational inefficiency due to the step-by-step planning-by-generation paradigm. In this work, we present EAR, an editing-as-reasoning paradigm that reformulates visual planning as a single-step image transformation. To isolate intrinsic reasoning from visual recognition, we employ abstract puzzles as probing tasks and introduce AMAZE, a procedurally generated dataset that features the classical Maze and Queen problems, covering distinct, complementary forms of visual planning. The abstract nature of AMAZE also facilitates automatic evaluation of autoregressive and diffusion-based models in terms of both pixel-wise fidelity and logical validity. We assess leading proprietary and open-source editing models. The results show that they all struggle in the zero-shot setting, finetuning on basic scales enables remarkable generalization to larger in-domain scales and out-of-domain scales and geometries. However, our best model that runs on high-end hardware fails to match the zero-shot efficiency of human solvers, highlighting a persistent gap in neural visual reasoning.
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026. Our code is available at https://github.com/spatigen/amaze

AI.title_translation: 探测图像编辑模型中的视觉规划
AI.tldr: 本文提出了“编辑-推理”范式和AMAZE数据集，用于探测和评估图像编辑模型在空间推理和视觉规划方面的能力，发现微调能显著提高泛化能力，但效率仍不及人类。
AI.motivation: 当前机器学习中的视觉规划通常采用以语言为中心的方法，或受限于逐步生成范式的高昂计算成本。本文旨在探究并提升图像编辑模型在无需繁琐逐步生成情况下的内在视觉规划与空间推理能力。
AI.method: 提出了 EAR（Editing-as-Reasoning）范式，将视觉规划重新定义为单步图像变换；引入了 AMAZE 数据集（包含 Maze 和 Queen 问题）作为探测任务，并利用其抽象性质对自回归和基于扩散的模型进行像素级保真度和逻辑有效性的自动评估。
AI.result: 现有领先的专有和开源图像编辑模型在零样本设置下均表现不佳；但在基础规模上进行微调后，它们展现出对更大同领域规模以及跨领域规模和几何形状的出色泛化能力；然而，顶级模型在效率上仍无法与人类求解器相比。
AI.conclusion: 尽管微调能显著提升图像编辑模型在视觉规划任务上的泛化能力，但顶尖模型在效率上仍远不及人类，凸显出当前神经网络在视觉推理方面的局限性。
AI.translation: 视觉规划是人类智能的一个至关重要方面，尤其是在需要复杂空间推理和导航的任务中。然而，在机器学习中，这个本质上的视觉问题通常通过以语言为中心的视角来处理。虽然最近的研究表明全视觉方法很有前景，但由于采用逐步生成的规划范式，它们遭受了显著的计算效率低下。在这项工作中，我们提出了EAR（编辑即推理）范式，将视觉规划重新定义为单步图像变换。为了将内在推理与视觉识别隔离开来，我们采用抽象谜题作为探测任务，并引入了AMAZE（一个程序生成的数据集，包含经典的迷宫和八皇后问题，涵盖了互补的视觉规划形式）。AMAZE的抽象性质还有助于从像素级保真度和逻辑有效性两个方面对自回归模型和基于扩散的模型进行自动评估。我们评估了领先的专有和开源编辑模型。结果表明，它们在零样本设置下都表现挣扎，但在基本规模上进行微调能够实现对更大域内规模以及域外规模和几何形状的显著泛化。然而，我们在高端硬件上运行的最佳模型仍未能匹配人类求解器的零样本效率，这凸显了神经视觉推理中仍然存在的差距。
AI.summary: 该论文探讨了图像编辑模型中的视觉规划能力，提出了一种将视觉规划转化为单步图像变换的 EAR 范式，并构建了 AMAZE 数据集进行评估。研究发现，虽然微调能带来显著的泛化能力，但现有模型在零样本性能和推理效率上与人类仍有明显差距。
AI.keywords: Visual planning, Image editing, Spatial reasoning, AMAZE dataset, Editing-as-reasoning
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种新颖的“编辑即推理”（EAR）范式，并通过构建抽象迷宫数据集 AMAZE 来评估图像编辑模型的视觉规划能力。研究揭示了当前模型在零样本设置下的不足以及微调后的泛化潜力，对理解和提升机器的视觉空间推理具有重要意义。

title: KubePACS: Kubernetes Cluster Using Performant, Highly Available, and Cost Efficient Spot Instances
comments: Accepted to the 27th ACM International Middleware Conference (Middleware 2026)
summary: Cloud users aim to minimize cost while maximizing performance by selecting the most suitable instance types for their workloads. To reduce expenses, spot instances have been widely adopted due to their steep discounts compared to on-demand pricing. However, their use introduces reliability risks due to potential interruptions, and existing research has primarily focused on mitigating this trade-off from a cost or availability perspective alone. Despite the diversity in hardware capabilities among instance types, current provisioning systems tend to ignore performance variation, selecting nodes solely based on minimum resource requirements. In this paper, we present KubePACS, a Kubernetes-native spot instance provisioning system that constructs node pools optimized for both cost and performance while guaranteeing high availability. KubePACS formulates the node selection process as a multi-objective optimization problem, incorporating real-time data such as spot prices, performance benchmarks, and availability scores, including the multi-node Spot Placement Score (SPS). It solves this problem efficiently using an Integer Linear Programming (ILP) approach guided by the Golden Section Search (GSS) algorithm to find the optimal configuration. By integrating with the Karpenter node autoscaler, KubePACS jointly optimizes instance-type selection and node scaling decisions within a standard provisioning workflow. KubePACS also adopts a novel heuristic to support workload-specific preferences by scaling performance metrics for specialized instances. Through extensive evaluation across synthetic and real-world workloads, KubePACS demonstrates on average 55.09% and up to 81.06% higher performance per dollar over state-of-the-art solutions such as Karpenter, SpotVerse, and SpotKube, which only reference the spot instance prices and limited availability data.
comment: Accepted to the 27th ACM International Middleware Conference (Middleware 2026)

AI.title_translation: KubePACS：使用高性能、高可用、高成本效益的竞价实例的Kubernetes集群
AI.tldr: KubePACS是一个Kubernetes原生的竞价实例供应系统，通过将节点选择过程建模为多目标优化问题（成本、性能、可用性），并利用ILP和GSS算法进行高效求解，显著提升了Kubernetes集群使用竞价实例的性能和成本效益。
AI.motivation: 云用户希望在最小化成本的同时最大化性能。竞价实例虽然具有成本优势，但存在中断风险，且现有系统在选择节点时往往忽略性能差异，未能同时优化成本和性能，仅从成本或可用性单一角度缓解权衡。
AI.method: KubePACS是一个Kubernetes原生的竞价实例供应系统，将节点选择过程表述为多目标优化问题，整合了实时数据（竞价价格、性能基准、可用性分数，包括多节点SPS）。它使用由黄金分割搜索（GSS）算法引导的整数线性规划（ILP）方法高效求解。通过与Karpenter节点自动扩缩器集成，共同优化实例类型选择和节点扩缩决策。还采用了一种新颖的启发式方法来支持工作负载特定偏好。
AI.result: KubePACS在合成和真实世界工作负载中，平均每美元性能比现有解决方案（如Karpenter、SpotVerse和SpotKube）高55.09%，最高可达81.06%。
AI.conclusion: KubePACS通过创新的多目标优化方法，成功地平衡了Kubernetes集群中使用竞价实例的成本、性能和可用性，显著超越了现有解决方案的效率和效益。
AI.translation: 云用户旨在通过选择最适合其工作负载的实例类型来最小化成本，同时最大化性能。为了降低开支，竞价实例因其相对于按需定价的巨大折扣而被广泛采用。然而，它们的使用带来了潜在中断导致的可靠性风险，现有研究主要仅从成本或可用性角度缓解这种权衡。尽管实例类型之间的硬件能力存在多样性，但当前的供应系统往往忽略性能差异，仅根据最低资源要求选择节点。在本文中，我们提出了KubePACS，一个Kubernetes原生的竞价实例供应系统，它构建了针对成本和性能进行优化同时保证高可用性的节点池。KubePACS将节点选择过程表述为多目标优化问题，整合了实时数据，如竞价价格、性能基准和可用性分数，包括多节点竞价放置分数（SPS）。它使用由黄金分割搜索（GSS）算法引导的整数线性规划（ILP）方法高效地解决此问题，以找到最优配置。通过与Karpenter节点自动扩缩器集成，KubePACS在标准供应工作流程中共同优化实例类型选择和节点扩缩决策。KubePACS还采用了一种新颖的启发式方法，通过为专用实例扩展性能指标来支持工作负载特定偏好。通过对合成和真实世界工作负载的广泛评估，KubePACS展示了平均每美元性能比现有最先进解决方案（如Karpenter、SpotVerse和SpotKube，它们仅参考竞价实例价格和有限的可用性数据）高55.09%，最高达81.06%。
AI.summary: KubePACS是一个Kubernetes原生的竞价实例供应系统，旨在解决现有方案在成本、性能和可用性之间权衡的不足。它通过将节点选择建模为多目标优化问题，整合实时数据（价格、性能、可用性），并采用ILP和GSS算法进行求解，构建了高性能、高可用且成本效益高的节点池。KubePACS与Karpenter集成，并引入了支持工作负载特定偏好的启发式方法。实验结果表明，KubePACS在性能/成本效益方面显著优于现有解决方案。
AI.keywords: Kubernetes, 竞价实例, 多目标优化, 成本效益, 高可用性
AI.comments: KubePACS的创新点在于将竞价实例的成本、性能和可用性问题整合为一个多目标优化问题，并利用先进的优化算法（ILP、GSS）进行求解，这比现有仅关注单一维度的解决方案更为全面和高效。与Karpenter的集成也使其更具实用性。其显著的性能提升证明了该方法的有效性。

title: A systematic evaluation of vision-language models for observational astronomical reasoning tasks
comments: 42 pages, 15 figures, 11 tables. Accepted at NeurIPS 2026, Track on Evaluations and Datasets
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly proposed as general-purpose tools for scientific data interpretation, yet their reliability on real astronomical observations across diverse modalities remains untested. We present AstroVLBench, a benchmark of over 4,100 expert-verified instances across five tasks spanning optical imaging, radio interferometry, multi-wavelength photometry, time-domain light curves, and optical spectroscopy. We systematically evaluate six state-of-the-art frontier models and find that performance is strongly modality-dependent and uncorrelated with general benchmark rankings. Mechanistic cross-model ablations reveal three concrete bottlenecks. First, prompt grounding exhibits marked model and task dependence: physical guidance yields more balanced classifications on optical imaging, whereas phenomenological prompts better navigate undersampled time-domain data. Second, presenting one-dimensional measurements as numerical tables rather than rendered plots consistently improves light-curve classification across all models by up to 23 percentage points, demonstrating that plot rendering can obscure physically relevant signal. Third, an expert audit of optical spectroscopy reveals a notable "right-answer-wrong-reason" phenomenon: across evaluated models, an average of 26% of correct predictions are accompanied by physically inconsistent or invalid reasoning chains, showing that accuracy alone is insufficient for trustworthy scientific deployment. AstroVLBench provides the first systematic, multi-modal baselines for VLMs in observational astronomy and identifies the representation, grounding, and reasoning bottlenecks that must be addressed before VLMs can be trusted as autonomous scientific interpreters.
comment: 42 pages, 15 figures, 11 tables. Accepted at NeurIPS 2026, Track on Evaluations and Datasets

AI.title_translation: 视觉语言模型在观测天文学推理任务中的系统评估
AI.tldr: 本文提出了AstroVLBench基准，系统评估了视觉语言模型在天文观测任务中的表现，揭示了其在表征、接地和科学推理方面的三大瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型（VLMs）虽被广泛用作科学数据解释的通用工具，但它们在跨多种模态的真实天文观测数据上的可靠性尚未得到测试。
AI.method: 提出了包含超过4,100个专家验证实例的AstroVLBench基准，涵盖光学成像、射电干涉、多波段光度测距、时域光变曲线和光学光谱五大任务，系统评估了六个前沿视觉语言模型，并进行了机制性跨模型消融实验与专家审计。
AI.result: 模型性能表现出强烈的模态依赖性且与通用基准排名不相关；识别出三个具体瓶颈：提示词接地依赖性、1D数据数值表比渲染图表表现更好（提升达23个百分点）、以及光谱学中存在的“正确答案但错误理由”（平均26%）现象。
AI.conclusion: AstroVLBench证明了当前前沿视觉语言模型在天文观测推理任务中表现出显著的模态依赖性及推理缺陷，必须解决表征、接地和推理瓶颈，才能实现可信的科学部署。
AI.translation: 视觉语言模型（VLMs）越来越多地被提议作为科学数据解释的通用工具，然而它们在跨多种模态的真实天文观测数据上的可靠性仍未得到测试。我们提出了 AstroVLBench，这是一个包含超过 4,100 个专家验证实例的基准，涵盖五个任务：光学成像、射电干涉测量、多波段光度测距、时域光变曲线和光学光谱。我们系统地评估了六个最先进的前沿模型，发现性能强烈依赖于模态，且与通用基准排名不相关。机制性跨模型消融实验揭示了三个具体的瓶颈。首先，提示词接地表现出明显的模型和任务依赖性：物理引导在光学成像上产生更平衡的分类，而现象学提示更好地应对采样不足的时域数据。其次，将一维测量结果表示为数值表格而不是渲染的图表，在所有模型中将光变曲线分类的准确率一致提高了多达 23 个百分点，这表明图表渲染可能会掩盖物理相关的信号。第三，对光学光谱的专家审计揭示了一个显著的“正确答案但错误理由”现象：在评估的模型中，平均 26% 的正确预测伴随着物理上不一致或无效的推理链，这表明仅靠准确性不足以实现可靠的科学部署。AstroVLBench 为视觉语言模型在观测天文学中的应用提供了第一个系统性的多模态基准，并指出了在将视觉语言模型作为自主科学解释器信任之前必须解决的表征、接地和推理瓶颈。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了AstroVLBench，这是一个用于评估视觉语言模型在观测天文学中表现的综合基准。通过对五个天文任务和六个前沿模型的系统评测，作者揭示了模型在模态适应性、数据表征方式以及科学推理真实性方面的三大核心瓶颈。
AI.keywords: 视觉语言模型, 天文学基准, 多模态评估, 科学AI, 可解释性
AI.comments: 该论文填补了视觉语言模型在天文学观测任务中系统性评估的空白，揭示了当前大模型在科学推理中的深层局限（如表面正确、表征偏差等），对未来可信科学AI的开发具有重要指导意义。

title: Asymmetric-Information Resource Allocation Games: An LP Approach to Purposeful Deception
summary: In this work, we introduce the Deceptive Resource Allocation Game (DRAG), which studies purposeful deception within a Bayesian game framework. In DRAG, a Defender allocates resources across the true asset and several decoys to influence an Attacker's beliefs and actions, with the goal of diverting the Attacker away from the true asset. We seek to characterize purposeful deception, whereby the Defender deceives only when doing so improves its performance. To this end, we solve for the Perfect Bayesian Nash Equilibrium (PBNE) of the corresponding game. We show that, despite the coupled belief-policy interdependence, the problem admits an efficient, non-iterative linear programming formulation. Numerical results demonstrate that the resulting policies naturally balance effective allocation and belief manipulation, giving rise to purposeful and emergent deceptive behaviors.

AI.title_translation: 非对称信息资源分配博弈：一种针对有目的欺骗的线性规划方法
AI.tldr: 引入欺骗性资源分配博弈(DRAG)模型，在贝叶斯博弈框架下研究防御者如何通过资源分配和诱饵有目的地欺骗攻击者，以保护真实资产。该问题可通过高效的线性规划方法求解完美贝叶斯纳什均衡。
AI.motivation: 研究防御者在贝叶斯博弈框架下如何通过资源分配和诱饵来有目的地欺骗攻击者，以保护真实资产。目标是表征有目的的欺骗行为，即防御者仅在能提高性能时才进行欺骗。
AI.method: 引入欺骗性资源分配博弈（DRAG），在贝叶斯博弈框架下建模。通过求解相应博弈的完美贝叶斯纳什均衡（PBNE）。证明该问题可以通过高效、非迭代的线性规划（LP）公式解决，尽管存在耦合的信念-策略相互依赖性。
AI.result: 数值结果表明，由此产生的策略自然地平衡了有效的资源分配和信念操纵，从而产生了有目的和突发的欺骗行为。
AI.conclusion: 该研究表明，通过线性规划方法可以有效地刻画和解决有目的的欺骗行为，并产生平衡资源分配和信念操纵的有效欺骗策略。
AI.translation: 在这项工作中，我们引入了欺骗性资源分配博弈（DRAG），它在贝叶斯博弈框架内研究有目的的欺骗。在DRAG中，防御者将资源分配给真实资产和几个诱饵，以影响攻击者的信念和行动，目标是将攻击者从真实资产上引开。我们旨在表征有目的的欺骗，即防御者仅在这样做能提高其性能时才进行欺骗。为此，我们求解了相应博弈的完美贝叶斯纳什均衡（PBNE）。我们表明，尽管存在耦合的信念-策略相互依赖性，该问题仍允许一个高效、非迭代的线性规划公式。数值结果表明，由此产生的策略自然地平衡了有效的分配和信念操纵，从而产生了有目的和突发的欺骗行为。
AI.summary: 本文引入了欺骗性资源分配博弈（DRAG），在贝叶斯博弈框架下分析防御者如何通过资源分配和诱饵来有目的地欺骗攻击者，以保护真实资产。研究通过求解完美贝叶斯纳什均衡来表征有目的欺骗，并证明该问题可以通过高效的线性规划方法解决。数值结果表明，所提出的策略能有效平衡资源分配和信念操纵，产生有目的的欺骗行为。
AI.keywords: 欺骗性资源分配博弈, 贝叶斯博弈, 线性规划, 完美贝叶斯纳什均衡, 有目的欺骗
AI.comments: 这篇论文通过引入DRAG模型和利用线性规划解决PBNE，为研究非对称信息下的有目的欺骗提供了一个新颖且高效的分析框架。其创新点在于将复杂的贝叶斯博弈问题转化为可求解的线性规划，并证明了其在生成有效欺骗策略方面的潜力。这对于安全领域中的资源分配和防御策略设计具有重要意义。

title: When the Forger Is the Judge: GPT-Image-2 Cannot Recognize Its Own Faked Documents
summary: OpenAI's GPT-Image-2 has effectively erased the visual boundary between authentic and AI-edited document images: a single number on a receipt can be replaced in under a second for a few cents. We release AIForge-Doc v2, a paired dataset of 3,066 GPT-Image-2 document forgeries with pixel-precise masks in DocTamper-compatible format, and benchmark four lines of defence: human inspectors (N=120, n=365 pair-votes via the public 2AFC site CanUSpotAI.com), TruFor (generic forensic), DocTamper (qcf-568, document-specific), and the same GPT-Image-2 model as a zero-shot self-judge -- asked, to avoid the trivial "image is mostly real" reading, whether any region was generated or edited by an AI image model. Human 2AFC accuracy is 0.501, indistinguishable from chance: even side-by-side, inspectors cannot tell GPT-Image-2 receipt forgeries from authentic counterparts. The three computational judges sit only modestly above (TruFor 0.599, DocTamper 0.585, self-judge 0.532). The self-judge fails consistently, not by chance: across five prompt strategies and four policies for handling ambiguous responses, AUC never rises above 0.59. To rule out the possibility that the two forensic detectors are broken on our source domain rather than blind to AI inpainting, we calibrate each on a same-domain traditional-tampering set built for its training distribution: TruFor reaches AUC 0.962 on cross-camera splicing of our dataset, DocTamper reaches 0.852 on cross-document OCR-token splicing with two-pass JPEG re-encoding. Both retain near-published performance on traditional tampering; switching to GPT-Image-2 inpainting drops AUC by 0.27-0.36 (0.962->0.599 TruFor; 0.852->0.585 DocTamper), isolating a detection gap specific to GPT-Image-2 inpainting. We release the dataset, pipeline, four-judge protocol, and calibration sets.

AI.title_translation: 当伪造者成为裁判：GPT-Image-2无法识别自身伪造的文档
AI.tldr: GPT-Image-2生成的文档伪造极其逼真，人类、传统取证工具和模型自身均无法有效识别，暴露出严重的AI取证漏洞。
AI.motivation: 随着OpenAI的GPT-Image-2模糊了真实文档与AI编辑文档的视觉界限，评估人类和现有计算取证方法在识别此类新型AI文档伪造方面的能力变得至关重要。
AI.method: 构建了包含3,066个GPT-Image-2文档伪造样本的配对数据集（AIForge-Doc v2），并对人类检查员（2AFC测试）、通用取证工具（TruFor）、文档特定取证工具（DocTamper）以及模型零样本自我裁判（self-judge）这四种防御手段进行了基准测试。
AI.result: 人类准确率为50.1%（如同盲猜），计算取证工具表现略高于随机水平（TruFor 0.599, DocTamper 0.585），而GPT-Image-2作为自我裁判完全失效（AUC最高0.59），证明当前技术存在针对AI图像内补（inpainting）的明显检测盲区。
AI.conclusion: GPT-Image-2生成的文档伪造极难被检测，无论是人类、传统取证模型还是模型自身均无法有效识别，暴露出当前AI图像篡改检测技术的重大盲区。
AI.translation: OpenAI的GPT-Image-2有效地抹去了真实文档图像与AI编辑文档图像之间的视觉界限：收据上的单个数字可以在不到一秒钟的时间内以几美分的价格被替换。我们发布了AIForge-Doc v2，这是一个包含3,066个GPT-Image-2文档伪造样本的配对数据集，带有DocTamper兼容格式的像素级掩码，并对四条防线进行了基准测试：人类检查员（N=120，通过公开的2AFC网站CanUSpotAI.com进行了365次配对投票）、TruFor（通用取证）、DocTamper（qcf-568，文档专用）以及作为零样本自我裁判的同一GPT-Image-2模型（被要求判断是否有任何区域是由AI图像模型生成或编辑的，以避免简单的“图像主要是真实”的解读）。人类2AFC准确率为0.501，与随机无异：即使并排对比，检查员也无法分辨GPT-Image-2收据伪造与其真实对应物。三个计算裁判的成绩仅略高于随机水平（TruFor 0.599，DocTamper 0.585，自我裁判0.532）。自我裁判持续失败，且并非由于随机：在五种提示策略和四种处理模糊响应的策略下，AUC从未超过0.59。为了排除两个取证检测器在其源域上失效而不是对AI内补盲目的可能性，我们针对其训练分布的同域传统篡改集对每个检测器进行了校准：TruFor在我们数据集的跨相机拼接上达到了0.962的AUC，DocTamper在具有两次JPEG重新编码的跨文档OCR标记拼接上达到了0.852的AUC。两者在传统篡改上都保持了接近发表时的性能；切换到GPT-Image-2内补使AUC下降了0.27-0.36（TruFor从0.962降至0.599；DocTamper从0.852降至0.585），隔离出了特定于GPT-Image-2内补的检测差距。我们发布了数据集、流程、四裁判协议和校准集。
AI.summary: 论文研究了OpenAI的GPT-Image-2在文档篡改方面的识别难度。通过发布AIForge-Doc v2数据集并测试四种防御手段（人类、通用取证、专用取证及模型自我裁判），发现无论是人还是各类计算模型都无法有效识别GPT-Image-2的高级文档伪造，凸显了现有AI取证技术的局限性。
AI.keywords: 文档篡改, AI生成图像, 图像取证, GPT-Image-2, 深度伪造检测
AI.comments: 该论文揭示了当前最先进的AI图像编辑工具在文档篡改检测上的巨大漏洞，无论是人类、传统取证工具还是模型自身（作为裁判）都难以有效识别其伪造痕迹，凸显了AI生成图像取证领域面临的严峻挑战。

title: GPT-Image-2 in the Wild: A Twitter Dataset of Self-Reported AI-Generated Images from the First Week of Deployment
comments: 11 pages; GPT-image-2 social media dataset; Twitter API collection and multilingual curation; C2PA watermark stripping on platform upload; browser-automated AI badge verification; CLIP semantic clustering; AI-generated image provenance and attribution
summary:
The release of GPT-image-2 by OpenAI marks a watershed moment in AI-generated imagery: the boundary between photographic reality and synthetic content has never been more difficult to discern. We introduce the GPT-Image-2 Twitter Dataset, the first published dataset of GPT-image-2 generated images, sourced from publicly available Twitter/X posts in the immediate aftermath of the model's April 21, 2026 release. Leveraging the Twitter API v2 and a multi-stage curation pipeline spanning multilingual text heuristics (English, Japanese, and Chinese), browser-automated Twitter "Made with AI" badge verification, and model name variant matching, we curate 10,217 confirmed GPT-image-2 images from 27,662 collected records over a six-day window.
  We characterize the dataset across four analyses: CLIP-based zero-shot subject taxonomy, OCR text legibility (82.0% of images contain detectable text), face detection (59.2% of images, 22,583 total faces), and semantic clustering (137 CLIP ViT-L/14 clusters).
  A key negative result is that C2PA content credentials are systematically stripped by Twitter's CDN on upload, rendering cryptographic provenance verification infeasible for social-media-sourced AI images. The dataset and all curation code are released publicly.
comment: 11 pages; GPT-image-2 social media dataset; Twitter API collection and multilingual curation; C2PA watermark stripping on platform upload; browser-automated AI badge verification; CLIP semantic clustering; AI-generated image provenance and attribution

AI.title_translation: GPT-Image-2在野外：部署第一周自报告的AI生成图像的Twitter数据集
AI.tldr: 本文介绍了首个GPT-Image-2生成图像的Twitter数据集，包含10,217张图像，并揭示了社交媒体平台在上传过程中会剥离C2PA内容凭证，使得加密溯源验证不可行。
AI.motivation: 随着OpenAI发布的GPT-image-2，AI生成图像与真实摄影内容之间的界限变得前所未有的模糊和难以辨别。为了应对这一挑战并深入研究AI生成图像，需要一个专门的数据集。
AI.method: 研究团队利用Twitter API v2，在GPT-image-2模型发布后的第一周内，从公开的Twitter/X帖子中收集数据。通过一个多阶段策展流程，结合多语言文本启发式（英语、日语、中文）、浏览器自动化Twitter“AI生成”徽章验证以及模型名称变体匹配，筛选并确认了GPT-image-2生成的图像。数据集通过CLIP零样本主题分类、OCR文本可读性分析、人脸检测和语义聚类（CLIP ViT-L/14）进行了特征描述。
AI.result: 从27,662条收集记录中，最终整理出10,217张已确认的GPT-image-2生成图像。数据集分析显示：82.0%的图像包含可检测文本；59.2%的图像包含人脸（共22,583张人脸）；形成了137个语义聚类。一个关键的负面结果是，C2PA内容凭证在上传到Twitter的CDN时被系统性剥离，导致社交媒体来源的AI图像无法进行加密溯源验证。
AI.conclusion: 本文发布了首个GPT-image-2生成图像的Twitter数据集及其所有策展代码，为研究AI生成内容提供了宝贵资源。研究还发现社交媒体平台（如Twitter）在上传过程中会系统性剥离C2PA内容凭证，使得通过加密方式验证AI图像的来源变得不可行。
AI.translation:
OpenAI发布的GPT-image-2标志着AI生成图像的一个分水岭时刻：摄影现实与合成内容之间的界限从未如此难以辨别。我们介绍了GPT-Image-2 Twitter数据集，这是第一个发布的GPT-image-2生成图像数据集，来源于模型于2026年4月21日发布后立即公开的Twitter/X帖子。我们利用Twitter API v2和一个多阶段的策展流程，涵盖多语言文本启发式（英语、日语和中文）、浏览器自动化Twitter“AI生成”徽章验证以及模型名称变体匹配，在六天内从27,662条收集记录中整理出10,217张已确认的GPT-image-2图像。
我们从四方面分析了数据集：基于CLIP的零样本主题分类、OCR文本可读性（82.0%的图像包含可检测文本）、人脸检测（59.2%的图像，共22,583张人脸）和语义聚类（137个CLIP ViT-L/14聚类）。
一个关键的负面结果是，C2PA内容凭证在上传到Twitter的CDN时被系统性剥离，使得社交媒体来源的AI图像无法进行加密溯源验证。数据集和所有策展代码均已公开发布。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了首个GPT-Image-2 Twitter数据集，该数据集从GPT-image-2模型发布后第一周的Twitter/X帖子中收集，包含10,217张经多阶段策展确认的AI生成图像。研究团队对数据集进行了CLIP主题分类、OCR文本检测、人脸检测和语义聚类分析。一个重要发现是C2PA内容凭证在Twitter的CDN上传时会被剥离，导致社交媒体上的AI图像难以进行加密溯源验证。数据集和策展代码已公开。
AI.keywords: GPT-Image-2, AI生成图像, Twitter数据集, C2PA, 内容溯源
AI.comments: 这篇论文通过构建和发布首个GPT-Image-2生成图像的Twitter数据集，为研究AI生成内容的传播、识别和影响提供了宝贵的实证数据。其创新性体现在结合多语言文本启发式和平台特定徽章验证进行数据策展。研究揭示的C2PA内容凭证在社交媒体平台上的系统性剥离问题，指出了当前AI内容溯源技术在实际应用中面临的重大挑战和限制，对未来内容验证技术的发展具有重要的警示和指导意义。

title: Why Are Some Emotions Harder for LLMs? Uncovering the Causal Mechanisms of Emotion Inference via Sparse Autoencoders
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in emotionally sensitive human-AI applications, where reliable emotion detection is essential. However, their emotion recognition abilities remain uneven: models often perform well on some emotions while consistently struggling with others. Although recent work has explored emotion mechanisms in LLMs, little is known about why models are weaker on some emotions than others from a mechanistic interpretability perspective. In this work, we investigate emotion-specific biases through the causal mechanisms of emotion inference using sparse autoencoders (SAEs). We systematically identify causal sparse emotion features that drive emotion inference and analyze their sparse causal organization within and across emotions. We show that some emotions, such as surprise and fear, rely on highly concentrated feature sets, whereas disgust exhibits a more distributed sparse causal organization: its causal features are generally weaker, frequently co-activate with features for other emotions, and are often overshadowed by causal features for anger. These representational differences provide a mechanistic explanation for why LLMs struggle more with certain emotions. Finally, we conduct two intervention experiments: targeted steering of weaker causal features to mitigate emotion-specific failures, and global optimization of a steering vector over the identified causal features to improve overall emotion recognition performance.

AI.title_translation: 为什么某些情绪对大语言模型来说更难？通过稀疏自编码器揭示情绪推理的因果机制
AI.tldr: 本研究利用稀疏自编码器揭示了为什么大语言模型难以识别某些特定情绪的机制原因，并证实了通过干预因果特征可以改善模型的情感识别性能。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在情感敏感应用中日益普及，但其情感识别能力存在不均衡现象（某些情绪表现好而另一些困难），目前对其背后的机制可解释性原因尚不明确。
AI.method: 利用稀疏自编码器（SAEs）系统识别驱动情感推理的因果稀疏情绪特征，分析其在情绪内部及之间的稀疏因果组织，并开展特征定向干预和全局优化实验。
AI.result: 研究发现，诸如惊讶和恐惧等情绪依赖于高度集中的特征集，而厌恶则呈现更分散的稀疏因果组织（其因果特征较弱、常与其他情绪特征共激活、且常被愤怒的因果特征掩盖）；定向干预实验成功缓解了特定情绪的失败并提升了整体识别性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过SAE揭示了LLM中情感识别困难的机制原因，即不同情绪的因果特征组织形式存在差异，并通过定向干预提升了情感识别性能。
AI.translation: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被应用于对情绪敏感的人机交互应用中，在这些应用中，可靠的情绪检测至关重要。然而，它们的情绪识别能力仍然很不均衡：模型通常在某些情绪上表现良好，而对其他情绪则持续表现不佳。尽管最近的研究探讨了LLM中的情绪机制，但从机制可解释性的角度来看，人们对模型在某些情绪上比其他情绪更弱的原因知之少之。在这项工作中，我们通过稀疏自编码器（SAE）的情绪推理因果机制来调查情绪特定偏差。我们系统地识别了驱动情绪推理的因果稀疏情绪特征，并分析了它们在情绪内部和跨情绪的稀疏因果组织。我们表明，一些情绪（如惊讶和恐惧）依赖于高度集中的特征集，而厌恶则表现出更分散的稀疏因果组织：其因果特征通常较弱，经常与其它情绪特征共同激活，并且经常被愤怒的因果特征所掩盖。这些表征差异为LLM为何在某些情绪上更加困难提供了机制解释。最后，我们进行了两项干预实验：对较弱的因果特征进行定向操纵以缓解特定情绪的失败，以及对识别出的因果特征上的操纵向量进行全局优化，以提高整体情绪识别性能。
AI.summary: 本文利用稀疏自编码器揭示了大语言模型在不同情绪识别上表现不均衡的因果机制，发现不同情绪的因果特征组织形式（集中与分散）存在显著差异，并证明了通过特征干预可以有效提升模型的整体情感识别能力。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 情感推理, 机制可解释性, 稀疏自编码器, 因果特征
AI.comments: 本文通过稀疏自编码器（SAE）从机制可解释性角度探讨了大语言模型在情感识别上面临的不均衡性，填补了该领域的空白，并通过干预实验验证了因果特征的有效性。

title: Linear-Core Surrogates: Smooth Loss Functions with Linear Rates for Classification and Structured Prediction
summary: A fundamental dichotomy in the theory of classification sets smoothness against statistical efficiency: smooth surrogate losses such as the logistic loss enable fast $O(1/T)$ optimization but yield slow square-root $H$-consistency bounds, while piecewise-linear losses like the Hinge loss achieve optimal linear $H$-consistency rates but are non-differentiable. We introduce Linear-Core (LC) Surrogates, the first family of explicit convex loss functions that provably resolve this tension. By stitching a linear core to a smooth tail, we construct surrogates that are differentiable everywhere ($C^1$, and even $C^2$ under mild conditions) while retaining strict linear $H$-consistency bounds, the strongest known form of consistency guarantee. We establish these linear bounds across three increasingly complex settings: binary classification, multi-class classification, and structured prediction. To our knowledge, this is the first explicit construction to simultaneously achieve smoothness and linear $H$-consistency in any of these settings. Beyond their theoretical appeal, Linear-Core Surrogates offer practical advantages. In multi-class classification, their constant gradient profile near the decision boundary provides natural robustness to instance-dependent label noise, outperforming Cross-Entropy by 2.6% on corrupted CIFAR-10. In structured prediction, their smoothness enables an unbiased stochastic gradient estimator that bypasses the $O(|Y|^2)$ per-step complexity of exact inference, yielding a 23$\times$ speedup over Structured SVMs on large-vocabulary sequence tagging tasks.

AI.title_translation: 线性核替代：具有线性速率的平滑损失函数，用于分类和结构化预测
AI.tldr: 引入线性核（LC）替代损失函数，首次实现了平滑性（可微）和最优线性H一致性，解决了现有损失函数在平滑性与统计效率之间的矛盾，并在分类和结构化预测中展现出理论和实践优势。
AI.motivation: 现有分类理论中，平滑损失函数（如逻辑损失）优化快但H一致性慢，而非可微损失函数（如Hinge损失）H一致性最优但优化困难。该研究旨在解决平滑性与统计效率之间的根本矛盾。
AI.method: 引入线性核（LC）替代损失函数，通过将线性核与平滑尾部拼接，构建了处处可微（$C^1$，在温和条件下甚至是$C^2$）的凸损失函数。
AI.result: LC替代函数在二元分类、多类分类和结构化预测中都保持严格的线性H一致性界限。在多类分类中，对实例依赖的标签噪声具有鲁棒性，在受损CIFAR-10上比交叉熵表现提高2.6%。在结构化预测中，其平滑性使得无偏随机梯度估计器能够绕过精确推断的$O(|Y|^2)$每步复杂度，在大词汇量序列标注任务上比结构化SVMs加速23倍。这是首次在这些设置中同时实现平滑性和线性H一致性的显式构造。
AI.conclusion: 线性核替代损失函数是第一个能够同时实现平滑性和最优线性H一致性的显式凸损失函数家族，解决了现有损失函数在理论上的矛盾，并在实践中展现出显著优势。
AI.translation: 分类理论中存在一个根本性的二分法，即平滑性与统计效率之间的矛盾：逻辑损失等平滑替代损失函数能够实现快速的$O(1/T)$优化，但产生缓慢的平方根H一致性界限；而Hinge损失等分段线性损失函数能够实现最优的线性H一致性速率，但不可微。我们引入了线性核（LC）替代函数，这是第一个能够明确解决这一矛盾的显式凸损失函数家族。通过将线性核与平滑尾部拼接，我们构建了处处可微（$C^1$，在温和条件下甚至是$C^2$）的替代函数，同时保持严格的线性H一致性界限，这是已知最强的一致性保证形式。我们在三个日益复杂的设置中建立了这些线性界限：二元分类、多类分类和结构化预测。据我们所知，这是首次在这些设置中的任何一个中同时实现平滑性和线性H一致性的显式构造。除了其理论吸引力之外，线性核替代函数还提供了实际优势。在多类分类中，它们在决策边界附近的恒定梯度分布为实例依赖的标签噪声提供了自然的鲁棒性，在受损CIFAR-10上比交叉熵表现提高2.6%。在结构化预测中，它们的平滑性使得无偏随机梯度估计器能够绕过精确推断的$O(|Y|^2)$每步复杂度，在大词汇量序列标注任务上比结构化SVMs加速23倍。
AI.summary: 本文提出了线性核（LC）替代损失函数，旨在解决分类理论中平滑损失函数（优化快但H一致性慢）和非可微损失函数（H一致性最优但优化困难）之间的矛盾。LC替代函数通过将线性核与平滑尾部拼接，构建了处处可微且保持严格线性H一致性界限的凸损失函数。实验证明，LC替代函数在二元分类、多类分类和结构化预测中均能保持其理论优势，并在多类分类中对噪声具有更强的鲁棒性，在结构化预测中显著提高了计算效率。
AI.keywords: 线性核替代, 平滑损失函数, 线性H一致性, 分类, 结构化预测
AI.comments: 这项工作通过引入线性核替代损失函数，巧妙地解决了机器学习中长期存在的平滑性与统计效率之间的两难困境。其创新之处在于首次明确构造出同时具备可微性和最优H一致性的损失函数，这不仅具有重要的理论意义，也为实际应用中的分类和结构化预测任务提供了性能更优、计算更高效的工具。特别是在处理标签噪声和大规模结构化预测时，展现出显著的实用价值。

title: Repetition over Diversity: High-Signal Data Filtering for Sample-Efficient German Language Modeling
summary: Recent research has shown that filtering massive English web corpora into high-quality subsets significantly improves training efficiency. However, for high-resource non-English languages like German, French, or Japanese, aggressive filtering creates a strategic dilemma: should practitioners prioritize diversity by training once on large amounts of lightly filtered web data, or prioritize quality by strictly filtering for a high-quality core and repeating it over multiple epochs? We investigate this trade-off for German by applying hierarchical quality filters to 500M web documents, comparing multi-epoch training on filtered subsets against single-pass training on a diverse corpus. Our experiments across multiple model scales and token budgets show that repeating high-quality data consistently outperforms single-pass training on larger, less filtered sets. Notably, the performance gap persists even after 7 epochs. Our findings suggest that for non-English LLMs, semantic concentration through quality filtering offers a more viable path to efficient language modeling than simply maximizing unique data volume. We release our German language models (called Boldt), as well as our cleaned evaluation benchmarks to the research community. Our experiments indicate that they achieve state-of-the-art results despite training on 10-360x fewer tokens than comparable models.

AI.title_translation: 重复胜于多样性：高信号数据过滤用于样本高效的德语语言建模
AI.tldr: 对于德语等非英语LLM，重复使用高质量数据进行多轮训练比单次训练更大、过滤较少的数据集更有效，能实现更高的训练效率和SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有研究表明，过滤英语网络语料库可以提高训练效率，但对于德语等高资源非英语语言，存在一个策略困境：是优先考虑多样性（在大量轻度过滤数据上训练一次），还是优先考虑质量（严格过滤出高质量核心数据并重复训练多轮）？
AI.method: 研究人员通过对5亿份德语网络文档应用分层质量过滤器来调查这一权衡。他们比较了在过滤后的子集上进行多轮训练与在多样化语料库上进行单次训练的效果，并在多种模型规模和token预算下进行了实验。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，重复使用高质量数据始终优于在更大、过滤较少的数据集上进行单次训练。即使在7个epoch之后，性能差距依然存在。研究发现，对于非英语LLM，通过质量过滤实现语义集中比简单地最大化独特数据量更能有效实现高效语言建模。他们发布的德语语言模型（Boldt）和清理后的评估基准，尽管训练所需的token比同类模型少10-360倍，但仍取得了最先进的结果。
AI.conclusion: 对于非英语大型语言模型，通过质量过滤实现语义集中并重复利用高质量数据，是实现高效语言建模比简单地最大化独特数据量更可行的途径。
AI.translation: 最近的研究表明，将海量的英语网络语料库过滤成高质量子集可以显著提高训练效率。然而，对于德语、法语或日语等高资源非英语语言，激进的过滤策略造成了一个战略困境：实践者应该通过在大量轻度过滤的网络数据上训练一次来优先考虑多样性，还是通过严格过滤以获得高质量核心数据并在多个epoch中重复使用来优先考虑质量？我们通过对5亿份网络文档应用分层质量过滤器来调查德语的这种权衡，比较了在过滤后的子集上进行多epoch训练与在多样化语料库上进行单次训练的效果。我们在多种模型规模和token预算下的实验表明，重复使用高质量数据始终优于在更大、过滤较少的数据集上进行单次训练。值得注意的是，即使在7个epoch之后，性能差距仍然存在。我们的发现表明，对于非英语LLM，通过质量过滤实现语义集中比简单地最大化独特数据量更能为高效语言建模提供一条更可行的路径。我们向研究社区发布了我们的德语语言模型（Boldt）以及我们清理后的评估基准。我们的实验表明，尽管它们的训练token比同类模型少10-360倍，但仍取得了最先进的结果。
AI.summary: 该研究探讨了非英语大型语言模型（以德语为例）数据过滤的策略。针对多样性与质量的权衡，作者通过对德语网络数据进行分层质量过滤，并比较了重复训练高质量子集与单次训练多样化语料库的效果。结果表明，重复使用高质量数据显著优于在更大、过滤较少的数据集上进行单次训练，即使经过多个训练周期性能差距依然存在。这表明对于非英语LLM，通过质量过滤实现语义集中是实现高效语言建模的更有效途径，甚至能以远少于同类模型的token量达到最先进的性能。
AI.keywords: 数据过滤, 德语语言模型, 样本效率, 高质量数据, 重复训练
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于它挑战了“数据量越大越好”的传统观念，特别是在非英语LLM领域。它提供了一个新的视角，即通过严格的质量过滤和重复利用高质量数据，可以在大大减少训练数据量和计算资源的情况下，依然实现甚至超越最先进的性能。这对于资源有限的非英语语言LLM开发具有重要意义，提供了一条更高效、更可持续的路径。其局限性可能在于高质量数据过滤标准的普适性，以及该策略在其他非英语语言上的泛化能力。

title: Fidelity-Guaranteed Entanglement Routing with Distributed Purification Planning
comments: 11 pages, 6 figures. Submitted to IEEE QCE 2026. Code available at: https://github.com/anthony-gatti/q-guard
summary: Many quantum-network applications require end-to-end Bell pairs whose fidelity exceeds a request-specific threshold, but existing entanglement routing algorithms either optimize only throughput without regard for fidelity or enforce fidelity guarantees using centralized controllers with global link-state knowledge. We present Q-GUARD, an online entanglement routing algorithm that enforces per-request fidelity thresholds within a distributed protocol model in which nodes exchange link-state information only with their $k$-hop neighbors. After link outcomes are realized in each slot, Q-GUARD builds per-link purification cost tables from realized Bell pairs, allocates per-hop fidelity targets using a Werner-state equal-split rule, and selects between candidate path segments using a segment-local expected-goodput (EXG) metric that jointly accounts for swap success, purification overhead, and resource availability. We also introduce Q-GUARD-WS, an extension that exploits per-link hardware quality estimates to allocate purification effort non-uniformly across hops. On synthetic 100-node topologies with heterogeneous link fidelity and stochastic BBPSSW purification, Q-GUARD raises the qualified success rate from under 20\% to over 85\% on 4-hop paths and nearly doubles the qualified service radius in Euclidean distance relative to throughput-only and naive-purification baselines, while Q-GUARD-WS provides additional throughput gains under high hardware heterogeneity.
comment: 11 pages, 6 figures. Submitted to IEEE QCE 2026. Code available at: https://github.com/anthony-gatti/q-guard

AI.title_translation: 具有分布式提纯规划的保真度保证纠缠路由
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为Q-GUARD的分布式在线纠缠路由算法，在仅依赖局部链路状态信息的条件下，通过创新的提纯规划和期望吞吐量度量，有效满足了量子网络中端到端Bell对的保真度阈值要求，并大幅提升了成功率和服务半径。
AI.motivation: 现有的纠缠路由算法要么只优化吞吐量而不考虑保真度，要么使用具有全局链路状态知识的集中式控制器来强制执行保真度保证，无法满足许多量子网络应用对端到端Bell对保真度阈值的需求。
AI.method: 提出Q-GUARD算法，基于$k$跳邻居交换链路状态信息，利用实现的Bell对构建每链路提纯成本表，采用Werner状态等分规则分配每跳保真度目标，并利用段局部期望吞吐量（EXG）指标选择候选路径段；同时引入Q-GUARD-WS以利用每链路硬件质量估计进行非均匀提纯努力分配。
AI.result: 在具有异构链路保真度和随机BBPSSW提纯的合成100节点拓扑上，Q-GUARD将4跳路径的合格成功率从20%以下提高到85%以上，并使欧几里得距离上的合格服务半径几乎翻倍，而Q-GUARD-WS在硬件高度异构下带来了额外的吞吐量增益。
AI.conclusion: Q-GUARD及其扩展Q-GUARD-WS通过分布式协议有效实现了具有保真度保证的纠缠路由，大幅提升了量子网络的合格成功率和服务半径。
AI.translation: 许多量子网络应用需要保真度超过请求特定阈值的端到端Bell对，但现有的纠缠路由算法要么只优化吞吐量而不考虑保真度，要么使用具有全局链路状态知识的集中式控制器来强制执行保真度保证。我们提出了Q-GUARD，这是一种在线纠缠路由算法，它在分布式协议模型中强制执行每请求的保真度阈值，在该模型中节点仅与其$k$跳邻居交换链路状态信息。在每个时隙中实现链路结果后，Q-GUARD根据实现的Bell对构建每链路提纯成本表，使用Werner状态等分规则分配每跳保真度目标，并使用共同考虑交换成功、提纯开销和资源可用性的段局部期望吞吐量（EXG）指标在候选路径段之间进行选择。我们还介绍了Q-GUARD-WS，这是一个利用每链路硬件质量估计来跨跳非均匀分配提纯努力的扩展。在具有异构链路保真度和随机BBPSSW提纯的合成100节点拓扑上，Q-GUARD相对于仅吞吐量和朴素提纯基线，将4跳路径的合格成功率从20%以下提高到85%以上，并在欧几里得距离上几乎使合格服务半径翻倍，而Q-GUARD-WS在硬件高度异构下提供了额外的吞吐量增益。
AI.summary: 论文提出了Q-GUARD，一种在线分布式纠缠路由算法，能够在仅知$k$跳邻居信息的情况下强制执行每请求的保真度阈值，并通过EXG指标和提纯规划显著提升量子网络的性能。
AI.keywords: 量子网络, 纠缠路由, 分布式提纯, 保真度保证, Q-GUARD
AI.comments: 该论文提出的Q-GUARD算法解决了量子网络中分布式环境下的保真度保证与纠缠路由问题，创新性地结合了分段本地期望吞吐量（EXG）指标和Werner状态等分规则，在分布式协议模型下显著提高了合格成功率和服务半径。

title: Prompt-Induced Score Variance in Zero-Shot Binary Vision-Language Safety Classification
summary: Safety pipelines often block content by thresholding a model's first-token unsafe score. We show that a single prompt's score is not a reliable probability and compare two repairs: mean ensemble and calibration with development labels. Across seven vision-language models and two benchmarks, an input's unsafe probability varies across 15 task-preserving rewordings with a standard deviation of 0.16-0.30 on average; the inputs that vary most are more often misclassified. The 15-prompt mean has lower negative log-likelihood (NLL) than the best single prompt, even one chosen with evaluation labels, on 13 of 14 model-benchmark pairs. Development labels change the picture: jointly selecting and calibrating a single prompt outperforms the similarly calibrated mean for all seven models on held-out data from the development benchmark. Under cross-benchmark evaluation without refitting, however, the advantage reverses, with the calibrated mean outperforming the single prompt on six of seven models. We recommend evaluating first-token scores as a prompt family, using the mean ensemble as the label-free baseline, calibrating one prompt when development labels exist and deployment data match, and calibrating the mean when they may not.

AI.title_translation: 零样本二元视觉语言安全分类中由提示词引发的分数方差
AI.tldr: 视觉语言模型的安全分类分数对提示词的微小变化极度敏感，使用平均集成或适当校准可以显著提升分类的可靠性。
AI.motivation: 现有的安全管道通常通过对模型的第一token不安全分数设定阈值来拦截有害内容，但作者发现单个提示词的分数并非可靠的概率，容易因提示词的微小改变而产生显著波动并导致分类错误。
AI.method: 通过跨7个视觉语言模型和2个基准测试，评估在15种保持任务不变的重写（提示词）下不安全得分的方差；比较了平均集成（mean ensemble）与使用开发标签进行校准这两种修复方法的性能。
AI.result: 实验表明，输入的不安全概率在15种提示词重写下平均标准差达0.16-0.30，且方差最大的输入更容易被错误分类；在14个模型-基准对中的13个上，15个提示词的平均值表现出比最佳单提示词更低的负对数似然（NLL）；在交叉基准评估中，校准后的平均集成表现优于单提示词。
AI.conclusion: 视觉语言模型中的零样本二元安全分类对提示词的微小变化高度敏感，单提示词分数不可靠。平均集成在无标签和跨基准场景下表现鲁棒，而有匹配开发标签时，联合选择并校准单提示词效果更好。建议将首token分数作为提示词族进行评估。
AI.translation: 安全管道通常通过对模型的第一token不安全分数设定阈值来拦截内容。我们证明了单个提示词的分数并不是一个可靠的概率，并比较了两种修复方法：平均集成和使用开发标签进行校准。在七个视觉语言模型和两个基准测试中，输入的不安全概率在15种保持任务不变的重写中平均标准差为0.16-0.30；变化最大的输入往往被更频繁地错误分类。在14个模型-基准对中的13个上，15个提示词的平均值比最佳单提示词（甚至是使用评估标签选择的单提示词）具有更低的负对数似然（NLL）。然而，开发标签改变了情况：在来自开发基准的留出数据上，联合选择和校准单个提示词在所有七个模型上都优于类似校准的平均值。但在无需重新拟合的跨基准评估下，优势发生了逆转，校准后的平均值在七个模型中的六个上优于单个提示词。我们建议将第一token分数作为提示词族进行评估，将平均集成作为无标签基线，在存在开发标签且部署数据匹配时校准单个提示词，而在不匹配时校准平均值。
AI.summary: 本文研究了零样本二元视觉语言安全分类中由提示词引发的分数方差问题。研究发现单个提示词的安全性得分在不同重写下变化剧烈且不可靠。通过对比平均集成和校准方法，作者发现平均集成在无标签和跨基准情况下表现更佳，而匹配的开发标签则使校准单提示词更具优势，为构建稳健的安全过滤管道提供了重要指导。
AI.keywords: Vision-Language Models, Safety Classification, Prompt Sensitivity, Score Variance, Ensemble Methods
AI.comments: 本文揭示了视觉语言安全分类中基于单提示词分数的不可靠性（提示词诱导的分数方差），并通过广泛的实验对比了平均集成（mean ensemble）和基于开发标签的校准方法。文章不仅指出了现有安全管线的漏洞，还针对不同的应用场景（有/无开发标签、跨基准评估）提供了清晰的实用建议，具有很高的安全工程应用价值。

title: SENECA: Small-Sample Discrete Entropy Estimation via Self-Consistent Missing Mass
summary: Discrete entropy estimation is a classic information theory problem, wherein the average information content of a discrete random variable is estimated from samples alone. Naive approaches, such as the plugin method, fail to account for the probability mass associated with members of the random variable's support that are unobserved in a given sample, known as the "missing mass." The resulting systemic underestimation is particularly problematic when data is time-consuming or costly to gather. We propose SENECA, an entropy estimation scheme based on a novel "self-consistent" missing mass calculation. Extensive numerical experiments indicate that our approach outperforms many state-of-the-art alternatives overall in the small-sample setting. We then apply SENECA to two practical use cases, namely biodiversity estimation and the detection of incorrect large language model responses, where our method is competitive with domain-specific approaches. Our work advances SENECA as an effective drop-in replacement for small-sample entropy estimation, with broad utility across several domains.

AI.title_translation: SENECA：通过自洽缺失质量估计小样本离散熵
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为 SENECA 的小样本离散熵估计新方法，通过自洽的缺失质量计算解决了低估问题，在多个领域展现出优越的性能。
AI.motivation: 传统的朴素方法（如插件法）无法估计样本中未观测到的支持集成员所占的概率质量（即“缺失 mass”），从而导致系统性低估，这在数据采集困难或昂贵的小样本情况下尤为严重。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为 SENECA 的熵估计方案，该方案基于一种新颖的“自洽”缺失质量计算方法来修正未观测到的小概率事件带来的偏差。
AI.result: 大量的数值实验表明，SENECA 在小样本设置下的总体表现优于许多先进的替代方法；在生物多样性估计和大语言模型错误响应检测两个实际应用中，该方法也具有与领域特定方法相竞争的性能。
AI.conclusion: SENECA 是一种有效的小样本离散熵估计替代方案，通过自洽的缺失质量计算解决了传统插件方法的低估问题，并在多个领域展现出广泛的应用前景。
AI.translation: 离散熵估计是信息论中的一个经典问题，其中离散随机变量的平均信息内容仅从样本中估计。诸如插件法等朴素方法无法计算在给定样本中未被观测到的随机变量支持集成员相关的概率质量，这被称为“缺失质量”。当数据收集耗时或昂贵时，由此产生的系统性低估问题尤其严重。我们提出了 SENECA，这是一种基于新颖的“自洽”缺失质量计算的熵估计方案。大量的数值实验表明，我们的方法在小样本设置下总体优于许多最先进的替代方案。然后，我们将 SENECA 应用于两个实际用例，即生物多样性估计和大语言模型错误响应的检测，在这些用例中，我们的方法与特定领域的方法具有竞争力。我们的工作推进了 SENECA 成为小样本熵估计的有效直接替代方案，在多个领域具有广泛的实用性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了 SENECA，这是一种用于小样本离散熵估计的新方法，通过创新的自洽缺失质量计算解决了传统方法的系统性低估问题。实验证明其在小样本场景下优于现存最先进的方法，并在生物多样性和大模型错误检测等实际应用中表现出色。
AI.keywords: 离散熵估计, 小样本, 缺失质量, 自洽计算, 信息论
AI.comments: 本文针对小样本条件下的离散熵估计问题，创新性地提出了基于自洽缺失质量计算的 SENECA 方法。该方法不仅在理论和数值实验上优于现有技术，还在生物多样性估计和大模型错误响应检测等实际场景中展现出强大的通用性和竞争力，具有很高的实用价值。

title: Missingness-Conditioned Spatio-Temporal Fusion for Human Activity Recognition from Low-Quality Wearable Sensor Data
summary: Body-worn sensor networks capture human activities through complementary views, where nodes, modalities, and axes partially describe the underlying motion. In real deployments, hardware faults, wireless dropouts, and loose attachments often cause entire channels or nodes to go missing, while environmental interference degrades the remaining signals. The common impute-then-recognize pipeline introduces reconstruction errors that cannot be observed or corrected at inference. We propose the Missingness-Conditioned Spatio-Temporal Network (MCSTN), an end-to-end framework for robust activity recognition under imperfect sensing. MCSTN has three components: a structured imperfection generator that simulates point, temporal-block, axis, modality, and node failures, plus noise at varying signal-to-noise levels; a mask-aware representation that conditions node embeddings, attention, and temporal aggregation on the availability mask; and a complete-to-imperfect multi-view learning scheme where an exponential-moving-average teacher guides multiple degraded student views through semantic consistency. The encoder models temporal and cross-feature dependencies in parallel: a bi-directional selective state-space branch captures long-range temporal dependencies, a transposed-attention branch models cross-channel correlations, and adaptive weights fuse their outputs. At inference, the generator, teacher, and consistency loss are removed, so MCSTN predicts directly from the observed window and its mask without reconstruction or noise-level estimation. On PAMAP2, Opportunity, and WISDM, MCSTN achieves average macro-F1 scores of 94.24\%, 91.67\%, and 96.22\% under imperfect observations, the best among all compared methods on each dataset, and the best in every failure mode on Opportunity. It requires fewer than one million parameters, with 3.78~ms inference latency per sample.

AI.title_translation: 基于低质量可穿戴传感器数据的人体活动识别的缺失条件时空融合
AI.tldr: 提出一种缺失条件时空网络（MCSTN），无需显式数据填补，即可实现低质量可穿戴传感器数据的高效、鲁棒人体活动识别。
AI.motivation: 现实部署中的可穿戴传感器常因硬件故障、无线丢包或环境干扰导致数据缺失或信号降级，而传统的“先填补后识别”流程会引入无法在推理阶段纠正的重建误差。
AI.method: 提出缺失条件时空网络（MCSTN），包含结构化不完美生成器、掩码感知表示和完整到不完美的的多视角学习方案。编码器利用双向选择状态空间分支和转置注意力分支并行建模时空及跨特征依赖。
AI.result: 在PAMAP2、Opportunity和WISDM数据集上，MCSTN在不完美观测条件下分别取得了94.24%、91.67%和96.22%的平均宏F1分数，优于所有对比方法，且参数量少于100万，每样本推理延迟仅为3.78毫秒。
AI.conclusion: MCSTN通过端到端的缺失条件时空融合架构，有效解决了低质量可穿戴传感器数据中的缺失和噪声问题，在多个基准数据集上取得了最优的识别性能和高效的推理表现。
AI.translation: 身体佩戴的传感器网络通过互补的视角捕获人类活动，其中节点、模态和轴部分描述了潜在的运动。在实际部署中，硬件故障、无线丢包和松动会导致整个通道或节点丢失，而环境干扰会使剩余信号退化。常见的“先填补后识别”流程引入了在推理时无法观察或纠正的重建误差。我们提出了缺失条件时空网络（MCSTN），这是一个在不完美传感下进行稳健活动识别的端到端框架。MCSTN包含三个组件：一个模拟点、时间块、轴、模态和节点故障以及不同信噪比噪声的结构化不完美生成器；一个将节点嵌入、注意力和时间聚合条件化到可用性掩码上的掩码感知表示；以及一个从完整到不完整的多视图学习方案，其中指数移动平均教师通过语义一致性引导多个退化的学生视图。编码器并行建模时间和跨特征依赖关系：双向选择性状态空间分支捕获长程时间依赖关系，转置注意力分支建模跨通道相关性，自适应权重融合它们的输出。在推理时，生成器、教师和一致性损失被移除，因此MCSTN直接从观测窗口及其掩码进行预测，无需重建或噪声水平估计。在PAMAP2、Opportunity和WISDM上，MCSTN在不完美观测下的平均宏F1分数分别达到94.24%、91.67%和96.22%，在每个数据集的所有比较方法中表现最好，并且在Opportunity的每种故障模式下都是最好的。它需要不到一百万个参数，每个样本的推理延迟为3.78毫秒。
AI.summary: 论文提出了一种名为MCSTN的端到端框架，用于从低质量可穿戴传感器数据中进行鲁棒的人体活动识别。该框架通过结构化不完美生成器、掩码感知表示和多视角学习方案，在无需显式数据填补的情况下，有效处理了传感器数据的大规模缺失和噪声，并在多个公开数据集上取得了最佳的识别性能和运行效率。
AI.keywords: Human Activity Recognition, Wearable Sensors, Spatio-Temporal Fusion, Missing Data, State-Space Models
AI.comments: 该论文针对可穿戴传感器网络中常见的缺失值和噪声问题，提出了缺失条件时空融合网络（MCSTN）。创新之处在于摒弃了传统的先填补后识别流程，采用端到端的掩码感知表示和多视角学习，在保持高准确率的同时具备极低的参数量和推理延迟，具有很高的实用价值。

title: CEZSAR: A Contrastive Embedding Method for Zero-Shot Action Recognition
comments: Accepted for presentation at the International Conference on Pattern Recognition (ICPR) 2026
summary: This paper proposes a novel Zero-Shot Action Recognition~(ZSAR) method based on contrastive learning. In ZSAR, we aim to classify examples from classes that were missing during training. Two well-known problems remain in ZSAR: the semantic gap and the domain shift. A semantic gap occurs because label representations come from the textual domain (i.e., language models) and must be associated with visual representations (i.e., CNNs, RNNs, transformer-based). This multimodal nature implies that the semantic properties of the two spaces are not identical. On the other hand, the domain shift arises from differences between the training and test sets and is inherent to ZSAR once the test set is unknown. One of the most promising methods to address both issues is learning joint embedding spaces. Therefore, we propose a new model that encodes videos and sentences in a joint embedding space, trained by aligning videos with their natural-language descriptions. We design an automatic negative sampling procedure to augment the training dataset and generate unpaired data, i.e., visual appearance and unrelated descriptions. Our results are state-of-the-art on the UCF-101 and Kinetics-400 datasets under several split configurations. Our code is available at https://github.com/valterlej/cezsar.
comment: Accepted for presentation at the International Conference on Pattern Recognition (ICPR) 2026

AI.title_translation: CEZSAR：一种用于零样本动作识别的对比嵌入方法
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为CEZSAR的零样本动作识别（ZSAR）方法，通过对比学习在联合嵌入空间中对视频和文本进行对齐，并引入自动负采样来解决语义鸿沟和领域偏移问题，在UCF-101和Kinetics-400数据集上取得了最先进的结果。
AI.motivation: 零样本动作识别（ZSAR）中存在两个主要问题：语义鸿沟（文本标签与视觉表示之间的差异）和领域偏移（训练集与测试集之间的差异）。解决这两个问题对于实现对未见过类别的有效分类至关重要。
AI.method: 本文提出了一种新的模型，该模型将视频和句子编码到一个联合嵌入空间中，通过将视频与其自然语言描述对齐进行训练。为了增强训练数据集并生成非配对数据，还设计了一种自动负采样过程。
AI.result: CEZSAR方法在UCF-101和Kinetics-400数据集上的多个分割配置下取得了最先进（state-of-the-art）的结果。
AI.conclusion: 通过学习联合嵌入空间并结合自动负采样，CEZSAR有效解决了零样本动作识别中的语义鸿沟和领域偏移问题，并达到了领先的性能。
AI.translation: 本文提出了一种基于对比学习的新型零样本动作识别（ZSAR）方法。在ZSAR中，我们的目标是对训练期间缺失的类别的示例进行分类。ZSAR中仍然存在两个众所周知的问题：语义鸿沟和领域偏移。语义鸿沟的发生是因为标签表示来自文本领域（即语言模型），并且必须与视觉表示（即CNN、RNN、基于Transformer的模型）相关联。这种多模态性质意味着两个空间的语义属性不完全相同。另一方面，领域偏移源于训练集和测试集之间的差异，并且一旦测试集未知，它就成为ZSAR固有的问题。解决这两个问题最有前途的方法之一是学习联合嵌入空间。因此，我们提出了一种新模型，该模型将视频和句子编码到一个联合嵌入空间中，通过将视频与其自然语言描述对齐进行训练。我们设计了一种自动负采样程序来增强训练数据集并生成非配对数据，即视觉外观和不相关的描述。我们的结果在UCF-101和Kinetics-400数据集的多种分割配置下达到了最先进的水平。我们的代码可在https://github.com/valterlej/cezsar获取。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为CEZSAR的零样本动作识别（ZSAR）新方法，该方法利用对比学习构建一个联合嵌入空间。为解决ZSAR中固有的语义鸿沟和领域偏移问题，CEZSAR模型将视频和自然语言描述对齐编码到同一空间中，并通过自动负采样机制增强训练数据。该方法在UCF-101和Kinetics-400数据集上展现出最先进的性能。
AI.keywords: 零样本动作识别, 对比学习, 联合嵌入, 语义鸿沟, 领域偏移
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于将对比学习应用于零样本动作识别，并通过学习联合嵌入空间有效弥合了视觉与文本之间的语义鸿沟，同时通过自动负采样缓解了领域偏移问题。其在标准数据集上达到SOTA结果，表明了方法的有效性和重要性。

title: High-Speed, Scalable Sensor Readout for Dexterous Robotic Hands via Shift-Register Multiplexing
comments: 8 pages, 8 figures. Updated to the accepted manuscript for IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters. Project website and videos: https://srl-ethz.github.io/scalable-sensor-readout/
summary: Dexterous robotic hands require high-speed multimodal sensing across many degrees of freedom, yet existing readout architectures often impose trade-offs between sensor count, wiring complexity, and sampling bandwidth. This paper presents a scalable analog sensor readout architecture based on a serial-in parallel-out (SIPO) shift-register principle. The proposed architecture supports versatile integration of heterogeneous analog-output sensors, scalable expansion using only three signal lines between sensor modules, and fast, configurable sampling. We validate the approach on a tendon-driven robotic hand integrating 16 joint sensor modules and one four-channel tactile sensor module, enabling acquisition of 20 sensor channels at a full-scan rate of 1 kHz, with stable operation up to 1.5 kHz. Joint sensor characterization showed a maximum slope absolute percentage error (APE) of 0.446% and sub-degree estimation error, indicating that the proposed readout system preserves sensing performance. For tactile sensing, LSTM-based models enabled real-time force estimation and contact-location classification at 1 kHz. System-level experiments showed that the joint sensors provided more accurate feedback than motor-based estimation during interaction. Closed-loop experiments further demonstrated improved joint trajectory tracking using joint-sensor feedback and force-controlled object pinching using tactile feedback. The proposed architecture offers a practical path toward sensorized robotic hands for dexterous manipulation.
comment: 8 pages, 8 figures. Updated to the accepted manuscript for IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters. Project website and videos: https://srl-ethz.github.io/scalable-sensor-readout/

AI.title_translation: 基于移位寄存器复用的灵巧机器人手高速、可扩展传感器读出系统
AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于移位寄存器的传感器读出架构，仅需三条信号线即可实现灵巧手上多传感器的高速、高带宽、高精度数据采集与闭环控制。
AI.motivation: 灵巧机器人手需要在多个自由度上进行高速多模态传感，但现有的读出架构往往在传感器数量、布线复杂度和采样带宽之间存在权衡。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于串入并行出（SIPO）移位寄存器原理的模拟传感器读出架构，仅需三条信号线即可实现模块间的可扩展扩展，并在肌腱驱动的机器人手上集成了16个关节传感器模块和一个4通道触觉传感器模块进行验证。
AI.result: 实现了20个传感器通道在1 kHz下的全扫描率（稳定运行可达1.5 kHz），关节传感器最大斜率绝对百分比误差（APE）为0.446%，亚度级估计误差；结合LSTM模型实现了1 kHz的实时力估计和接触位置分类，并通过闭环实验验证了轨迹跟踪和力控抓取性能的提升。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的基于移位寄存器复用的模拟传感器读出架构，能够以极少的信号线实现大量异构传感器的高速、高精度采集，为高度集成的灵巧机器人手提供了一种实用的解决方案。
AI.translation: 灵巧机器人手需要在许多自由度上进行高速多模态传感，然而现有的读出架构往往在传感器数量、布线复杂度和采样带宽之间造成权衡。本文提出了一种基于串入并行出（SIPO）移位寄存器原理的可扩展模拟传感器读出架构。该提出的架构支持异构模拟输出传感器的多功能集成、仅使用传感器模块之间的三根信号线进行可扩展扩展，以及快速、可配置的采样。我们在集成16个关节传感器模块和1个4通道触觉传感器模块的肌腱驱动机器人手上验证了该方法，能够以1 kHz的全扫描速率采集20个传感器通道，并能以高达1.5 kHz的频率稳定运行。关节传感器表征显示最大斜率绝对百分比误差（APE）为0.446%，估计误差小于一度，表明所提出的读出系统保持了传感性能。对于触觉传感，基于LSTM的模型实现了1 kHz的实时力估计和接触位置分类。系统级实验表明，在交互过程中，关节传感器比基于电机的估计提供更准确的反馈。闭环实验进一步证明了使用关节传感器反馈改进了关节轨迹跟踪，以及使用触觉反馈进行了力控物体捏取。所提出的架构为实现用于灵巧操作的具传感能力的机器人手提供了一条实用的途径。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种基于移位寄存器复用的可扩展传感器读出架构，用于解决灵巧机器人手中传感器高密度布线与带宽的冲突，通过在肌腱驱动灵巧手上的实验验证了其高速、高精度和闭环控制优势。
AI.keywords: 传感器读出, 移位寄存器多路复用, 灵巧机器人手, 触觉传感, 高速采样
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种基于移位寄存器复用技术的全方位、高速、可扩展的灵巧手传感器读出架构，有效解决了传感器数量、布线复杂度和采样带宽之间的矛盾，在机器人灵巧操作领域具有重要的应用价值。

title: SignVerse-2M: A Two-Million-Clip Pose-Native Universe of 55+ Sign Languages
summary: Large-scale sign language resources usually pair RGB videos with text and support recognition, translation, and generation. However, RGB frames contain backgrounds, clothing, and other appearance information unrelated to signing motion. Representing the videos as whole-body keypoints such as DWPose removes much of this variation, produces a compact description of body, hand, and facial movement, and matches the input used by recent pose-guided video models. Existing datasets do not provide this representation at scale for in-the-wild sign language videos. We present SignVerse-2M, a multilingual dataset containing approximately two million pose clips from more than 55 sign languages. We process publicly available sign language videos with a shared DWPose pipeline, representing body, hand, and facial motion in the same keypoint format across all clips. The source videos include diverse signers, viewpoints, and recording environments. We also release the processing pipeline, task definitions, and SignDW Transformer baselines. Experiments show that the data supports multilingual text-to-pose modeling and that the generated poses can directly drive several recent pose-conditioned rendering systems.

AI.title_translation: SignVerse-2M：一个包含55种以上手语的200万剪辑姿态原生数据集
AI.tldr: SignVerse-2M是一个包含200万个姿态剪辑的多语言手语数据集，涵盖55种以上手语，旨在通过使用DWPose关键点表示来解决现有RGB视频数据集中无关背景信息的问题，并支持文本到姿态建模和姿态驱动的渲染系统。
AI.motivation: 现有的大规模手语资源通常将RGB视频与文本配对，但RGB帧包含与手语动作无关的背景和外观信息。将视频表示为全身关键点（如DWPose）可以消除这种无关变化，提供紧凑的身体、手和面部动作描述，并与当前姿态引导视频模型的输入匹配。然而，现有的数据集无法大规模提供这种“野外”手语视频的姿态表示。
AI.method: 我们提出了SignVerse-2M，一个多语言数据集，包含来自55种以上手语的约200万个姿态剪辑。我们使用共享的DWPose管道处理公开可用的手语视频，将身体、手和面部动作以相同的关键点格式表示。源视频包含多样化的手语者、视角和录制环境。我们还发布了处理管道、任务定义和SignDW Transformer基线。
AI.result: SignVerse-2M数据集支持多语言文本到姿态建模，并且生成的姿态可以直接驱动多个最近的姿态条件渲染系统。
AI.conclusion: SignVerse-2M成功地创建了一个大规模的姿态原生手语数据集，通过DWPose关键点表示解决了RGB视频中无关信息的问题，并证明了其在文本到姿态建模和姿态驱动渲染方面的有效性。
AI.translation: 大规模手语资源通常将RGB视频与文本配对，并支持识别、翻译和生成。然而，RGB帧包含与手语动作无关的背景、服装和其他外观信息。将视频表示为全身关键点，如DWPose，可以消除大部分这种变化，生成身体、手和面部动作的紧凑描述，并与最近姿态引导视频模型所使用的输入相匹配。现有的数据集无法大规模提供这种“野外”手语视频的表示。我们提出了SignVerse-2M，一个多语言数据集，包含来自55种以上手语的约200万个姿态剪辑。我们使用共享的DWPose管道处理公开可用的手语视频，以相同的关键点格式表示所有剪辑中的身体、手和面部动作。源视频包括多样化的手语者、视角和录制环境。我们还发布了处理管道、任务定义和SignDW Transformer基线。实验表明，该数据支持多语言文本到姿态建模，并且生成的姿态可以直接驱动多个最近的姿态条件渲染系统。
AI.summary: SignVerse-2M是一个大规模的多语言手语数据集，包含来自55种以上手语的约200万个姿态剪辑。该数据集通过使用DWPose关键点表示，解决了传统RGB视频数据集中无关背景和外观信息的问题，提供了一种紧凑且与现代姿态引导模型兼容的手语动作描述。该项目发布了处理管道和基线模型，并实验证明其数据支持多语言文本到姿态建模以及姿态驱动的渲染系统。
AI.keywords: 手语数据集, 姿态关键点, DWPose, 多语言手语, 文本到姿态建模
AI.comments: SignVerse-2M通过将手语视频转换为姿态关键点表示，创新性地解决了传统RGB视频数据中无关信息干扰的问题，为手语识别、翻译和生成任务提供了更纯净、更高效的输入。其大规模（200万剪辑，55+手语）和多语言特性使其成为手语研究领域的重要资源。发布处理管道和基线模型也极大地促进了社区的进一步研究和开发。

title: Reduced-Feedback Hybrid Precoding for Wideband mmWave MIMO-OFDM Systems via Hierarchical Interpolation
comments: 6 pages, 4 figures, 1 table. Accepted for presentation at the 2026 IEEE GLOBECOM Workshops
summary: In this paper, we propose a feedback-efficient hybrid precoding framework for wideband millimeter-wave (mmWave) multiple-input multiple-output orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing (MIMO-OFDM) systems. To reduce the hardware cost of radio-frequency (RF) chains and the feedback burden associated with frequency-selective digital precoding, frequency-flat analog precoders and combiners are first constructed from the dominant angle-of-arrival (AoA) and angle-of-departure (AoD) directions associated with the strongest propagation paths. For digital precoding, a shared quantized codebook is designed using the Lloyd algorithm, and a binary-search-based hierarchical interpolation method is developed to identify codeword switching locations between adjacent pilot subcarriers. By avoiding exhaustive codeword comparisons over all intermediate subcarriers, the proposed method reduces online search complexity and enables compact digital-precoder feedback. For the considered system configuration, the proposed method achieves a worst-case feedback reduction of approximately 98.34% relative to full-grid per-subcarrier feedback. Simulation results further demonstrate competitive spectral efficiency and bit error rate (BER) performance, low computational cost, and robustness under imperfect effective channel state information (CSI).
